chapters.title: Chapter 4580 - Capítulo 4580: The Chicken Or The Egg? I
paragraphs: Capítulo 4580: The Chicken Or The Egg? I
Existence was paradoxical by nature.
There were countless such paradoxes woven throughout the fabric of reality, and the one entity standing tall and paradoxical above all others was unique even among the extraordinary.
Inside THE Loom, in that paradoxical region filled with incomprehensible wonder, THE Living Paradox floated with deep contemplation as his eyes perceived far too many things simultaneously.

Many misunderstood him. Many misunderstood his fundamental nature and his true ambitions. Even those within THE Loom itself, even the tiny False THE and Pre-THE entities who served his purposes, Even THE...only a select few knew his actual goals. And no others, not even Emotive who stood closest to his confidence, knew his true, TRUE ambitions that lay beneath even those surface objectives.

THE Loom was a grand construct of staggering complexity. Few entities across existence knew that it was actually a weapon, not merely a domain or territory. A weapon directed against The Belly of Existence itself, aimed squarely at THE Creature with calculated precision.

It was an attack and weapon that spanned from The Earliest Folds and even slightly before that primordial era, extending all the way to the current time period. And even that description barely scratched the surface of intricacies that others could not begin to fathom. Some even thought they were its Architects when they were merely led to it!

His enemy was THE Creature, after all, so he had to prepare extensively and with meticulous care. One single slip up, one moment of carelessness, and he would be utterly destroyed without possibility of recovery.

Which was precisely why he had left behind so many layered countermeasures across existence. At the mere sign of a possibility, at even the potential of a countermeasure being triggered as an alarm bell, he would immediately follow up to investigate and respond.
And now, he had to follow up on something unexpected.

When it came to the events unfolding outside of THE Loom in the collapsed former Transcendent Paradoxical Folds, he had so far been relaxing, enjoying the spectacle, and playing around with indirect influence. But might it be time to get genuinely serious about intervention?
A profound silence spread through the paradoxical sea like ripples across still water.
And Paradox, who had been relaxing in languid repose on a throne of endless seas of paradox that lay above existence itself, shifted his body with deliberate motion.
He moved from being laid back in casual observation, and sat upright with focused attention.
He merely sat upright.
But this simple action alone should terrify even THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entities if they could perceive it occurring.
Because when Paradox decided to sit up and pay attention, existence itself trembled!
Oh!

In The Infinite Unfurling, deep within Ginnungagap’s ancient territory on the shores of The Primordial Genesis Shore, Noah floated downward with tremendous sense of exuberance after speaking his first ever Phoneme.
His first true letter of The First Tongue.
His entire existence felt utterly ecstatic at this moment as an array of prompts flashed before his enhanced vision with detailed information.
|Phoneme Learned: Fire (Primordial Combustion)|
|Current Mastery Level: Novice Speaker (1st Tier)|
|Mastery Progression: Novice Speaker, Fluent Speaker, Perfect Speaker|
|At Novice Speaker: Can speak Phoneme with basic accuracy, drawing upon Grand Principles|
|At Fluent Speaker: Can speak Phoneme with refined accuracy, potentially drawing upon a nearby Singularity Principles|
|At Perfect Speaker: Can speak Phoneme with flawless accuracy, potentially drawing upon a nearby Genesis Principle|
|THE Organ of Civilization is advancing|
|The Parenchyma within THE Organ of Civilization are now being forged.|

|The Parenchyma represents the functional tissue of THE Organ, the essential matter that performs the primary work of processing and integrating civilizational complexity. Like biological parenchyma forms the working substance of organs, this structure will form the working substance of your civilizational authority.|
|Function: Processes incoming knowledge, refines understanding, converts raw information into usable advancement.|
|Current Status: Initial formation at 23% Organ development.|
|OVERALL ORGAN DEVELOPMENT: 23%|
|Advancement rate: Dramatically increased through First Tongue comprehension.|

Noah observed all of these grand prompts with analytical interest, but instead of focusing entirely on his advancement metrics, he looked down toward the figures of Ul’moreth and THE Fisherman standing on the shore below.

He floated downward gradually as he could feel the hairy figure of Ul’moreth smiling at him beneath all that obscuring hair. But he had also picked up something concerning with his enhanced perception during the earlier conversation.
He landed softly on the obsidian surface and spoke with cautious inquiry.
|I heard mentions of dangers? References to The Others? What exactly is this referring to?|
His Mana perception had been extraordinarily acute during the moment of his breakthrough, catching fragments of the conversation between the two ancient beings.
Ains sighed deeply at his direct question, his six arms shifting position with body language suggesting reluctance to discuss this topic.
Ul’moreth’s body vibrated with acknowledgment before he began his explanation with characteristic thoroughness.

|The Others refer to creatures who are anomalous in their own right and were born just as early as us Ginnu Lifeforms in the primordial eras of existence. Most of them do not sit still peacefully, nor are they free to be like us, simply enjoying existence as it naturally unfolds. They seem to be imprisoned by an incapability of just sitting still and observing. They are always seeking something with desperate intensity.|

|They are like you in that particular regard, Little Anomaly. Always advancing, always cultivating, always pushing boundaries. But on a scale that dwarfs conventional ambition. They seek to impose their weavings over everything. Over Existence itself. Over The First Tongue. Over every concept and principle and law. Everything must bend to their vision.|
His obsidian gold hair flowed with emphasis.

|The Others are entities you may or may not already know by reputation, but the main ones who concern us most are THE Creature, THE Primordial Chaos, THE Living Paradox, THE Secretive Eon, among several others of similar caliber. Each one represents a fundamental approach to existence, a different answer to how reality should be structured and governed.|

|You, Little Anomaly, with what your unique nature managed to accomplish with The First Tongue, can actually be considered one of The Others now. You have achieved something that places you in their category, whether you desired that classification or not. You are no longer merely a cultivator or an exceptional entity. You are now a potential candidate for reshaping existence itself according to your vision.|
|But to understand why there exists such conflict and this desperate need for supremacy among The Others, why they cannot simply coexist peacefully, you have to ask yourself a fundamental question.|
He paused for dramatic effect.
|What came first, Little Anomaly? The chicken, or the egg?|

chapters.title: Chapter 4581 - Capítulo 4581: The Chicken Or The Egg? II
paragraphs: Capítulo 4581: The Chicken Or The Egg? II
What?
Noah blinked at the seemingly ridiculous question appearing at the end of such a serious explanation.
Ul’moreth laughed heartily at his reaction, clearly enjoying the moment.

|Haha, yes, I know how absurd it sounds! But bear with me, Little Anomaly. There exists a question, one that has consumed the contemplation of many entities across all eras since awareness first emerged from undifferentiated chaos,| Ul’moreth began with voice carrying the weight of ancient philosophical inquiry.

|A question so fundamental that it sits at the very foundation of everything we understand about reality, and yet remains utterly unanswerable despite eons of dedicated contemplation by the wisest minds.|
|The question is deceptively simple in its phrasing, yet incomprehensibly complex in its implications. What came first, Little Anomaly? Existence itself, or The First Tongue?|
The space around him began to shimmer as obsidian gold diagrams formed to illustrate the philosophical paradox with visual clarity.

|Consider the first position held by many powerful entities. Some argue that Existence had to exist first in order for The First Tongue to form as the language of existence. After all, how can a language exist without something for that language to describe? How can there be speech without a speaker to produce it? How can there be words without reality to give those words meaning and context?|

|By this logic, Existence came first as primordial chaos, as undifferentiated potential, as formless void waiting to take shape. And then, from within that already existing chaos, The First Tongue emerged as a way for existence to organize itself, to speak itself into structured forms, to create grammar and syntax from randomness. The language arose from existence, not the other way around.|
The diagrams shifted to show a completely different perspective.

|But then consider the opposing position, equally supported by compelling evidence and reasoning. These entities argue that The First Tongue spoke existence into being, that the language came first and created reality through the act of being spoken. When The First Tongue first declared concepts like space, time, matter, energy, these things came into being specifically because they were named, because they were spoken with proper pronunciation and structure.|

|By this logic, before The First Tongue was spoken, there was absolutely nothing. Not even chaos or void, because chaos and void are themselves concepts that require language to define them. The very first utterance of The First Tongue created existence by giving it definition, by establishing the rules and patterns that would govern all future reality.|
Ul’moreth’s presence seemed to lean forward with emphasis on the critical flaw embedded in both arguments.

|But here is where the paradox becomes truly inescapable, Little Anomaly. If we accept that The First Tongue came first and spoke existence into being, then we must answer a devastating question. If The First Tongue existed before existence, was that not itself a form of existence? How can something be, how can something have the capability to speak and create, without already existing in some form?|

|The moment we say The First Tongue existed first, we have already conceded that existence preceded it, because The First Tongue’s presence is itself existence. We have contradicted our own position through the very act of stating it clearly.|
The diagrams showed the two positions circling each other endlessly without any possibility of resolution.

|This is what The Others have called THE Primordial Paradox. The Chicken or The Egg elevated to a terrifying significance. Which came first? And more frustratingly, how can we possibly determine the answer when the very act of existing in a position to ask the question means we are already operating within a framework where both existence and language are so intertwined that separating them becomes impossible?|

|Ah, you can go round and round in circles as it remains a genuine paradox without solution. Which is why in existence, I would actually not fear THE Creature or THE Primordial Chaos among The Others, despite their terrifying power and ambition.|
His voice dropped to carry genuine warning.

|But I would be most cautious of THE Primordial Paradox, THE Living Paradox specifically. While others argue passionately about what came first and wage wars to prove their position correct, Paradox continues to enjoy the sheer nature of this question itself. That entity thrives on contradiction, feeds on unresolvable conflicts, grows stronger from the very debate that weakens others.|

|That is the one you would have to be most careful of, Little Anomaly. Because while you fight to prove your answer, Paradox has already won by ensuring the question can never be definitively answered.|
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes shone with tremendous luminosity as understanding cascaded through his existence.
Oh, how absolutely right Ul’moreth was, even though the ancient being did not fully know the extent of that truth!

Based on what had already happened years from now in the timeline Noah had experienced, based on what he had witnessed of Paradox’s machinations, that entity had truly set themselves up to be absolutely terrifying in ways that defied conventional understanding.
The one who enjoyed the question more than any possible answer.
The one who won by ensuring no one else could ever truly win!
The information that Ul’moreth continued to provide was expansive and kept opening up different pathways and possibilities that Noah had not even known existed.
Among the many revelations that had just been shared, the identities of The Others swirled in his mind with urgent curiosity.

THE Creature and THE Living Paradox he already knew of from direct experience. But THE Primordial Chaos sounded utterly insane as a concept, alongside THE Secretive Eon whose very name suggested hidden depths.

If they were being mentioned in the same breath alongside entities like THE Creature or THE Living Paradox, THE Primordial Paradox...they had to be immensely powerful existences operating on scales that defied conventional comprehension.

This begged the question once more that had been bothering Noah for some time. Where exactly did all the THE level entities go? Why were they so rare in the current era when logic suggested there should be more of them scattered across existence?

Noah felt like he had an inkling of an idea forming, a working theory that was beginning to take shape in his mind. But it was so wild and potentially disturbing that he would only give it serious credibility when he obtained substantially more information to support or disprove it.
But for now, there was the continuation of expanding his knowledge on The Way of Existence and The First Tongue.

He normally would not give anyone the time of day to be talking so extensively and at such length as Ul’moreth was doing. But regardless of how long winded this entity wanted to be, he could continue talking in entire paragraphs for hours and Noah would not care in the slightest. Talk as much as you wanted, big guy!
Just continue feeding him as much knowledge as possible, and he would advance even further!

chapters.title: Chapter 4582 - Capítulo 4582: The Chicken Or The Egg? III
paragraphs: Capítulo 4582: The Chicken Or The Egg? III

And as if he could clearly perceive Noah’s shining eyes filled with boundless tyranny and hunger for understanding, the hairy form of Ul’moreth shone with obsidian gold light as he continued with somewhat jovial and laid back tone.

|Do not worry too much about the immediate threat of The Others for now, Little Anomaly,| he said with reassuring emphasis. |When it comes to that fundamental question about what came first, even I have not found an answer that satisfies me completely after eons of contemplation. The Ginnu Lifeforms emerged when The First Tongue was still being actively formed, when existence was learning to speak itself into structured reality, and even we cannot say with absolute certainty which came first because we were integral parts of that formation process itself.|

|We are the living evidence of the question, not the definitive answer to it. We witnessed the process but cannot say whether we observed language creating existence or existence creating language, because the two were so intertwined during formation that separation becomes impossible.|
His presence radiated patient teaching energy.

|What I can tell you is this with absolute conviction. The question matters tremendously because how you personally answer it shapes everything else about how you understand cultivation, advancement, and the fundamental nature of power itself. Those who believe Existence came first tend to view The First Tongue as a tool, certainly a powerful method but ultimately subordinate to the reality it describes. It is useful, it is effective, but it serves existence rather than commanding it.|

|Those who believe The First Tongue came first view it as the ultimate authority, the creative force that shapes all reality through proper pronunciation and grammatical structure. To them, existence itself is subordinate to language, merely the manifestation of what The First Tongue declares into being.|
His presence focused entirely on Noah with concentrated teaching intensity.

|You, Little Anomaly, by choosing The Way of Mana, by declaring The First Tongue as your fundamental path of cultivation, have implicitly chosen a side in this ancient debate whether you consciously realized it at the time or not. You are arguing through your very existence that The First Tongue holds primacy, that language shapes reality rather than merely describing what already exists.|

|And this philosophical position will be one of your greatest challenges going forward. You will encounter entities, powerful beyond measure, who favor the opposing view with passionate conviction. Who believe that Existence came first and that The First Tongue is merely a sophisticated tool for manipulating that pre-existing existence. They will challenge your path directly, they will argue against your fundamental assumptions, and they will seek to prove through combat and philosophical debate that their understanding is superior to yours. To Break your Way.|

|Some will not even care for debate at all and will simply attempt to collapse you immediately, those crazy violent things. They view your position as so fundamentally flawed that conversation is pointless.|
Ul’moreth’s voice carried genuine concern mixed with encouragement.

|How will you defend your position, Little Anomaly? How will you argue that The First Tongue deserves primacy when the very fact of your existence seems to prove that existence preceded your ability to speak? After all, you had to exist before you could learn The First Tongue, which appears to support the position that existence comes first.|

|This is not merely philosophical exercise or abstract contemplation. This is a question that will determine whether your Way can advance to its highest potential or whether it will collapse under the weight of its own contradictions and paradoxes. Reality itself will test whether your answer holds validity, and if it does not, your entire cultivation foundation may crumble.|
The obsidian gold diagrams that had been illustrating his points dissipated as Ul’moreth concluded this particular teaching.

|Your biggest challenge in the battles to come will not be learning to speak more Phonemes or even construct complex combinations of them. It will be arguing your answer to this fundamental question against those who favor the position that Existence came first, and convincing reality itself that your answer deserves to reshape the rules by which all things operate.|
His tone became more serious and warning.

|Do not meet The Others if you are not ready, Little Anomaly. They will absolutely curbstomp you and beat you sideways before they collapse you entirely or devour you for resources. Ah, it is frankly ridiculous how powerful they are. But hey, you have got me as a teacher, so you should be okay! Bahaha!|
Noah smiled at the words as he recognized how genuinely unique Ul’moreth was as an instructor.
Who could he truly think of in his past as a proper Teacher with capital T?

Khor and he had discussed existence and its nature extensively. Tor had helped him in similar ways as they also discussed existence and the mechanics of power. But Ul’moreth’s contributions to the understanding of his Way and the direct teaching of The First Tongue were on an entirely different level of impact.

And in regards to Ul’moreth’s words about not meeting any of The Others right now, this advice was already difficult to follow. He was already deeply embroiled with both THE Living Paradox and THE Creature through various conflicts and connections.
Paradox was a wild card that could be absolutely monstrous and disastrous if provoked or if circumstances aligned incorrectly.
He had to move cautiously and with extreme care.
He immediately sent a mental warning to The Infiniverse through their connection to be ready for absolutely anything and to prioritize survival above all other objectives.
Thereafter, his eyes burned with renewed hunger for more knowledge as he spoke to Ul’moreth with clear intention.

|I will keep everything you have said in mind and process it carefully,| he said with acknowledgment. |How about we talk more extensively about The First Tongue itself? Maybe I could learn more Phonemes to expand my vocabulary? Or perhaps you could teach me about what exists above Phonemes in the linguistic hierarchy?The...Logos?|
His search for knowledge was absolutely transparent and undisguised.
Ul’moreth and Ains looked at each other and laughed heartily at his enthusiasm, clearly pleased with such a dedicated student.
Ains turned around to continue his casual fishing in the chaotic waters below, his six arms moving with practiced motion as his line cast out once more.
Ul’moreth turned around and began walking toward the endless forests and mountains that stretched across The Primordial Genesis Shore.

|Let me take you further into this little place here,| he said with voice carrying invitation. |We shall walk and talk. Walk and talk! There is much more to see and much more to teach, Little Anomaly.|
Noah turned to nod at THE Fisherman for a goodbye as this entity smiled lightly and nodded back.
Ul’moreth’s obsidian gold hair flowed behind him as he began leading Noah deeper into the ancient territory where existence first learned to speak.

We witnessed the process but cannot say whether we observed language creating existence or existence creating language, because the two were so intertwined during formation that separation becomes impossible.|
His presence radiated patient teaching energy.
|What I can tell you is this with absolute conviction.
The question matters tremendously because how you personally answer it shapes everything else about how you understand cultivation, advancement, and the fundamental nature of power itself.
Those who believe Existence came first tend to view The First Tongue as a tool, certainly a powerful method but ultimately subordinate to the reality it describes.
It is useful, it is effective, but it serves existence rather than commanding it.|
|Those who believe The First Tongue came first view it as the ultimate authority, the creative force that shapes all reality through proper pronunciation and grammatical structure.
To them, existence itself is subordinate to language, merely the manifestation of what The First Tongue declares into being.|
His presence focused entirely on Noah with concentrated teaching intensity.

|You, Little Anomaly, by choosing The Way of Mana, by declaring The First Tongue as your fundamental path of cultivation, have implicitly chosen a side in this ancient debate whether you consciously realized it at the time or not.
You are arguing through your very existence that The First Tongue holds primacy, that language shapes reality rather than merely describing what already exists.|
|And this philosophical position will be one of your greatest challenges going forward.
You will encounter entities, powerful beyond measure, who favor the opposing view with passionate conviction.
Who believe that Existence came first and that The First Tongue is merely a sophisticated tool for manipulating that pre-existing existence.

They will challenge your path directly, they will argue against your fundamental assumptions, and they will seek to prove through combat and philosophical debate that their understanding is superior to yours.
To Break your Way.|
|Some will not even care for debate at all and will simply attempt to collapse you immediately, those crazy violent things.
They view your position as so fundamentally flawed that conversation is pointless.|
Ul’moreth’s voice carried genuine concern mixed with encouragement.
|How will you defend your position, Little Anomaly?
How will you argue that The First Tongue deserves primacy when the very fact of your existence seems to prove that existence preceded your ability to speak?
After all, you had to exist before you could learn The First Tongue, which appears to support the position that existence comes first.|
|This is not merely philosophical exercise or abstract contemplation.
This is a question that will determine whether your Way can advance to its highest potential or whether it will collapse under the weight of its own contradictions and paradoxes.
Reality itself will test whether your answer holds validity, and if it does not, your entire cultivation foundation may crumble.|
The obsidian gold diagrams that had been illustrating his points dissipated as Ul’moreth concluded this particular teaching.
|Your biggest challenge in the battles to come will not be learning to speak more Phonemes or even construct complex combinations of them.

It will be arguing your answer to this fundamental question against those who favor the position that Existence came first, and convincing reality itself that your answer deserves to reshape the rules by which all things operate.|
His tone became more serious and warning.
|Do not meet The Others if you are not ready, Little Anomaly.
They will absolutely curbstomp you and beat you sideways before they collapse you entirely or devour you for resources.
Ah, it is frankly ridiculous how powerful they are.
But hey, you have got me as a teacher, so you should be okay!
Bahaha!|
Noah smiled at the words as he recognized how genuinely unique Ul’moreth was as an instructor.
Who could he truly think of in his past as a proper Teacher with capital T?
Khor and he had discussed existence and its nature extensively.
Tor had helped him in similar ways as they also discussed existence and the mechanics of power.
But Ul’moreth’s contributions to the understanding of his Way and the direct teaching of The First Tongue were on an entirely different level of impact.
And in regards to Ul’moreth’s words about not meeting any of The Others right now, this advice was already difficult to follow.
He was already deeply embroiled with both THE Living Paradox and THE Creature through various conflicts and connections.
Paradox was a wild card that could be absolutely monstrous and disastrous if provoked or if circumstances aligned incorrectly.
He had to move cautiously and with extreme care.
He immediately sent a mental warning to The Infiniverse through their connection to be ready for absolutely anything and to prioritize survival above all other objectives.
Thereafter, his eyes burned with renewed hunger for more knowledge as he spoke to Ul’moreth with clear intention.
|I will keep everything you have said in mind and process it carefully,| he said with acknowledgment. |How about we talk more extensively about The First Tongue itself?
Maybe I could learn more Phonemes to expand my vocabulary?
Or perhaps you could teach me about what exists above Phonemes in the linguistic hierarchy?The...Logos?|
His search for knowledge was absolutely transparent and undisguised.
Ul’moreth and Ains looked at each other and laughed heartily at his enthusiasm, clearly pleased with such a dedicated student.
Ains turned around to continue his casual fishing in the chaotic waters below, his six arms moving with practiced motion as his line cast out once more.
Ul’moreth turned around and began walking toward the endless forests and mountains that stretched across The Primordial Genesis Shore.
|Let me take you further into this little place here,| he said with voice carrying invitation. |We shall walk and talk.
Walk and talk!
There is much more to see and much more to teach, Little Anomaly.|
Noah turned to nod at THE Fisherman for a goodbye as this entity smiled lightly and nodded back.
Ul’moreth’s obsidian gold hair flowed behind him as he began leading Noah deeper into the ancient territory where existence first learned to speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 4583: Is A Foundation Ever Complete? I
paragraphs: The Primordial Genesis Shore was unfathomably vast and filled with wonder that defied easy comprehension.
Even the regions that Noah was currently crossing with Ul’moreth were filled with their own unique wonders and intricacies that would require years to fully explore and understand.

The landscape was more stable than the outside regions he had crossed not too long ago, where reality itself seemed to constantly teeter on the edge of collapse. But this stability was held together loosely by civilizational authority woven throughout the environment.

They walked through forests of unfathomably tall trees that stretched toward the sky like pillars supporting heaven itself. The trunks were wider than entire cities, their bark formed from compressed layers of crystallized existence. The canopy far above created a ceiling of interwoven branches that filtered the strange light of Ginnungagap into patterns of obsidian gold illumination.

Each tree seemed to pulse with different types of civilizational authority, as if entire civilizations had somehow crystallized their essence into these ancient growths. Some radiated the authority of conquest and expansion. Others carried the weight of accumulated knowledge and philosophy. Still others hummed with the concentrated power of technological advancement compressed into organic form.

But at the baseline of all of it, obsidian waves of pure Mana could be distinctly felt by Noah. Even more so now that he was beginning to understand The First Tongue a little bit better, he could perceive how these trees were fundamentally expressions of undifferentiated Mana that had been spoken into specialized forms.
As they crossed through this vast primordial forest,Ul’moreth’svoice took on a more somber quality.
|Do you know why Ains is sitting and fishing at the edge of this endless shore?| he asked with a tone suggesting deeper significance.

Noah blinked with mild surprise and looked back in the direction they had come from, though the fishing figure was long out of sight. The question had not struck him as particularly significant before. He had simply assumed the entity enjoyed fishing as a pastime.
So he shook his head to indicate his ignorance.
Ul’moreth continued with voice carrying weight of ancient history and consequence.

|Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms have a very unique bond that binds us together across all of Ginnungagap and beyond,| he explained with careful emphasis. |Collapsing any single one of us is considered akin to collapsing all of us in terms of offense and consequence. Those who do so, regardless of their power or justification, are hunted down by every Ginnu Lifeform across existence until they are found and eliminated. This is our law, absolute and inviolable.|

|Ains, well, something happened long ago. He collapsed a THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty Ginnu in a conflict whose details have been lost to time. It was a monumentally significant event that shook our entire community. I vouched for him among others, arguing that circumstances justified his actions, that the collapsed entity had transgressed first in ways that demanded response.|

|But even with my support and the support of others, there were consequences. For the past countless eons, he has had to sit at the edge of this shore as penance and observation. Never leaving it for anything else, never venturing into the deeper territories or beyond Ginnungagap’s boundaries. It can get quite lonely for him sometimes, fishing in those chaotic waters with only occasional visitors for company.|

Noah’s eyes shone brightly with surprise and contemplation. He had not even considered something like this, had not imagined the complex social structures and consequences that existed among these ancient beings.
Existence was vast with its own intricacies, and everyone held their own stories of triumph and tragedy, of mistakes and redemption.
Ul’morethperceived his contemplative silence and spoke with philosophical acceptance.

|Haha, do not worry yourself too much about such things, Little Anomaly. Existence is as existence is. We live, we die, and existence continues on regardless of our individual dramas. In the meanwhile, we enjoy The First Tongue and Existence itself and do what we can to understand the unfathomable mysteries out there.|

|If you ever find anyone telling you they have discovered everything or know everything about existence, then such entities have already veered far off the path of genuine understanding. Nobody knows everything, Little Anomaly. Even for me, someone who has existed since the formation of structured reality, there is infinitely much that I do not know and may never comprehend.|
Nobody knew everything.

Noah nodded at these words with genuine agreement. There were countless things in existence, layers upon layers of complexity and mystery. And most entities were only grasping at the very tip of existence’s iceberg, barely scratching the surface of what was truly out there waiting to be discovered.
Ul’morethcontinued calmly as they walked deeper into the ancient forest, his teaching focus returning.

|Now, Little Anomaly, you have successfully spoken your first Phoneme of The First Tongue, which is a genuinely remarkable achievement,| he began with voice carrying both praise and expectation. |But speaking it once, even successfully, does not constitute mastery. You are currently at the Novice Speaker level, which means you can produce the Phoneme with basic accuracy. To advance to Fluent Speaker and eventually Perfect Speaker, you need to repeat it constantly until the structure becomes as natural to you as breathing.|
His obsidian gold hair flowed as diagrams began forming around them in the air, showing intricate patterns of energy flow and linguistic structure.

|However, here is where most entities who attempt to learn The First Tongue make a critical mistake that severely limits their progression. They believe they need to speak The First Tongue again and again externally, producing the effect over and over in the physical world to build proficiency. And yes, this does work to a degree. But it is extraordinarily exhaustive on your existence in ways that are not immediately obvious.|

|When you speak a Phoneme outward, you are not merely releasing your own Authority. You are creating a linguistic bridge between your internal existence and all the surrounding Principles of Existence that respond to that utterance. You are essentially opening yourself as a conduit, allowing existential forces to flow through you to manifest the effect.|

|Each time you do this, you are forming and then dissolving that bridge, opening and closing that conduit. Your existence must maintain structural integrity while these tremendous forces pass through it. The Phoneme draws upon Grand Principles, Singularity Principles, even Genesis Principles depending on your mastery level. And when you can eventually connect multiple Phonemes to utter Logos, yes yes, I see your interest in Logos, I will tell you about them in a bit. But all of that accumulated weight flows through your being to manifest externally.|
His presence intensified with technical explanation as the diagrams showed the strain on a body channeling such forces.

|Think of it like this. Your existence is a vessel, and speaking The First Tongue externally is like repeatedly forcing an ocean through a cup. Yes, the cup can channel the ocean’s power for that moment, but the strain of containing and directing such force, over and over, will eventually crack even the strongest vessel. Your Civilizational Authority reserves can deplete. Your structural integrity weakens. Your capacity to maintain the linguistic bridge diminishes with each repetition until you must rest and recover.|

|This is why entities who learn The First Tongue through conventional external practice require years or even decades to master a single Phoneme. They must speak it many times, rest for extended periods, speak it again, rest again. The cycle becomes painfully slow.|
The diagrams shifted dramatically to show a completely different approach, depicting internal pathways within a body with remarkable anatomical detail.

|But there is a trick, Little Anomaly, one that many who attempt to learn The First Tongue do not know or do not understand how to implement properly. The secret to rapid mastery without exhausting your existence is to practice the Phoneme internally rather than externally. To speak The First Tongue within your own existence instead of projecting it outward into reality.|

|What I mean by this is technical and requires deep understanding of your own physiological foundation and existential structure. Foundation, foundation, foundation! I say it three times because it is absolutely critical to everything. When you form a thought, Little Anomaly, how does that thought actually manifest within your being? It passes through neural pathways, through synapses firing in specific sequences, through electrochemical signals cascading through your nervous system. Your cells communicate with each other through these pathways to create consciousness, awareness, intentionality.|

|A strong foundation has infinitely stronger and more intricate pathways for processing such information. Now, what if instead of passing normal thoughts through these pathways, you passed the structured power of The First Tongue itself? What if, when you thought about fire, you actually structured that thought as the complete Phoneme of Fire, with all its proper frequency rises, compressions, accents, and expansions?|
His voice carried the weight of profound technique being shared.

|When you utter the Phoneme of Fire internally in this manner, the fire itself will course through all of your nerves, synapses, cells, organs, tissues, every single component of your physiological and existential structure. The linguistic pattern will propagate through your entire being like a thought propagates, following the natural pathways that already exist within you for processing information and forming awareness.|

|But unlike a normal thought, this is The First Tongue being spoken. So as the Phoneme of Fire courses through your nervous system, it is not merely an abstract idea of fire. It is Fire itself at a conceptual level, the platonic ideal of combustion and transformation, flowing through your internal structure.|
The diagrams showed intricate pathways lighting up with flame that did not burn destructively but instead strengthened and refined.

|Your nerves will learn the pattern of Fire through constant exposure. Your synapses will adapt to transmit the concept of Fire with increasing efficiency. Your cells will integrate the principle of Fire into their fundamental operation. Every organ system in your body will gradually align itself with the Phoneme you are internally practicing. And by extension, align you with The First Tongue even if you have differentiated and specialized|

|And here is the magnificent part, Little Anomaly. This process actually elevates your entire existence as you do it. Your Way, you body, your mind, your spirit, all of it becomes more refined, more complex, more capable of handling sophisticated concepts. You are not exhausting yourself through this internal practice. You are strengthening yourself, training every component of your being to understand and embody The First Tongue.|

|You master Phonemes exponentially faster through this method because you can practice continuously without rest. There is no external manifestation draining your reserves. There is no existential bridge exhausting your structural integrity. You are simply thinking in The First Tongue, allowing the linguistic patterns to flow through pathways that are designed to carry information.|
Ul’moreth’s tone became distinctly more cautionary as the diagrams shifted to show potential catastrophic failures.

|Of course, there is a critical requirement for this technique to work safely, Little Anomaly. You must be proficient enough in the Phoneme to not speak it incorrectly within your own existence. Because if you make an error, if you mispronounce the internal utterance or corrupt the grammatical structure, you will not be scorching the external environment. You will be scorching your entire existence from the inside out.|

|Imagine speaking the Phoneme of Fire incorrectly while it courses through your nervous system. Your nerves would burn away to nothing. Your synapses would combust completely. Your cells would immolate from within. There would be no external manifestation to warn you of the error before catastrophic damage occurred. Just immediate internal devastation as The First Tongue, even imperfectly spoken, draws upon surrounding Principles and channels that power directly through your physiology.|

|This is why I emphasize that you must already be able to speak the Phoneme correctly at least once before attempting internal practice. You need that baseline competency, that Novice Speaker level of mastery, to ensure you understand the proper structure well enough to avoid lethal mistakes.|
The diagrams showed both successful internal practice and the horrifying consequences of failure side by side in stark contrast.

|But assuming you maintain proper pronunciation and structure, Little Anomaly, internal practice is the fastest and most effective method for advancing your mastery of The First Tongue. You can practice the Phoneme of Fire constantly, every moment of every day, letting it flow through your thoughts and your physiological processes until speaking it becomes as natural as your heartbeat. Your foundation will become grander and grander with each passing moment.|

|Your nervous system will memorize the pattern with perfect fidelity. Your cells will integrate the principle into their operation. Your entire existence will align itself with the Phoneme until you can speak it externally with Fluent mastery, drawing upon Singularity Principles without conscious effort. And eventually, with enough internal practice, you will achieve Perfect Speaker status, where even Genesis Principles respond to your pronunciation.|

|This is how we Ginnu Lifeforms mastered The First Tongue despite our malformed bodies, Little Anomaly. We practiced internally, letting the Phonemes course through our unusual physiology, allowing our strange anatomies to adapt and integrate the linguistic patterns. Our malformations actually became advantages because our bodies were already accustomed to processing existence in unconventional ways.|

|So practice the Phoneme of Fire internally, Little Anomaly. Let it flow through every nerve, every synapse, every cell. Let your entire existence learn to speak The First Tongue from the inside out. And when you are ready to speak externally again, you will find your mastery has advanced far beyond what conventional practice could have achieved in the same timeframe.|
His presence radiated satisfaction at sharing such valuable technique.

|This is the secret that separates those who spend decades learning a single Phoneme from those who master them in mere years or even months. Internal practice, continuous and exhaustion-free, allowing your physiology itself to become fluent in existence’s native language.|
A small trick was given by Ul’moreth.
A small trick that changed everything.
With it, one could reinforce their existence continuously while dangerously allowing them to forge an ever deeper foundation.
Noah’s eyes squinted with intense contemplation as he thought about this revelation with shining focus.
Here he was, thinking he had already finished building his foundation adequately. That he had reached some plateau where foundational work was complete.
Was that actually a laughable thought?

If he did not catastrophically fail in the future and he achievedTHE Fundamental Depthor even higher, would he not still be thinking about forging an unmatched quintessential foundation? Would the work of building and refining ever truly be complete?
The answer seemed obvious now.
Foundation was not something you finished.
It was something you continuously reinforced and expanded for your entire existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 4584: Is A Foundation Ever Complete? II
paragraphs: A foundation was never finished.
This statement alone seemed ridiculous on its surface, but why the hell not?
As they continued to move deeper into this vast shore through forests of impossible scale, Noah looked toward the figure of Ul’moreth with eyes shining with determination.
|I will give what you said a try,|he said with a voice carrying conviction.
Ul’morethnodded with approval and replied calmly.
|Go ahead, Little Anomaly. I will try not to overwhelm you with too many bundles of information all at once. It is good to put into practice what you learn before the knowledge fades |
The entity shone with obsidian gold light as his vibrant and thick hair pulsed with concentrated authority.
Noah smiled as he closed his eyes while continuing to move forward through the ancient landscape, trusting his enhanced perception to guide his steps.

He thought of the Phoneme of Fire and its activation sequence. But instead of allowing it to manifest externally as he had done before, he would have that terrifying fire actually course within his own existence. He would have The First Tongue bathe and scorch his nerves, synapses, cells, organs, tissues, every single component of his physiological and existential structure.
He did not even take a moment to consider whether he might accidentally burn himself or cause catastrophic internal damage.
He simply proceeded to do it with absolute confidence.
Who the fuck was he to have any hesitation, doubt, or fear about his own capabilities?
HUUM!
The Phoneme began.
Rising frequency. Compression. Accent. Expansion.

He spoke The First Tongue internally with the same structural precision he had used for external manifestation, and immediately felt the response as terrifying blue gold flames ignited within his existence.

These were not normal flames confined to physical space. They were Fire itself at a conceptual level, empowered by multiple foreign fire based Principles that existed throughout Ginnungagap and beyond. Even a Singularity Principle responded faintly to his internal utterance, lending its incomparable weight to the manifestation.
The flames began their journey through his body with systematic precision.

First, they flowed through his cardiovascular system. His heart became a furnace of blue gold fire, each chamber burning with concentrated intensity as the flames coursed through arteries and veins. The blood itself carried Fire through every capillary, delivering the conceptual flame of The First Tongue to every tissue.

Then his respiratory system. Lungs filled with flames that did not consume oxygen but instead burned with the principle of transformation itself. Each alveolus became a tiny inferno, exchanging Fire of The First Tongue with his bloodstream.

His digestive system next. Esophagus, stomach, intestines, all bathed in blue gold flames of The First Tongue that refined rather than destroyed. The organs responsible for processing matter were now processing the concept of Fire itself.

His nervous system lit up like a network of burning pathways. The brain, that magnificent center of consciousness, became illuminated with such intensity that his entire head shone with radiant light visible even through closed eyes. Each neuron fired with flames of The First Tongue instead of electrical impulses! Each synapse transmitted Fire across its gap. The spinal cord became a pillar of blue gold combustion!
As he felt all of this, he had to affirm that truly, Mana did not directly equate to The First Tongue!
The First Tongue and Mana were one and the same, and yet at the same time not as The First Tongue truly felt like Mana...but how it was always meant to be.
It was glorious.
The First Tongue continued to course across him.

His muscular system. Every muscle fiber, from the largest in his legs to the smallest in his eyes, contracted and relaxed with flames flowing through them. The Fire of The First Tongue refined the proteins, elevated the cellular structure, made everything more efficient and capable.

His skeletal system. Bones that formed the framework of his body became infused with Fire of The First Tongue at a fundamental level. Even the bone marrow, where blood cells were produced, burned with blue gold intensity as it created new cells already marked by The First Tongue!
Oh!
His endocrine system. Glands throughout his body released hormones that carried Fire with them, spreading the influence of The First Tongue to every regulatory system.
His lymphatic and immune systems. The very defenders of his body learned to recognize and embody Fire of The First Tongue, integrating the principle into their operation.
Then the flames went deeper, flowing from the largest components toward the microscopic.

Tissues broke down into individual cells. Trillions of cells throughout his body, each one containing its own universe of complexity, became bathed in blue gold flames. Cell membranes, cytoplasm, organelles, the nucleus containing his genetic information, all refined by The First Tongue!

Even deeper. The flames reached the molecular level. Proteins, lipids, carbohydrates, nucleic acids,all the fundamental molecules of life were touched by The First Tongue and elevated beyond their previous state.

Deeper still.Individual atoms that comprised those molecules felt the passage of The First Tongue. Electrons orbiting nuclei carried the blue gold flames with them. Protons and neutrons at the atomic core resonated with the principle of transformation.
And once the flames of The First Tongue had burned around all cells and atoms throughout his entire body, they flowed toward a final location with purposeful direction.
THE Organ of Civilization.

The surrounding area where his brain was located felt completely aflame as his entire head shone with radiant light that would have been blinding to outside observers. But all the distributed flames throughout his body began flowing systematically toward this single point.
They converged on THE Organ with concentrated intensity.

The flames coursed across the Parenchyma, that functional tissue responsible for processing civilizational complexity. Every component of this extraordinary structure was bathed by The First Tongue and refined to a higher state of existence.
The Desmoterion glowed brilliantly and became reinforced!
The entire Organ became ever so brilliant, shining from within with blue gold radiance as it integrated the principle of Fire into its very foundation.
The Phoneme of Fire, which could scorch a Pre-THE when called out by him, pulsed one final time throughout his entire existence before the flames began to fade gradually.

Noah felt his entire existence operating at a level that could only be described as terrifying and glorious simultaneously. Everything had been switched to overdrive. He felt more alive than he had ever felt before in any previous moment of his existence.
In fire, one truly felt alive!
One needed to burn themselves to really experience what being alive meant!
Well...

He breathed out slowly as he acclimated his mind from the intensely euphoric sensation flooding through him. He may have gone slightly overboard in proclaiming that one needed to burn themselves to feel alive.
BOOM!
His eyes opened as the internal utterance of The First Tongue completed its first full cycle.

His skin gave off a faint blue gold glow as if his entire body had just undergone its first refinement in a master blacksmith’s workshop. His existence felt even more immense, denser, more real than it had been mere moments before.
New prompts materialized before his vision with critical information.
|Your existence, foundation, and very being has begun systematic refinement with the most ancient and true form of Mana.|
|The First Tongue is now being integrated into the fundamental structure of your cultivation.|
|All components of your Civilization are being reinforced and elevated.|
|Walls of Civilization: Structural integrity increased, conceptual density elevated|
|Sovereign Spires of Osmont: Authority output enhanced, range expanded, Your Early Atlas of the Folds, Your Principles...all weavings of your Civilization are being refined.|
|THE Organ of Civilization has entered an Exponential Growth Phase|
|Foundation refinement with The First Tongue has triggered exponential development acceleration.|
|Immensity and weight of Organ foundation has increased dramatically.|
|Previous development metrics no longer accurately represent true capability.|
|RECALIBRATION REQUIRED|
|DEVELOPMENT PERCENTAGE RECALIBRATED|
|Previous Development: 23%|
|Recalibrated Development: 15%|
|NDespite lower percentage, current capabilities exceed what 30% development would have represented prior to foundation refinement.|

|The potential scope ofTHE Organ of Civilizationhas expanded dramatically through First Tongue integration. The foundation is now being built to support capabilities far beyond initial projections. What was previously estimated as 100% completion is now recognized as only a fraction of true potential. Current 15% represents a more capable state than previous 30%, but there is exponentially more room for growth.|
|THE Organ of Civilization is no longer being built to standard specifications.|
|THE Organ of Civilization is now being forged to speak existence’s native language.|
|Estimated final capability upon completion: INCALCULABLE|
WAA!
Noah observed these prompts with eyes shining with profound understanding and satisfaction.
He could feel the exuberance of his existence, the way every component of his being was now operating at a fundamentally higher level.
Sure, he would use The First Tongue to continuously refine himself. Sure, his foundation was nowhere near done, would perhaps never be done.
After all, if he began learning more Phonemes and eventually the unexplained Logos of The First Tongue, if he continued to reinforce his already obscene foundation with existence’s native language...
Would he be able to potentially do something as utterly obscene as wielding power equivalent toTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntywithout even reaching that classification himself?
The thought burned in his mind with the same intensity as the flames that had just refined his body.
He looked towardUl’morethwith gratitude and hunger for more knowledge mixing in his expression.
The ancient being was watching him with what felt like satisfaction beneath all that obscuring hair.

|You adapt quickly, Little Anomaly,| Ul’morethsaid with voice carrying approval. |Most entities require multiple attempts before they can complete even one full internal cycle without error. You did it perfectly on your first try. Perhaps your Way truly does make you compatible with The First Tongue in ways others cannot match.|
They continued walking deeper into the ancient forest as Noah began his second internal utterance of the Phoneme of Fire.
His foundation would never be finished. Not truly. Not ever.
And that was exactly how it should be!

chapters.title: Chapter 4585: A Dissolution I
paragraphs: In the Primordial Genesis Shore, as Noah’s existence continued to shine with luminescent blue gold glow internally which even reflected outwardly through his skin, he looked at Ul’moreth with a radiant gaze filled with hunger for more knowledge.

Ul’moreth perceived this intensity and shook his head with what felt like an amused smile, though of course his entire form remained covered with thick hair all over as Noah was simply perceiving the emotion through other means.
The ancient entity gazed at him and spoke with knowing tone.

|I can feel your impatience radiating from you, Little Anomaly. It is quite remarkable that you are already capable of uttering the Phoneme of Fire internally without having to hold all your focus exclusively on it. You are processing it as background activity while maintaining full awareness of your surroundings. But right now you already want to ask for more, yes? Very well. Okay!|
They stopped walking at a small clearing between the impossibly tall trees.
Ul’moreth raised a hairy hand and motioned upward with casual gesture. A stick fell down from one of the towering trees above, landing perfectly in his grasp.
In the clearing surrounded by radiant trees filled with different types of civilizational authority, Ul’moreth began to use the stick to draw on the ground below with deliberate strokes.

|While there are countless variations and permutations of Phonemes throughout existence, while entities across all eras have developed specialized expressions and dialectical modifications, there are actually just eighteen Core Phonemes that can be considered the true alphabet of existence itself, The Letters of The First Tongue|he began while sketching the first symbol in the dirt.

|From these eighteen fundamental letters, each one can produce eighty-one distinct variations. Fire, when written and expressed with slight modifications, can also stand for concepts like Persevere, Scorch, Purify, Consume, Ignite, and many others. These are tiny variations to the one Core Phoneme. In the end, you should be able to decipher all variations on your own once you understand the foundational structure, but the fundamental Phoneme of Fire will remain the same at its core.|
He drew more elaborate patterns as he continued.

|From the Phoneme of Fire alone, when mixed with other Phonemes...forms into larger structures we call Logos, words. But thats for later on. Fire can become Wildfire. It can become Soulfire, Coldfire, Voidfire. Each one is a different expression built upon the same foundational letter.|

|But Fire is merely one letter in the alphabet of Existence. Let me introduce you to the others, Little Anomaly, so you understand the complete linguistic framework you are learning to speak. And remember, all of these are merely the most accurate translation of The First Tongue. |
He drew a flowing symbol next to the angular one representing Fire.

|The second Core Phoneme is Water. It is the principle of flow, adaptability, persistence. These concepts of flow and adaptation are also variant Phonemes derived from the core Water. This Phoneme represents the concept of that which takes the shape of its container yet possesses its own inherent nature. Water embodies change without loss of self, transformation without destruction of identity.|
Another symbol took shape, solid and geometric.

|The third is Earth. Stability, foundation, endurance, the principle of that which remains when all else has passed. Earth is the concept of fundamental persistence, the bedrock upon which all other things are built. It represents materiality itself, the idea that things can be solid and real and permanent.|
A swirling, almost invisible mark appeared.

|The fourth Core Phoneme is Air. Movement, freedom, distribution, the principle of that which cannot be grasped but touches everything. Air represents the concept of pervasiveness without substance, influence without direct contact, the idea that some things affect all things without being seen or held.|
He drew what looked like an empty circle, yet somehow it felt full of potential.

|The fifth is Void. Not absence as many misunderstand, but rather the principle of potential, the space between things that allows them to exist separately. Void is what separates one thing from another, what makes distinction possible. Without Void, all would be compressed into undifferentiated unity. It represents the concept of possibility itself, the canvas upon which existence paints.|
A radiating symbol burst forth on the ground.

|The sixth Core Phoneme is Light. The electromagnetic radiation, the principle of revelation, clarity, the concept of that which makes other things visible and knowable. Light represents awareness, consciousness, the idea that things can be perceived and understood. It is the principle of illumination at all levels, from physical sight to intellectual comprehension.|
Next to it, he drew what seemed to absorb the surrounding brightness.

|The seventh is Darkness. Not absence of light, but rather the principle of mystery, hiddenness, the concept of that which remains unknown and unknowable. Darkness represents the limits of perception and understanding, the acknowledgment that some things exist beyond awareness. It is potential unrevealed, secrets maintained.|
An organic, growing pattern emerged.

|The eighth Core Phoneme is Life. Animation, growth, evolution, the principle of that which organizes itself into increasing complexity. Life is not merely biological processes but the concept of emergent order, the idea that complexity can arise from simplicity and perpetuate itself through time. It is the principle of organization resisting entropy.|
Beside it, a symbol suggesting finality and release.

|The ninth is Death. Cessation, ending, transformation through destruction, the principle of that which returns complexity to simplicity. Death is necessary, the concept that all organized things must eventually dissolve so their components can be reorganized. It represents the cycle of renewal through dissolution, the clearing of space for new creation.|
He drew an arrow pointing forward, then another, creating a sense of progression.

|The tenth Core Phoneme is Time. Sequence, causality, the arrow of cause and effect, the principle of that which ensures one thing follows another rather than all things occurring simultaneously. Time represents the concept of narrative itself, the idea that existence has a story rather than being a static tableau frozen in one moment.|
Expanding lines radiating outward in all directions.

|The eleventh is Space. Extension, dimension, the principle of distance and position, the concept of that which allows things to be here rather than there. Space represents separation through distance rather than through void, the idea that things can be far from each other rather than merely distinct from each other.|
A perfectly symmetrical pattern of intersecting lines.

|The twelfth Core Phoneme is Order. Pattern, structure, predictability, the principle of that which makes rules and ensures they are followed. Order is consistency, the concept that existence follows patterns rather than being completely random. It represents the idea of natural law itself, the framework within which things operate.|
Chaotic scribbles that somehow formed a coherent whole.

|The thirteenth is Chaos. Unpredictability, randomness, freedom from constraint, the principle of that which breaks patterns and creates novelty. Chaos is the concept of infinite possibility, the idea that existence is not bound by its past patterns. It represents genuine newness, the capacity for things to be different from what came before.|
Interconnected circles forming a unified design.

|The fourteenth Core Phoneme is Unity. Connection, relationship, the principle of that which binds separate things into cohesive wholes. Unity represents the concept that things can be related without losing their individual identity, that wholeness can emerge from diversity without destroying the components that create it.|
A single shape splitting into multiple fragments.

|The fifteenth is Division. Separation, distinction, the principle of that which takes unified things and creates multiplicity. Division is differentiation, the concept that one thing can become many things while retaining some connection to its origin. It represents the creation of diversity from unity, the flowering of possibility.|
A point expanding outward into existence.

|The sixteenth Core Phoneme is Beginning. Origin, initiation, the principle of that which starts processes and brings things into existence. Beginning is temporal and conceptual, the idea that there is a point at which something is not and then is. It represents the transition from nonexistence to existence.|
A convergence of lines into a final point.

|The seventeenth is Ending. Conclusion, completion, the principle of that which finishes processes and removes things from existence. Ending is cessation and fulfillment, the concept that things reach their natural conclusion rather than continuing indefinitely. It represents the transition from existence to nonexistence, the moment when something has completed its purpose.|
Finally, he drew a symbol that seemed to contradict itself, existing and not existing simultaneously.

|And the eighteenth and final Core Phoneme, Little Anomaly, is Paradox. Contradiction, impossibility, the principle of that which violates logic yet exists nonetheless. Paradox represents the concept that reality is not bound by consistency, that things can be and not be simultaneously, that existence itself contains contradictions that cannot be resolved. It is perhaps the most dangerous and the most powerful of all Core Phonemes because it undermines the very framework within which the others operate.|
Eighteen!
18 glorious letters glowed on the ground before him as each one felt grander than the last, but this...wasThe First Tongue.

He drew an arrow pointing forward, then another, creating a sense of progression.
|The tenth Core Phoneme is Time.
Sequence, causality, the arrow of cause and effect, the principle of that which ensures one thing follows another rather than all things occurring simultaneously.
Time represents the concept of narrative itself, the idea that existence has a story rather than being a static tableau frozen in one moment.|
Expanding lines radiating outward in all directions.
|The eleventh is Space.
Extension, dimension, the principle of distance and position, the concept of that which allows things to be here rather than there.
Space represents separation through distance rather than through void, the idea that things can be far from each other rather than merely distinct from each other.|
A perfectly symmetrical pattern of intersecting lines.
|The twelfth Core Phoneme is Order.
Pattern, structure, predictability, the principle of that which makes rules and ensures they are followed.
Order is consistency, the concept that existence follows patterns rather than being completely random.
It represents the idea of natural law itself, the framework within which things operate.|
Chaotic scribbles that somehow formed a coherent whole.
|The thirteenth is Chaos.
Unpredictability, randomness, freedom from constraint, the principle of that which breaks patterns and creates novelty.
Chaos is the concept of infinite possibility, the idea that existence is not bound by its past patterns.
It represents genuine newness, the capacity for things to be different from what came before.|
Interconnected circles forming a unified design.
|The fourteenth Core Phoneme is Unity.
Connection, relationship, the principle of that which binds separate things into cohesive wholes.
Unity represents the concept that things can be related without losing their individual identity, that wholeness can emerge from diversity without destroying the components that create it.|
A single shape splitting into multiple fragments.
|The fifteenth is Division.
Separation, distinction, the principle of that which takes unified things and creates multiplicity.
Division is differentiation, the concept that one thing can become many things while retaining some connection to its origin.
It represents the creation of diversity from unity, the flowering of possibility.|
A point expanding outward into existence.
|The sixteenth Core Phoneme is Beginning.
Origin, initiation, the principle of that which starts processes and brings things into existence.
Beginning is temporal and conceptual, the idea that there is a point at which something is not and then is.
It represents the transition from nonexistence to existence.|
A convergence of lines into a final point.
|The seventeenth is Ending.
Conclusion, completion, the principle of that which finishes processes and removes things from existence.
Ending is cessation and fulfillment, the concept that things reach their natural conclusion rather than continuing indefinitely.
It represents the transition from existence to nonexistence, the moment when something has completed its purpose.|
Finally, he drew a symbol that seemed to contradict itself, existing and not existing simultaneously.
|And the eighteenth and final Core Phoneme, Little Anomaly, is Paradox.
Contradiction, impossibility, the principle of that which violates logic yet exists nonetheless.
Paradox represents the concept that reality is not bound by consistency, that things can be and not be simultaneously, that existence itself contains contradictions that cannot be resolved.
It is perhaps the most dangerous and the most powerful of all Core Phonemes because it undermines the very framework within which the others operate.|
Eighteen!
18 glorious letters glowed on the ground before him as each one felt grander than the last, but this...wasThe First Tongue.

chapters.title: Chapter 4586: A Dissolution II
paragraphs: He stepped back from his diagram, the eighteen symbols arranged in a circular pattern on the ground.

|These eighteen Core Phonemes comprise the complete alphabet of existence, Little Anomaly. Everything that exists, every concept that can be conceived, every phenomenon that can occur, all of it can be expressed through combinations and permutations of these eighteen fundamental letters. They are the building blocks of reality itself, the linguistic units from which all of existence is constructed.|

|Now, if you can master all eighteen of these Core Phonemes and practice them internally as I have taught you with Fire, allowing each one to course through your existence and continuously fortify and refine your foundation, your very being will become something extraordinary. Your foundation will be reinforced at such a fundamental level that you should be able to handle direct confrontation with a THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity without being immediately collapsed.|

|I emphasize should, Little Anomaly, because there are always variables in combat, always circumstances that can shift outcomes unpredictably. But purely in terms of foundational stability and existential density, mastering all eighteen Core Phonemes internally will elevate you to a level where THE Surface Depth entities cannot simply erase you through overwhelming power differential. You will have built yourself into something that can withstand their authority.|

|I introduced the Phoneme of Fire individually to you with extensive explanation because it was your first, because you needed to understand every component and principle in detail. But the others, well, I have practiced them myself countless times across the eons. I will simply infuse you with the knowledge of scenes from my past where I performed each one, allowing you to observe the proper structure and execution directly rather than requiring me to explain each one in tedious detail.|

|I can see you are somewhat impatient despite your politeness, and my droning of words is likely getting to you even though you genuinely value the knowledge I am sharing. So this method will be considerably quicker and more efficient for both of us. Here, Little Anomaly, are all the remaining seventeen Core Phonemes in their totality.|
Ul’moreth’s obsidian gold hair suddenly extended toward Noah with purposeful motion, moving with precision that suggested each strand knew exactly what it was doing.

The ancient being tapped the air seventeen times in rapid succession, each tap creating a unique bubble filled with vibrant characters that seemed to pulse with concentrated authority and compressed knowledge.

The bubbles floated toward Noah’s mind like soap bubbles carrying entire universes within them, each one containing the complete knowledge of how to properly speak one of the Core Phonemes of The First Tongue.
Water. Earth. Air. Void. Light. Darkness. Life. Death. Time. Space. Order. Chaos. Unity. Division. Beginning. Ending. Paradox.
All seventeen remaining letters of existence’s alphabet flowed into his consciousness simultaneously, each one distinct yet harmoniously integrated with the others.
Noah’s eyes blazed with blue gold intensity as his mind processed the sudden influx of foundational knowledge, his existence already beginning to resonate with all eighteen Core Phonemes at once.
The alphabet of reality itself now resided within him!
Oh!
Noah held many different weavings of power over the years he had cultivated and advanced.
Each one felt uniquely distinct and different from the others, carrying its own flavor of authority. But they all felt a certain way, all operated within similar frameworks and limitations.
The First Tongue felt extremely different from everything else he had experienced.
Which was uniquely fascinating because that which he held an infinite amount of, pure Mana itself, was exactly what The First Tongue represented.

And now as he received seventeen bundles of compressed knowledge that held the rises, compressions, accents, and expansions of seventeen Phonemes of The First Tongue, he felt a truly profound sensation of this power coursing through his awareness.
It felt as if he had received a master key that could unlock infinite doors throughout existence.

Eighteen total letters of The First Tongue. Eighteen fundamental components of the language of existence itself. And each one held its own variations, eighty-one distinct expressions that could be derived from a single foundational letter.

But since that one core letter comprised all of those variations within its essence, for his purposes of reinforcing and fortifying his foundation, regardless which of the eighty-one variations of a single Phoneme he used, the effect on his existence would ultimately be the same.
So he only needed to focus on the eighteen Core Phonemes and slowly study how slight changes in pronunciation and structure could cause their variations to manifest afterward.

So now, since he had already gone through three complete cycles of uttering The Phoneme of Fire across his existence and felt comfortable with its structure, he wanted to put into practice the other seventeen letters he had just received and do the same with all of them.
New prompts materialized before his vision with critical information.
|Unfathomably Critical Knowledge Obtained|
|The records and complete methodology of the Eighteen Core Phonemes of The First Tongue have been successfully integrated.|

|The rises, compressions, accents, and expansions of the newly gained seventeen Phonemes have been replayed one million times across the synapses of your existence exactly as Ul’moreth has performed them in the obtained knowledge.|
|Each sequence has been memorized at the cellular level.|
|Neural pathways have been prepared for internal practice.|
|Foundation reinforcement protocols standing by for activation.|
His existence worked with terrifying speed and efficiency.

He had replayed the knowledge thatTHE Primeval Titangave him again and again within the span of moments, his enhanced processing capabilities allowing him to absorb eons of accumulated wisdom in seconds.
At this moment, Ul’moreth spoke with voice carrying sagely advice.

|Take your time with the rest of the letters of The First Tongue, Little Anomaly. After you confirm that you can externally utter each one successfully and safely, you can begin to fortify your existence internally with them. There is no rush. Mastery requires patience and careful progression.|
Such words of wisdom echoed out from Ul’moreth with genuine concern for Noah’s wellbeing.
And yet, Noah felt his existence buzzing with barely contained energy. The wild sense of tyranny inside of him began to vibrate alongside his Quintessence with absolute confidence!

Even if he did not utilize the newly learned Phonemes of The First Tongue externally first like he had done with Fire, as he examined them and processed the bundles of information thatTHE Primeval Titanhad given him, he felt an undeniable sense of certainty that he would not get any sequence of their activation wrong!
