chapters.title: Chapter 4587: A Dissolution III
paragraphs: The knowledge had integrated too perfectly. His existence understood these letters at a fundamental level.
So he looked directly at the primeval titan and smiled with an expression mixing gratitude and determination.
|Let me surprise you just a little bit,| he said with a voice carrying quiet confidence.
The moment he spoke such words,THE Primeval Titaninstantly understood what Noah was about to attempt.

The eyes of this hairy being shone with terrifying obsidian gold light as comprehension dawned. He did not offer any additional guidance or warning after he saw the absolute light of confidence blazing in Noah’s eyes.
Sometimes, a teacher knew when to simply watch and allow a student to prove themselves.
Noah closed his eyes and began.
Fire.
The first Phoneme activated internally with familiar comfort, blue gold flames coursing through every nerve, synapse, cell, and organ before converging inTHE Organ of Civilization.
Water.

The second Phoneme flowed like liquid silver blue through his existence, following the same pathways as Fire but with completely different character. It adapted to every structure it encountered, flowing and persistent.
Earth.
Solid bronze radiance reinforced his entire being, providing stability and endurance. His bones felt denser, his foundation more unshakable.
Air.
Pale green light scattered through his body like wind through leaves, touching everything without grasping, pervasive and free.
Void.
Deep obsidian darkness that was potential opened spaces within his existence he had not known could exist, making room for further growth.
Light.
Brilliant white gold illumination revealed every component of his being to itself, creating awareness and clarity throughout his entire structure.
Darkness.
Shadowy indigo concealment balanced the Light, preserving mystery and maintaining the unknown aspects of his existence.
Life.
Vibrant emerald energy pulsed through him with organic rhythm, encouraging growth and increasing complexity in all his systems.
Death.
Somber gray force followed Life, not destroying but rather preparing for renewal, clearing space for transformation.
Time.
Crystalline purple waves established proper sequence and causality within his existence, ensuring all processes occurred in correct order.
Space.
Shimmering stellar azure created proper distance and dimension within his being, allowing different aspects to exist in their own territories.
Order.
Geometric white platinum patterns established consistency and structure, creating frameworks for all other Phonemes to operate within.
Chaos.
Prismatic explosions of randomness broke patterns strategically, ensuring his existence remained capable of genuine novelty.
Unity.
Golden threads connected every disparate part of his being into harmonious whole without destroying individual identity.
Division.
Silver fractures created necessary separation and distinction, allowing complexity to emerge from unified simplicity.
Beginning.
Bright yellow dawn energy initiated new processes throughout his existence, creating fresh potential everywhere it touched.
Ending.
Deep violet dusk force concluded old patterns gracefully, allowing them to reach fulfillment before dissolution.
Paradox.

Finally, the eighteenth and most dangerous Phoneme. Reality-breaking crimson and black energy that violated logic yet existed perfectly within him, allowing contradictions to coexist without resolution!

His figure shone with multicolored radiance as all eighteen Phonemes activated simultaneously within his existence. The flow of each one briefly coursed across every component of his being in sequence, creating a symphony of power!
Then they all converged inTHE Organ of Civilizationas their final destination.
The moment all eighteen Core Phonemes activated and fortified his existence simultaneously, something fundamental shifted.
BOOM!
New prompts erupted before his vision with reality-altering significance.
|Foundation Evolution Achieved|
|You have begun forging THE Foundation of The First Tongue.|
|This is a foundation that has no predetermined end or completion point.|
|Your own existence will be the sole decider of when this Foundation reaches a state you consider complete.|
|This Foundation can be continuously reinforced indefinitely.|
|Every single aspect of your Civilization will rise in direct proportion to the development ofTHE Organ of Civilization and THE Foundation of The First Tongue|
|All Walls, Spires, Principles, Authorities, everything will scale with Foundation growth.|
Noah felt a terrifying sensation flooding through his existence that had been fortified by all eighteen Phonemes of The First Tongue coursing through him.
He could not fully explain what he was experiencing with words. He just felt unfathomably immense, as if his mere presence carried weight that could reshape reality around him.
In the next moment, his heart beat in a way it had never beaten before.
Not just a physical contraction of cardiac muscle, but something far more profound. A pulse that resonated through every layer of his existence simultaneously.
A new prompt bloomed before his vision immediately after that unprecedented heartbeat.
|Lineage Emergence Initiated|
|Purified by The First Tongue, your heart has initiated the emergence of your own unique lineage that does not stem from the source of another.|
|The Distinction of The Early Creature, Osmont is being systematically broken down and undergoing Dissolution.|
|Your heart seeks the emergence of your lineage directly from The First Tongue itself.|
Noah’s eyes opened slowly, blazing with multicolored radiance that reflected all eighteen Phonemes burning within him.
Ul’moreth stood before him in absolute silence, his obsidian gold light pulsing with what could only be described as profound shock mixed with satisfaction!
Oh!
The progression was a heavy one to contemplate.
Early Creature.
A lineage many feared and looked up to from The Earliest Folds that came after The Infinite Unfurling. A distinction of tremendous power and authority.
And something stemming directly fromTHE Creaturehimself.

It had been something grand to possess because none of those who might have contested his claim were in existence when Noah obtained it, apart from those entities on the other side of the veil who were entirely Dead.

The power that had come with The Early Creature lineage was genuinely magnificent. The methodologies of the early creatures, the Glyphs they relied on for their techniques, the Astral Arcana Codexes containing concentrated knowledge, Haki as a manifestation of willpower, and the Early Veiled Shores as domains of power were all things of utter wonder to have inherited.
He had taken many things from what represented an early creature and elevated them beyond their original forms through his own innovations and advancements.

But at the end of the day, even if he was The Early Creature in name while simultaneously not being an actual early creature, he was still fundamentally taking from the musings and weavings of THE Creature himself.
One of the terrifying existences that was actively seeking to impose their power and vision across all of Existence.

When Noah thought about this being, and even aboutTHE Living Paradox or THE Secretive Eon or THE Primordial Chaos, he could not help but wonder just how terrifyingly advanced they were in their mastery of The First Tongue.

How much they had refined their existences with not just the eighteen letters that he had only now learned, but with complete words constructed from those letters and perhaps even full sentences formed from complex grammatical structures, all practiced and perfected over countless millions of years.
The thought alone of the accumulated power such beings possessed might have been enough to make lesser minds tremble with despair at the impossible gap.
But for him? It was merely a challenge to overcome!
Because none of them, not evenTHE Creaturehimself, had The First Tongue itself as their fundamental Way of Existence.
They used it as a tool, however masterfully. He was becoming it!

chapters.title: Chapter 4588: You!
paragraphs: As he contemplated this critical distinction, additional prompts bloomed before his vision.
|Unique Existential State Achieved|
|Your existence is operating in a state that defies conventional classification.|
|Your mastery of the Letters of The First Tongue will rise collectively as long as you continue to utter them internally and simultaneously.|
|All eighteen Phonemes will advance together rather than individually.|
|Mastery progression: Unified ascension toward Fluent Speaker status across all Core Phonemes.|
|Complexity and Purity Deviation Detected|
|Your existential metrics are deviating from standard numerical quantifications.|
|Complexity: Previously measurable in Decillions, now becoming UNDEFINED|
|Purity: Previously measurable in Decillions, now becoming UNDEFINED|
|Your existence is transcending conventional measurement frameworks.|
|New classification protocols required for accurate assessment.|
WAA!
All the prompts appearing represented a tremendous amount of fundamental change occurring within him. He was genuinely looking forward to discovering what they would ultimately produce.
He quickly sent his thoughts to Ruination about something grand.
She replied immediately with analytical precision.
|Resource allocation for First Tongue mastery analyzed.|
|Analysis: 75% of your current mental capacity and weavings of Existence are required to successfully continue the internal fortification and reinforcement ofTHE Foundation of The First Tongue.|
|Recommendation: Reserve and automate this process to perpetually continue practicing and gaining mastery in the Phonemes of The First Tongue while simultaneously refining your existence.|
|This will allow 25% capacity for normal awareness and interaction.|
|Shall this configuration be implemented?|
Noah’s eyes shone brilliantly with multicolored radiance as he spoke his decision without hesitation.
|Proceed.|
The moment he gave authorization, his entire existence transformed.

Underneath his skin, throughout every layer of his being, his entire existence began to buzz like a primordial beast awakening from ancient slumber. It felt as if he was growing increasingly dangerous with every passing second, his power escalating continuously.
The immensity and weight he gave off became unfathomably heavy, as if reality itself struggled to contain his presence.
Ul’morethlooked at him while shaking his head with what felt like a mixture of awe and concern.

|Are you able to move and talk normally?|he asked with voice suggesting he knew exactly what Noah was currently doing, as if such a dangerous process should be taking all of Noah’s concentration and existence to ensure nothing catastrophically went wrong.
And yet Noah simply smiled with complete confidence and replied casually.
|It is merely the uttering of a few letters of my Way. It will not take too much of me.|
The hairy figure of Ul’moreth laughed jovially before responding with clear satisfaction.
|What a unique thing you are, Little Anomaly! Alright, we have talked extensively already. Let us move things along a little. Come.|
With such words, Ul’moreth took a single step forward.
Obsidian gold light wrapped around both of them as they instantly traveled a few Gigaparsecs inland across the vast Primordial Genesis Shore.
It was a single step. And yet that single step took them farther distances than all the accumulated steps they had been walking while talking and teaching.
It took them instantly into the internal region of this ancient shore, into the heart of the settlement itself.
The Primordial Genesis Shore revealed its true nature.
Noah’s eyes widened slightly as he observed what could only be described as a thriving Civilization of Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms.

The settlement sprawled across the landscape with organic architecture that seemed grown rather than built. Structures formed from crystallized existence itself rose in impossible angles, their surfaces pulsing with various types of civilizational authority.
Every single Ginnu Lifeform that Noah observed possessed extraordinary power.

Some were entities that had laid claim to a certain level of Sovereignty, similar to the ones he had defeated when he was traveling withTHE First Hunger. Their malformed bodies radiated concentrated authority that warped space around them.
Others held bodies that vibrantly pulsed with the aura of Pre-THE Existence, their power just on the cusp of reaching that first scale of true significance.
And he could feel with absolute confidence that there were a few dozen entities scattered throughout this settlement that held the full distinction of THE Civilizational Authority.
Entities at The First Scale of Existence.THElevel beings.
A few dozen of them, all living together in this single ancient settlement.
The Ginnu Lifeforms were engaged in various activities that portrayed busy and fulfilling lives within this archaic community.
Some were gathered in what appeared to be teaching circles, where knowledge was being shared.
Others were working on what looked like cultivation projects, refining various aspects of Existence.

A marketplace of sorts existed where entities were exchanging resources that ranged from crystallized authority to fragments of Collapsed Ways and Collapsed Hearts of Civilizations to bundles of pure concentrated Mana.
But one of the major focal points that immediately drew Noah’s attention was a massive area that looked specifically designed for combat and testing.
An archaic arena of tremendous scale.

The structure was formed from compressed layers of existence itself, creating walls that could withstand attacks fromTHElevel entities without sustaining damage. The floor was inscribed with countless symbols that Noah now recognized as Phonemes and potentially...Logos of The First Tongue?
Yeah, it should be!
They all went to creating a combat environment that adapted to the fighters within it.
There were already a few hundred Ginnu Lifeforms surrounding the arena, watching an unfolding battle with intense analytical focus.
In the center of the arena, a Ginnu Lifeform with six arms and a serpentine lower body was utterly thrashing another entity that clearly stemmed from outside Ginnungagap.

The foreign entity appeared humanoid but was formed from crystallized time itself, its body flickering between past and future states. It was clearly powerful, likelyTHEexistence of significant capability.

But it was being systematically dismantled by the Ginnu Lifeform, who seemed to be demonstrating various combat applications of The First Tongue while the watching crowd analyzed every movement and technique.
The other Ginnu Lifeforms observed as if they were studying not just the battle itself but the fundamental Ways of Existence being displayed, learning from their companion’s demonstration.
As Noah’s gaze swept across the arena and its surroundings, he noticed something deeply unique near one edge of the combat area.
Cages. Or more accurately, prisons.

When he looked closely at these containment structures, he saw they were formed not from physical materials but from terrifying concentrations of The First Tongue that appeared ordered and structured with sophisticated precision.
They were actually constructed from multiple Phonemes put together to form complete Logos relating specifically to binding, confinement, and suppression.
With such linguistic construction in place, the cages or prisons were shockingly capable of holding entities atTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty!
The words themselves created inescapable reality.
Multiple Pre-THE and even some THE level entities were locked within these prisons, their forms either dormant or struggling futilely against constraints formed from existence’s own language.
While Noah was absorbing all of this information, his attention was suddenly captured by movement near the region of cages.

A Ginnu Lifeform was approaching one of the empty prisons, dragging something behind them with obsidian chains that pulsed with a terrifying Way of Destruction. Deep within those chains, Noah could perceive a glimmer of pure Mana woven into their fundamental structure.
The obsidian chains were binding a captive lifeform that the Ginnu was leading toward imprisonment.
Noah had to blink several times to make absolutely certain he was seeing correctly.
The bound lifeform being led to one of the cages, struggling against chains formed from The First Tongue and wrapped in destructive authority, was none other thanTHE Maelstrom Thundermane.
The very entity who had chased him into Ginnungagap what felt like an eternity ago!
Now reduced to a prisoner, being casually escorted to confinement by a Ginnu Lifeform who seemed utterly unconcerned with the tremendous power their captive theoretically possessed!
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 4589: Misfortune!
paragraphs: Across the infinite expanse of existence, countless entities routinely wished misfortune upon others with remarkable consistency.

Sometimes it stemmed from envy, from seeing another possess what they themselves desired. Sometimes it came from belief that their own misfortune had been caused by that other person, making revenge feel justified. Sometimes it arose simply from petty spite or wounded pride.
So they sat in their heads and wished constantly of misfortune befalling those they resented, imagining elaborate scenarios of downfall and suffering.
What most of these entities failed to realize, in their focus on directing negativity outward, was that more often than not they were actually wishing the same misfortune upon themselves.
Exisrence had a peculiar sense of irony about such things.

Consider, for instance, the cultivator who envied his neighbor’s success in advancing to a higher Realm. He would spend hours each day imagining that neighbor failing catastrophically, perhaps encountering a powerful beast that would cripple his cultivation foundation permanently.
He pictured it in vivid detail. The beast attacking. The neighbor’s techniques failing. The foundation cracking. The permanent damage.

And then, merely weeks later, that same cultivator would encounter a powerful beast in the form of a Young Master himself during his own advancement attempt. His techniques would inexplicably fail at the critical moment. His foundation would crack in precisely the way he had imagined for his neighbor.

He would collapse in confusion, wondering how existence could be so cruel to him specifically, never once connecting the irony that he had spent weeks visualizing and wishing for exactly this scenario to occur.
The misfortune he had wished upon another had somehow manifested for himself instead.
Existence had a way of reflecting intentions back to their source!
THE Maelstrom Thundermanewas at this moment wholly and completely wishing all the misfortune there could possibly be upon the anomaly that he had chased into Ginnungagap.
Because of pursuing that anomaly, he had entered this unique region within The Infinite Unfurling that many entities with any sense actually stayed far away from.

Many knew there were more resources and grander Weavings of Existence available here compared to safer territories. But more often than not, they were simply not worth the risk because of the Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms who called this place home.

One had to be truly powerful at a fundamental level to appear here safely, or they might find themselves either collapsed by these ancient lifeforms or taken captive into their settlements as prisoners or research subjects.
THE Maelstrom Thundermanehad been running around Ginnungagap for less than five minutes before he came across one of these terrifying lifeforms.

The Sovereignty of this particular entity had been so utterly horrid and overwhelming that it actually imposed itself in such a way as to force the other body thatTHE Maelstrom Thundermanehad left outside Ginnungagap, the one guarding their precious treasure, to abandon its post completely.
His divided Existence had been forcibly merged back together, dragged entirely into Ginnungagap against his planning.

So now all of himself was trapped within this chaotic region. And he, an esteemed entity of TheLevel One Civilizational Scale of Existence, a being who had reachedTHEclassification through dedicated advancement, was actually imprisoned here at this very moment.
Bound in chains formed from concepts he barely understood.
For the only solace in his Existence right now was hatred for the one who was responsible for all of this catastrophic chain of events.
He imagined again and again the misfortune that had surely already befallen that anomaly by now.

That anomaly had not even attained the state ofTHEclassification yet. If such a weak entity was moving anywhere within Ginnungagap’s unstable territories, it would likely be unraveled by the instabilities of Existence itself within moments.
The chaotic environment would tear apart anything belowTHEscale.

And with how pathetically weak that anomaly was, once he was inevitably found by Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms, they would likely just devour him immediately for resources and would not even bother to bring him to a settlement as a prisoner.
SoTHE Maelstrom Thundermanesimply wished and imagined that anomaly dying in the most painful way possible.
Being torn apart slowly by the unstable Weavings of Ginnungagap. Screaming in agony as his Existence dissolved. Realizing in his final moments that he had brought this upon himself!
This pleasant fantasy was one of his few consolation prizes for the misfortune that he found himself suffering right now.
But as he was indulging in these bitter thoughts while being dragged toward imprisonment, something caught his attention.
THE Maelstrom Thundermane, who was being forcibly escorted toward one of the cages by a Ginnu Lifeform, happened to see something in the corner of his vision.
He blinked in confusion before turning his head in that direction and looking across the distance.
There, walking calmly near the combat arena, was the figure of the exact anomaly he had been thinking about.
Looking directly back at him.
What?
What the fuck was this?

He had to make absolutely certain it was not an illusion or hallucination. He even asked himself if this was possibly some form of Civilizational Authority from another Malformed Ginnu Lifeform, showing him the worst possible thing that could be playing out right now in Existence as psychological torture.
But unbelievably, impossibly, in the distance stood the anomaly that had set off all of these catastrophic chain of events and caused him to be where he was right now!

Calmly standing beside a terrifyingly powerful hairy Malformed Ginnu Lifeform that had to be at least of THE Intermediate Depth or even THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty based on the oppressive presence radiating from it.
And that anomaly was even looking over towardTHE Maelstrom Thundermanewith an expression of genuine incredulity, as if surprised to see him here.
The two locked eyes across the distance.
Recognition flared between them.
In the next moment,THE Maelstrom Thundermane’sfury erupted with volcanic intensity.
He roared toward the nearby Malformed Ginnu Lifeform binding him, his voice carrying desperate rage.
"That anomaly there is not a Ginnu Lifeform! He needs to be bound and collapsed immediately! He is an outsider who should not be-"
Before his words could even finish, the Ginnu Lifeform holding his chains glanced in the distance toward Noah’s position.
The ancient being’s gaze found Ul’moreth standing beside the young entity.
Recognition and respect flashed through the Ginnu’s presence as he actually gave a deep bow of acknowledgment toward Ul’moreth from across the distance.
Then the Ginnu turned back toward THE Maelstrom Thundermane with expression shifting to pure annoyance and anger.
|You dare suggest we imprison a guest of THE Primeval Titan?|
The Ginnu Lifeform’s body pulsed with concentrated authority as he spoke a variation of The Phoneme of Darkness.
The terrifying power manifested instantly, not as mere absence of light but as the principle of mystery and hidden suffering given physical form.

Darkness wrapped aroundTHE Maelstrom Thundermane’sExistence with crushing force, causing even hisTHElevel body to pulse with sickly black and blue discoloration as the concept of pain unrevealed was inflicted upon every component of his being.
He screamed in agony as the Ginnu beat him thoroughly with linguistic authority, each strike reinforced by The First Tongue speaking suffering into reality.
Then, with casual contempt,THE Maelstrom Thundermanewas thrown bodily into the prison cage.
The moment he crossed the threshold, the Logos of binding activated around him. Multiple Phonemes working in grammatical harmony to create inescapable confinement.
His Existence locked into place, unable to move, unable to escape, barely able to even process thoughts beyond the pain still radiating through him.
His eyes, filled with absolute hatred and impotent rage, could only stare across the distance toward the figure responsible for everything.
Toward the anomaly who stood free while he suffered imprisonment.
He roared internally with fury that had nowhere to go, trapped within linguistic bonds he could not break!
Oh!
Across Existence, entities continue to wish misfortune upon others, never learning the fundamental lesson that reality tends to teach.
THE Maelstrom Thundermane had spent those five minutes in Ginnungagap imagining the anomaly’s painful death in vivid detail, wishing for suffering and imprisonment and collapse.
And now he found himself suffering, imprisoned, on the verge of potential collapse.
The anomaly he had wished such fate upon stood free, honored, protected!
While he rotted in a cage formed from Existence’s own language.
Perhaps if he had spent those five minutes wishing for his own safe escape instead of another’s destruction, reality might have reflected that intention differently.
But such wisdom rarely comes before the lesson is learned the hard way.
And he would learn today!

chapters.title: Chapter 4590: Logos I
paragraphs: It was surreal to watch a THE level entity be beaten black and blue with such casual brutality, and yet here Noah was reflecting on it as he observedTHE Maelstrom Thundermanelying in a cage and being utterly unable to leave.
How terrifyingly existence could play out for those who found themselves on the wrong side of power dynamics!

He shook his head at the ironic reversal of fortune as his focus was actually more concentrated on the coming together of Phonemes that formed complete words to create the inescapable bindings that evenTHElevel entities could not break free from.
The linguistic construction was fascinating to observe now that he understood what he was looking at.

He found himself suddenly wondering something that made his eyes narrow with analytical focus. Had he seen the same thing inTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existencewhen he had been imprisoned there, but he simply did not understand what he was observing at the time?
Had those cages been reinforced withLogos of The First Tonguethat he had been completely blind to?
He could not say for certain without returning to examine that location with his current understanding.
But his intense gaze toward the cages and their linguistic bindings seemed to have been caught by Ul’moreth, whose hairy form turned slightly toward him.
The ancient being smiled wryly while speaking with knowing tone.

|You just learned the eighteen letters, and you already want to jump directly into understanding complete words. Well, before you start trying to decipher things yourself and potentially go catastrophically wrong, I will tell you a little bit about them. Come.|
Ul’moreth began walking deeper into the settlement with Noah following close beside him, his presence radiating focus once more.
They moved through the ancient community as Ul’moreth spoke, his voice carrying across the space with measured instruction.

|After Phonemes, which are the individual letters comprising the alphabet of Existence, The First Tongue progresses to the second tier of expression. These are called Logos. Complete words formed by combining Phonemes in specific, intentional patterns with precise grammatical structure.|

They passed a group of Ginnu Lifeforms engaged in what appeared to be cultivation practice, their malformed bodies pulsing with various types of authority. Every single one of them turned immediately to Ul’moreth and gave respectful bows of acknowledgment toTHE Primeval Titanas he walked by.
Ul’moreth acknowledged them with subtle nods while continuing his explanation without pause.

|Each Logos represents a fundamental concept or law that governs some aspect of Existence. Where a Phoneme is a single letter expressing a basic principle like Fire or Water or Time, a Logos is a complete word that expresses something more sophisticated and nuanced. Fire as a Phoneme is the concept of combustion and transformation. But you could form a Logos that means specifically Purifying Fire, or Consuming Fire, or Creative Fire, each one being a different word constructed from multiple Phonemes arranged with grammatical precision.|
They continued walking, passing structures formed from crystallized Existence that pulsed with incomprehensible authority.
More Ginnu Lifeforms turned to pay respect to Ul’moreth as they traveled.

|Now, here is something absolutely critical for you to understand, Little Anomaly. When you master certain unique Logos that have a preset identity completely, understanding not just how to speak it but why it is structured as it is, what fundamental truth it expresses, what emerges from that mastery is what entities across The Infinite Unfurling call...Grand Principles and Singularity Principles of Existence.|
Noah’s eyes widened slightly with sudden understanding as the implication crashed through his awareness.
Principles of Existence!
Ul’moreth’s presence seemed to intensify with the weight of revelation he was sharing.

|Principles of Existence, Little Anomaly, are actually unique Logos. They are official Logos of Existence itself. High tier words of The First Tongue that have been woven into the fundamental fabric of reality so deeply that they operate as natural laws. Many entities access Principles know they are the equations that govern Existence, the mathematical formulae that determine how reality operates. What they do not know is that those equations are actually words. Complete linguistic expressions in Existence’s native language.|

They passed another gathering where a Ginnu Lifeform was demonstrating something to a small group of students. All of them paused their lesson to bow respectfully toward Ul’moreth before returning to their studies.

|When you gain acess to and comprehend a Grand Principle, you are essentially stumbling onto an Equation of Existence- a Logos of The First Tongue with sufficient accuracy that you can reproduce its effect. When you advance to understanding a Singularity Principle, you stumbled into an even more complex and sophisticated Logos that you begin to use the power of...without realizing this power stems from The First Tongue. And Genesis Principles? Those are Logos so extraordinarily complex and fundamental that they delve into the third tier of expression of The First Tongue...Philology!|
BOOM!
Philology.
Phonemes, Logos, Philology!
The words burned in Noah’s mind as Ul’moreth continued!
|Philology is too distant for you right now but, complex Logos and Philology represent the very first words and sentences spoken when Existence began organizing itself from primordial chaos.|
Ul’moreth gestured with one hairy hand to encompass the settlement around them.

|For example, the Principle of Gravitational Attraction that exists throughout Existence. This is actually a Logos, a complete word in The First Tongue that can be broken down into component Phonemes. It contains the Phoneme of Unity, because gravity brings things together. It contains the Phoneme of Space, because it operates through distance. It contains aspects of the Phoneme of Order, because it follows consistent mathematical relationships.|

|These Phonemes are arranged in a specific grammatical structure to create the complete word that means gravitational attraction pulls objects with mass toward each other proportional to their mass and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them.|
Noah’s eyes were bright.
Unfathomably so!

Each word from Ul’moreth felt grander and grander than the last as if he was being freely given the secrets of Existence, and he was learning just how obscenely he could now violate existence if he had the right tools!
So...continue your long speeches,Ul’moreth!
Talk as much as you want!

|When you comprehend the Principle of Gravitational Attraction through conventional cultivation, you are learning to reproduce that Logos even though you do not realize you gained acess to an equation, to a word. You think you are manipulating some fundamental law of nature. But what you are actually doing is gaining access to The First Tongue unconsciously, without understanding any of it.|
They turned down another pathway through the settlement, heading in a specific direction. More Ginnu Lifeforms acknowledged Ul’moreth’s passage with respectful gestures.

|This is why entities who master many Principles are considered so powerful, Little Anomaly. They have learned to gain acess to multiple words of The First Tongue without realizing that is what they are doing.|

|Someone who actually understands The First Tongue as a language can accomplish the same thing with deliberate intention and grammatical knowledge. You can construct new Logos by combining Phonemes according to linguistic rules rather than hoping random experimentation produces useful results. You can modify existing Logos by changing their component letters to create variations. You can analyze Principles that others have discovered and understand their underlying structure immediately rather than spending years studying their effects.|
His voice carried profound significance as if he was speaking the very turth of existence itself.

|This is the true advantage of knowing The First Tongue, Little Anomaly. Not just that you can speak letters and words with power. But that you understand what Principles actually are at their core, and you can work with them as linguistic constructs rather than as mysterious forces that must be painstakingly decoded.|

How terrifyingly existence could play out for those who found themselves on the wrong side of power dynamics!

He shook his head at the ironic reversal of fortune as his focus was actually more concentrated on the coming together of Phonemes that formed complete words to create the inescapable bindings that evenTHElevel entities could not break free from.
The linguistic construction was fascinating to observe now that he understood what he was looking at.
He found himself suddenly wondering something that made his eyes narrow with analytical focus.
Had he seen the same thing inTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existencewhen he had been imprisoned there, but he simply did not understand what he was observing at the time?
Had those cages been reinforced withLogos of The First Tonguethat he had been completely blind to?

Come.|

Complete words formed by combining Phonemes in specific, intentional patterns with precise grammatical structure.|

Fire as a Phoneme is the concept of combustion and transformation.

They continued walking, passing structures formed from crystallized Existence that pulsed with incomprehensible authority.

Principles of Existence!

High tier words of The First Tongue that have been woven into the fundamental fabric of reality so deeply that they operate as natural laws.
Many entities access Principles know they are the equations that govern Existence, the mathematical formulae that determine how reality operates.
What they do not know is that those equations are actually words.
Complete linguistic expressions in Existence’s native language.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4591: Logos II
paragraphs: Logos.
Principles!

Such a reality was making his Principles of Cheating Architect and Perpetual Harvest begin to buzz as at this moment, Noah had already gone deeply into himself, into the manifestation of his Civilization to look at the massive Trees representing his 5 Principles.
What the hell were they hiding this whole time from him?
He had stumbled onto them not knowing they were so grand, but it explained their ridiculous capabilties! And how they were even leading him towards a Genesis Principle.
As he did this.

They passed through what appeared to be a marketplace where various resources were being exchanged. Every merchant paused their transactions momentarily to acknowledge Ul’moreth’s presence as he merely nodded.

|Now, there are even some unique creatures out there across Existence who possess a natural talent for recognizing Phonemes and Logos even without formal training in The First Tongue. This talent alone gives them access to many official equations of Existence, to many Principles that others struggle to comprehend. They do not consciously understand that they are reading and speaking a language, but their intuition allows them to perceive the linguistic patterns underlying reality and work with them effectively.|
At this revelation, Noah’s Existence buzzed with sudden recognition as a specific individual came immediately to mind.
The First Farmer.

That ancient entity was able to nurture and cultivate Principles in ways that others could not even begin to understand or replicate. His techniques for growing and harvesting Principles had seemed almost mystical in their effectiveness.
To thr point that he was even visited byTHE Creature.

Was The First Farmer actually recognizing and subtly steering Phonemes and Logos without consciously knowing that was what he was doing? Was his extraordinary talent for working with Principles actually a natural aptitude for perceiving The First Tongue?
The implication was heavy to consider.
As Noah processed this thought, Ul’moreth continued with his explanation.

|In Existence, there are many such anomalies that can be naturally influenced or even mutated by The First Tongue and exhibit terrifying capabilities as a result. Some beings are simply born with neural structures that allow them to perceive linguistic patterns in reality that others cannot see. Some have Existences that naturally resonate with certain Phonemes or Logos, giving them instinctive mastery over related concepts.|
They arrived at their destination, standing before the prison holdingTHE Maelstrom Thundermanethat Noah had been focused on.
Ul’moreth pointed toward the Logos burning with concentrated authority over the cage structure, using them as a direct example for his continued explanation.

|Now, let me break down these specific Logos for you so you can understand how words of The First Tongue function in practical application. Look closely at the inscriptions surrounding this prison, Little Anomaly.|
Noah’s gaze focused intently on the glowing linguistic patterns as Ul’moreth began his detailed analysis.

|There are seven distinct Logos inscribed here, each one serving a specific function in creating inescapable confinement. The first Logos, the one glowing with deep purple radiance, is constructed from the Phonemes of Void, Division, and Space. It creates the concept of absolute separation between the prisoner and the outside world. The conceptual separation that prevents any interaction or influence from crossing the boundary.|

|The second Logos, showing silver white light, combines Order, Unity, and Ending. It establishes the rule that any attempt to escape represents a unified action that must reach its ending, its conclusion, which is defined as failure. The prisoner cannot begin an escape attempt without that attempt immediately concluding unsuccessfully because the Logos defines the end state in advance.|

|The third Logos, radiating golden amber, uses Time, Beginning, and Order. It ensures that the prisoner’s temporal experience flows in only one direction, forward, at a consistent rate, preventing any manipulation of time to find weak points in the binding or to age the structure until it fails.|
Fuck.
Noah’s eyes pulsed with marvel at this usage of power!
One Logos creates absolute separation, another makes even the attempt of escape to be a failure, and another ensures that even time could not be used to get out of it.
And these were just 3 Logos out of 7 inscribed on this Prison.
Fuck!
Ul’moreth gestured to the remaining inscriptions with clear teaching intent.

|The fourth Logos, burning with crimson and black light, combines Fire, Death, and Chaos. It creates the threat of immediate collapse for any Existence that attempts to force its Way through the bindings. The more power you apply to breaking free, the more this Logos activates to unmake your Existence. It turns strength against itself.|

|The fifth Logos, displaying emerald green radiance, uses Life, Unity, and Water. It ensures the prison itself remains vital and intact, adapting to any damage or degradation, flowing around weak points to maintain structural integrity. The cage is essentially alive and self-repairing.|

|The sixth Logos, pulsing with pale violet, combines Darkness, Void, and Paradox. It conceals the prisoner from outside awareness while simultaneously preventing the prisoner from perceiving outside reality clearly. Both sides of the barrier are blind to each other, creating isolation at the conceptual level. Right now, I am influencing this to allow this Prisoner to see us as you two seem to share history.|
HUUM!

Noah nearly laughed at this as he nodded with enthusiastic eyes for Ul’moreth to continue. Because while he absorbed all this knowledge like a sponge, he wss already imagining how he could use all lf this for himself!

|And the seventh Logos, the one shining with prismatic brilliance, uses multiple Core Phonemes arranged in a specific master pattern. It serves as the keystone that binds all the other Logos together into a unified system, ensuring they work in harmony rather than conflicting with each other.|
His presence radiated satisfaction at the sophisticated construction.

|When you stack multiple Logos together in The First Tongue with this level of sophistication, the result is that even THE Surface or Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entities cannot escape. They are facing not just physical barriers but living language, living words that express inescapable concepts. It is as if this prison actually has its bars being reinforced by multiple invisible jailers constantly working to maintain the confinement. Those jailers are The First Tongue itself, the language of Existence working according to its own grammatical rules.|

|And here is what makes inscribed Logos so extraordinarily powerful and efficient. After we inscribed these seven Logos onto this cage structure, we do not have to expend or continuously channel any personal authority to reinforce them. The First Tongue pulls directly on the authority of Singularity Principles to maintain its operation, and sometimes when the inscriptions are sophisticated enough, even Genesis Principles contribute their weight to ensuring the Logos continue functioning as written.|

|The language itself powers its own expression once properly inscribed. We simply had to write the words correctly, and now they speak themselves into perpetual reality without requiring any maintenance or energy input from us.|
Noah’s eyes shone brilliantly with wonder and growing comprehension as he absorbed this explanation.
This entire time, he and Ul’moreth had been conversing exclusively in The First Tongue, their words incomprehensible to anyone who did not know the language.

Inside his cage, THE Maelstrom Thundermane could only look toward Noah with hateful expression mixed with growing unease and confusion. He understood nothing of what was being discussed, hearing only the strange linguistic patterns of The First Tongue that his mind could not process into meaning.

All he could perceive was the continued expression of Ul’moreth’s terrifically oppressive power radiating through the space, an aura so overwhelming that it made abundantly clear this ancient being could collapse him in a single moment if provoked.

It was a truly terrifying situation to find oneself imprisoned in, unable to understand the language being spoken by your captors, unable to know if they were discussing your immediate execution or indefinite imprisonment!
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 4592: Logos III
paragraphs: Noah barely spared a glance for the imprisoned entity as his attention remained fixed on the multiple vibrant Logos surrounding the cage with fascinated wonder.
After several moments of studying the inscriptions, he looked toward Ul’moreth and asked with a voice carrying intense interest.
|Can you teach me about inscribing and writing Logos externally like this? The permanent inscription of The First Tongue onto objects and structures?|
Ul’moreth’s hairy form seemed to pulse with approval at the question before he launched into another explanation.

|The Inscription of The First Tongueis a heavy and terrifically difficult art, Little Anomaly. It requires far more than simply knowing and understanding Phonemes or even being able to speak complete Logos aloud. You must learn to write them in such a way that they continue expressing their effects perpetually without your direct involvement or conscious maintenance.|

|When you speak a Phoneme or Logos, the effect manifests and then fades once you stop channeling it. But when you inscribe The First Tongue onto weapons, buildings, constructs, armor, even living beings if you are skilled and careful enough, the linguistic pattern becomes permanent. The object itself becomes a speaker of The First Tongue, continuously uttering the inscribed word and producing its effect as long as the inscription remains intact.|
His voice carried the weight of extensive experience with this technique.

|The mechanics of Inscription are complex and variable. Different practitioners achieve different results even when inscribing the same Logos because you must write through your own Way of Existence while simultaneously allowing The First Tongue to flow through you. Your personal understanding, your cultivation foundation, your connection to Mana, all of these factors influence how effectively the inscription manifests and how powerfully it operates.|

|Someone with shallow understanding might inscribe a Logos of Fire onto a sword and achieve only modest enhancement of the blade’s cutting temperature. Someone with deeper comprehension inscribing the exact same Logos would create a weapon that burns with flames drawing upon Singularity Principles of combustion. The words are identical, but the depth of understanding behind them determines their potency.|
Ul’moreth gestured toward Noah with what felt like measuring assessment.

|If you continue to be insane enough in your rate of advancement, Little Anomaly, you would potentially become capable of inscribing Logos onto your weapons and armor, decorating yourself from top to bottom with linguistic patterns of The First Tongue. You could then face a THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity with just multiple Logos supporting you, which would likely mean the constant support of Singularity and even Genesis Principles without you personally utilizing any of your own authority at all.|

|Imagine entering combat where your armor continuously speaks defensive Logos that make you nearly indestructible. Where your weapon perpetually utters offensive Logos that allow it to cut through any defense. Where inscriptions on your armament itself enhance your speed, strength, perception, regeneration, all drawing power directly from fundamental Principles of Existence rather than from your personal reserves. You would be fighting not with your own power but with the accumulated authority of reality itself backing every action.|
Noah had to pace himself at the thought of it alone!
Becuase...sheesh!
What were Complexity and Purity before such things?
Existence was truly filled with unfathomable weavings of wonder!
But...
The tone of Ul’moreth became more cautionary.

|However, the art ofInscription of The First Tongueis extraordinarily difficult and requires years of dedicated practice and study to achieve even basic competency. The precision required is far beyond what verbal utterance demands. When speaking, small errors in pronunciation might reduce the effect or cause minor backlash. When inscribing, small errors create permanent flaws that can cause catastrophic failure, destroying the object you were trying to enhance or even causing linguistic explosions that could collapse your own Existence.|

|You must learn not just how to form each component of each Phoneme perfectly in written form, but how to connect them into complete Logos with flawless grammatical structure, and how to inscribe them onto different materials that each respond differently to linguistic patterns. Metal accepts Fire Phonemes readily but resists Water. Wood welcomes Life but rejects Death. Every material has its own affinities and resistances that must be understood and worked with.|
Noah listened to all of this explanation with growing marvel while looking at the sophisticated Logos inscribed on the cage before him.
If he could learn to inscribe Logos seamlessly onto weapons or armor or even entire constructs like The Infiniverse...
’Oh?’
The thought alone stopped him as from The Infiniverse, he thought ofTHE Loom.
Was that fucking thing...filled with Inscriptions of The First Tongue to be as impenetrable as it was and still powered and energized all these years?
It was only a thought that came to his mind as it may not be accurate at all, but he couldn’t shake the thought!
The possibilities felt genuinely immense and potentially reality-breaking in their implications.
Just to confirm his understanding and potential limitations, he asked with careful emphasis on a specific detail.
|One can inscribe Logos onto themselves, yes? Directly onto their own Existence rather than onto external objects?|
Ul’moreth was quiet for a long moment before responding with unusually contemplative tone.

|Well, yes. You can attempt it if you want to potentially collapse your own Existence catastrophically. Objects or other things in nature are relatively easy to inscribe and have them maintain their structural qualities. But Existences, living conscious beings, you would be forcing the letters and words of The First Tongue onto entities that are fundamentally not aligned with The First Tongue in its pure undifferentiated form.|

|All of us countless beings who have differentiated and specialized away from pure Mana into particular Ways and Paths. Our Existences resist The First Tongue to varying degrees because we have committed ourselves to specific expressions rather than remaining open to all possibilities. Trying to inscribe Logos directly onto such an Existence is like trying to write on water, the medium constantly shifts and rejects the pattern you are attempting to impose.|

|It is technically feasible to inscribe a Logos onto yourself so long as it closely matches your Way. A Way related to Fire would have a much easire time inscribing the Phoneme of Fire and its variations onto themselves, but they may collapse themselves if they inscribe Water while their Way is that of Fire.|

|But it is feasible to do all this and have the Logos act like an engine continuously enhancing your capabilities. But the effect is limited by what your Existence can withstand based on how much of a natural connection you maintain to The First Tongue in its purest form. Most entities can perhaps sustain one or two simple Logos inscribed on themselves before their Existence begins rejecting the patterns and risking collapse from the incompatibility.|
He paused, then added with voice carrying sudden realization.

|Oh, hmm, actually when it comes to you specifically, this limitation may function entirely differently. That is right, you are an anomaly of The First Tongue itself. Your Way is pure Mana, which is The First Tongue in its undifferentiated state. Your Existence has not specialized away from the source language but rather embraced it as your fundamental nature.|
BOOM!
The realization was a quintessentially heavy one for both Ul’moreth and him as moments later, Ul’moreth turned silent at the thought of it.
Yes.
Yes!
His eyes shone luminously as he processed the implications with mounting excitement.
Why not pursue this path? It made perfect sense for his unique situation.
Mana was his Way. The First Tongue was his Way. The language of Existence itself was what he cultivated.
This terrifying technique of inscribing The First Tongue directly onto his own body and Existence, would it not simply be equivalent to him writing words in his own native language onto himself?
He would not be forcing foreign patterns onto resistant material. He would be adding to and enhancing what was already fundamentally aligned with The First Tongue!
The idea was grand and glorious to contemplate in all its potential applications.

But there was still tremendously much work to be done before such techniques became feasible. He had not even successfully formed and spoken a single Logos yet, much less begun learning the intricate art of permanentInscription.
One step at a time. Master the letters, then the words, then the writing of those words into permanent reality!
As he and Ul’moreth had their discussion of advanced linguistic techniques,THE Maelstrom Thundermaneinside his cage could only observe them with growing sense of profound unease.
He was particularly fearful of Ul’moreth, whose aura radiated such stifling and overwhelming power that it made breathing feel difficult even through the cage barriers.

Since they were conversing exclusively in The First Tongue, THE Maelstrom Thundermane understood absolutely nothing of what was being said. He could only feel the continued expression of Ul’moreth’s terrifying presence, that suffocating weight of authority that could collapse his entire Existence in a fraction of a second if this ancient being decided he was not worth keeping alive.
He had no idea if they were discussing his fate, planning his execution, debating whether to use him for experiments, or simply ignoring his presence entirely while teaching unrelated concepts.
The linguistic isolation was almost worse than the physical imprisonment.
At least if he could understand what they were saying, he might be able to plead or negotiate or attempt some form of communication!

But trapped in incomprehension, unable to even process the sounds they were making into meaningful language, he could only wait in mounting dread for whatever these unfathomably powerful beings decided to do with him.
It was genuinely one of the most terrifying situations an entity could find themselves in.
Imprisoned in unbreakable bindings, surrounded by beings who could end you casually, unable to understand the language determining your fate.
THE Maelstrom Thundermanehad wished misfortune upon the anomaly who led him here.
But as he watched that same anomaly standing free while he rotted in a cage...
He was beginning to deeply regret everything so far!
Noah saw this gaze of regret and did not even pay it any heed as he was thinking of even grander things.
He looked around the cages here that held a few THE and Pre-THE entities.
He was thinking that maybe...just maybe, he had found the metaphorical chickens to imprison inside his chicken coop.
InsideTHE Organ of Civilization!
Why could he not imprison metaphorical chickens at the THE level inside ofTHE Organ of Civilization?!

He just needed to gain the power to defeat them and have the power to hold them in his THE Organ of Civilization, but would this not be easy if he took the 7 Logos that Ul’moreth had just introduced which were inscribed on these prison cages out here?
Hmm.
Hmm!

|Can you teach me about inscribing and writing Logos externally like this?
The permanent inscription of The First Tongue onto objects and structures?|
Ul’moreth’s hairy form seemed to pulse with approval at the question before he launched into another explanation.
|The Inscription of The First Tongueis a heavy and terrifically difficult art, Little Anomaly.
It requires far more than simply knowing and understanding Phonemes or even being able to speak complete Logos aloud.
You must learn to write them in such a way that they continue expressing their effects perpetually without your direct involvement or conscious maintenance.|
|When you speak a Phoneme or Logos, the effect manifests and then fades once you stop channeling it.
But when you inscribe The First Tongue onto weapons, buildings, constructs, armor, even living beings if you are skilled and careful enough, the linguistic pattern becomes permanent.
The object itself becomes a speaker of The First Tongue, continuously uttering the inscribed word and producing its effect as long as the inscription remains intact.|
His voice carried the weight of extensive experience with this technique.
|The mechanics of Inscription are complex and variable.

Different practitioners achieve different results even when inscribing the same Logos because you must write through your own Way of Existence while simultaneously allowing The First Tongue to flow through you.
Your personal understanding, your cultivation foundation, your connection to Mana, all of these factors influence how effectively the inscription manifests and how powerfully it operates.|
|Someone with shallow understanding might inscribe a Logos of Fire onto a sword and achieve only modest enhancement of the blade’s cutting temperature.
Someone with deeper comprehension inscribing the exact same Logos would create a weapon that burns with flames drawing upon Singularity Principles of combustion.
The words are identical, but the depth of understanding behind them determines their potency.|
Ul’moreth gestured toward Noah with what felt like measuring assessment.

|If you continue to be insane enough in your rate of advancement, Little Anomaly, you would potentially become capable of inscribing Logos onto your weapons and armor, decorating yourself from top to bottom with linguistic patterns of The First Tongue.

You could then face a THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity with just multiple Logos supporting you, which would likely mean the constant support of Singularity and even Genesis Principles without you personally utilizing any of your own authority at all.|
|Imagine entering combat where your armor continuously speaks defensive Logos that make you nearly indestructible.
Where your weapon perpetually utters offensive Logos that allow it to cut through any defense.

Where inscriptions on your armament itself enhance your speed, strength, perception, regeneration, all drawing power directly from fundamental Principles of Existence rather than from your personal reserves.
You would be fighting not with your own power but with the accumulated authority of reality itself backing every action.|
Noah had to pace himself at the thought of it alone!
Becuase...sheesh!
What were Complexity and Purity before such things?
Existence was truly filled with unfathomable weavings of wonder!
But...
The tone of Ul’moreth became more cautionary.
|However, the art ofInscription of The First Tongueis extraordinarily difficult and requires years of dedicated practice and study to achieve even basic competency.
The precision required is far beyond what verbal utterance demands.
When speaking, small errors in pronunciation might reduce the effect or cause minor backlash.

When inscribing, small errors create permanent flaws that can cause catastrophic failure, destroying the object you were trying to enhance or even causing linguistic explosions that could collapse your own Existence.|

|You must learn not just how to form each component of each Phoneme perfectly in written form, but how to connect them into complete Logos with flawless grammatical structure, and how to inscribe them onto different materials that each respond differently to linguistic patterns.
Metal accepts Fire Phonemes readily but resists Water.
Wood welcomes Life but rejects Death.
Every material has its own affinities and resistances that must be understood and worked with.|

’Oh?’
The thought alone stopped him as from The Infiniverse, he thought ofTHE Loom.
Was that fucking thing...filled with Inscriptions of The First Tongue to be as impenetrable as it was and still powered and energized all these years?
It was only a thought that came to his mind as it may not be accurate at all, but he couldn’t shake the thought!
The possibilities felt genuinely immense and potentially reality-breaking in their implications.
Just to confirm his understanding and potential limitations, he asked with careful emphasis on a specific detail.

Directly onto their own Existence rather than onto external objects?|

You can attempt it if you want to potentially collapse your own Existence catastrophically.
Objects or other things in nature are relatively easy to inscribe and have them maintain their structural qualities.

But Existences, living conscious beings, you would be forcing the letters and words of The First Tongue onto entities that are fundamentally not aligned with The First Tongue in its pure undifferentiated form.|

A Way related to Fire would have a much easire time inscribing the Phoneme of Fire and its variations onto themselves, but they may collapse themselves if they inscribe Water while their Way is that of Fire.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4593: Existential Intermission- The Annals of Mana
paragraphs: In Existence, there were many weird oddities scattered all around across countless domains and territories.
Some oddities were unfathomably more odd compared to others as they pursued activities that defied conventional understanding or purpose.
Two entities that could arguably take the crown when it came to pure oddity wereThe Queen of Matter and The Shadow Guard, Night.

At this moment in time, in the current era, inside a unique domain within The Infiniverse, there existed an emerging Fold of Dreams that held seas of golden sands permeating all around for both the skies and the earth below.
The entire landscape existed in warm amber illumination, as if perpetually caught in the golden hour before sunset.
Inside such a domain, toward the central corner of this vast space, there sat a massive marbled golden table surrounded by three ornate thrones.
Two of these thrones were currently occupied by the figures of The Queen of Matter and The Shadow Guard, Night.

The Queen of Matter was adorned in a radiant white dress that seemed to be woven from countless pages of books, the text visible on the fabric constantly shifting and rearranging as if the dress itself was being continuously rewritten. Her presence radiated scholarly authority and accumulated knowledge.

Night sat beside her, adorned in a black tightfitting dress that hugged her curves with elegant precision. Shadows seemed to cling to her form naturally, creating an aura of mystery and concealment even in the golden light filling the domain.

Both entities sat on their thrones with stacks of books and papers scattered all over the massive table before them. These documents held wondrous Records of Weavings of Existence pertaining to The True Emperor of Quintessence and The Infiniverse itself.
At this moment, The Queen of Matter breathed out slowly as if clearing away building nerves before speaking with determined focus.
"Okay, let us do this. The first discussion to put into The Annals of Mana. A proper record for future generations to understand who we were and what we faced..."
Night nodded with agreement, her pen already poised over blank parchment waiting to capture every word.
The Queen of Matter then raised her voice slightly and called out.
"Alright, Sir Henry, please come in!"
In the next moment, the figure of Henry Osmont manifested in the air above the third throne, his steps light and calm as he descended to sit.
He looked like a young prince of Existence itself, carrying himself with natural nobility and quiet confidence.

His hair shone with blue gold radiance, catching the ambient light of the domain. He was adorned in a blue gold shirt and matching pants that hugged his slightly muscular and toned figure, the fabric seeming to shimmer with concentrated authority.
Henry looked between The Queen of Matter and Night with wry smile forming on his features as he spoke with gentle skepticism.
"We are at a fairly pivotal moment in our Existence right now. Is there really time for this sort of... this? Even if our Main Bodies are free to do this while events unfold elsewhere..."
The Queen of Matter leaned forward slightly.

"We cannot do anything to change the outcome of what is currently happening out there beyond the calculations and preparations already made. And we do not need to be so fearful of our enemies that we cannot even be comfortable in our own homes, right? IfTHE Loomerupts in the next few seconds and we all die from overwhelming force, what use is all this constant worry and tension? We can spend the time doing things we genuinely love and find meaningful."
Henry leaned back in his throne with thoughtful expression before responding with dry honesty.
"If I was going to collapse in the next few seconds, this would not be the last thing I hope to be doing with my remaining moments of Existence."
As he said this, Night was already writing things down rapidly on the papers in front of them, her pen moving with practiced efficiency.
She chimed in without looking up from her documentation.

"Hmm, what would you rather be doing then? You had a girl before that you brought to meet your Father, and now you have also added Lyra to what appears to be a growing harem. Just for the record of The Annals of Mana, are you planning to grow a harem like your Father has done?"
At such a ridiculous and direct question, Henry smiled while shaking his head with mixture of amusement and exasperation.
"I cannot really answer that definitively. But I do not think so, no. That is not my intention or focus."
The Queen of Matter and Night looked at each other meaningfully before they both wrote something down on the papers before them.
The Queen of Matter then picked up the questioning with smooth transition.

"Okay, what about the harem of your Father then? He has more than a dozen women under his belt at this point, and Queen Adelaide is your biological mother. How do you look at the other Queens of The Infiniverse? And what would be your reaction if you ended up getting a sibling soon in the midst of all this chaos?"
Henry took a moment to formulate his response carefully before speaking with calm and measured tone.

"I look at all of them with respect and treat them accordingly as Queens who have chosen to stand with my Father and with all of us in The Infiniverse. They are powerful entities in their own right who made their choices freely. As for siblings..."
He paused with slight smile.

"I can say without any doubt that having children is something my Father is absolutely not planning on anytime in the foreseeable future. His focus is entirely on our survival and advancement, not on expanding the family further during such a dangerous period."
Night and The Queen of Matter nodded at this response, writing down his words with approving expressions.
Night spoke next, her voice shifting to more serious territory.

"Okay, veering away from personal matters. What can you say about our current situation overall? We just learned about something calledThe First Tonguethat The Master briefly sent knowledge about through his connection with RUIN/EDEN. So far, the only one among us who knows the full details and can actually do anything practical withThe First Tongueis The Infiniverse herself as she faces off against a supposed Disciple ofTHE Creature. What...do you think about us havingTHE Creatureas a confirmed enemy in the future?"
Henry’s expression became more focused and serious as he considered the weight of the question before responding with steady conviction.

"Enemies are enemies, regardless of where they come from or what titles they hold. So long as they threaten us, threaten our Existence and everything we have built, we will defend against them with everything we have. We already fight againstTHE Living Paradox and THE Living Emotiveand countless others withinTHE Loom’sinfluence. IfTHE Creaturecomes next as another adversary, so what? We face what comes and adapt accordingly."
The Queen of Matter and Night both nodded at such an answer with shining eyes!
Night continued with another challenging question.

"What about those among us who think that The Infiniverse should not have erupted to use the power of The First Tongue against our enemies? Right now, we are witnessing what we now understand to be a glimpse of aGenesis Principlefrom the Disciple ofTHE Creature,power they shockingly might have gained fromTHE Creaturehimself relating toThe First Tongue. But with The Infiniverse using the power ofThe First Tonguein response, some fear that it will likely invite an even more terrifying challenge or retaliation that we may not be ready to face. Based on the limited background knowledge we have from what Master has shared with RUIN/EDEN, the power ofThe First Tongueis not even something those belowTHEclassification can wield freely without risk."
At such a complex question, Henry frowned slightly as he shook his head with clear conviction.

"If someone has a rock or a gun nearby and there is an intruder breaking into their home, should they use only the rock and not the gun because they are fearing what response might come next? Because escalating the conflict might invite greater danger? That makes no sense. They have to use every tool in their arsenal to do what they can to win the immediate battle and survive. The Infiniverse likely made countless calculations before she even made that move to useThe First Tongue. None of us possess the computational power and awareness she and others hold. Who are we to judge them as they defend us using methods we barely comprehend? Whatever enemies come after this escalation, whatever response our actions invite, we can only deal with them accordingly when they arrive. Holding back power out of fear only guarantees defeat."
Night and The Queen of Matter nodded with clear agreement as the latter then posed what she indicated would be the final question.

"Okay, last question and we will not bother you for a while after this. Do you think The Master will come back to the current era in time for whatever terrifying response we are about to face? Many are worried about exactly what kind of retaliation we might see fromTHE Dead Order, THE Living Paradox,and now potentiallyTHE Creaturehimself. What response could we face now from all of them combined? This is not even mentioning the ongoing threat fromTHE Living Elementaland others..."
At such a question touching on fears many held but few voiced openly, Henry was briefly silent as he considered his words carefully.
When he spoke, his voice carried absolute conviction.

"My father is going through who knows what trials and dangers in the past to try and help us in our present. Whatever is happening to him across time, he continues to do everything by himself to give the rest of us a chance at survival and victory. We should all simply give away our Everythings of Fear, our Doubts, our perceived Limitations, and trust in what he is doing. When he calls for us to move, we move without hesitation. When he needs to be back in this era, he will be back. Of this, I am absolutely sure."
The answer carried heavy weight that settled over the golden table.
The Queen of Matter and Night looked at each other and nodded with shared understanding and appreciation.
The Queen of Matter spoke earnestly, her voice carrying genuine warmth.

"We do not know what fate holds for any of us in the coming conflicts. But Night and I thought it would be...meaningfulto have a proper record of you and other important personages of The Infiniverse preserved inThe Annals of Mana.A Record of Our Everythings, who we were and what we believed in. Thank you for taking the time to humor us in this project."
Henry nodded at these words with slight smile before his figure began to fade, disappearing from the golden throne and leaving Night and The Queen of Matter behind.
The two looked at each other across the table covered in their documentation.
Night spoke first with thoughtful tone.
"That went well...?"
The Queen of Matter nodded in agreement before asking the next logical question.
"Who should we talk to next for The Annals?"
Night tapped her pen against her lips contemplatively before thinking of several options.
"Not sure, but I can think of many..."
The Queen of Matter smiled as she began organizing her notes!
