chapters.title: Chapter 4594 - 25 Seconds To Midnight I
paragraphs: WithinTHE Loom.
In an unfathomably terrifying region of pure paradox, where seas of paradoxical authority seemed to stand above even the Weavings of Existence themselves.
Here, in this place where logic came to die,THE Living Paradoxhad stood straight.
He was no longer lounging around in casual repose, no longer affecting the appearance of relaxed confidence.
And just because of this single change in posture, just because he had chosen to sit up rather than recline...
WAP!
In the next moment, a flutter of chaotic emotions emerged in the space as a multicolored feminine figure appeared without warning.
The entity spoke immediately upon manifestation, her voice carrying layers of conflicting feelings that somehow harmonized into coherent speech.

"You know, I was more than happy to continue my emotions of self deception and delusions that I held some form of control, some meaningful role or actual power over THE Loom’s operations. Such emotions are so wonderfully strong and all consuming that they put me in a state of mind where I can more easily study The First Tongue without despair overwhelming me. But when you go and do things like this, when you activate critical functions of THE Loom without even sending me a single word beforehand, when you so freely demonstrate that I absolutely have no control whatsoever over anything that truly matters... well, my precious emotions of delusion and grandeur are so easily lost."
The humanoid female entity said all of this while smiling brightly, as if discussing something amusing rather than expressing genuine grievance.

Waves of manic emotions surrounded her form, colors shifting rapidly through the entire spectrum and beyond. Joy mixed with rage, contentment blended with desperation, confidence merged with terror, all cycling through her presence simultaneously.
This was none other thanTHE Living Emotive.
In his seated figure, the visage ofTHE Living Paradoxturned over to regard her as he actually smiled with what might have been genuine warmth and spoke with unusually forthcoming honesty.

"Would you have preferred if I came to you first and we continued keeping up the elaborate act? You have known about all of this for many, many years already. Unlike all of the others who serve under me in THE Loom, you are the one that I have been the most honest with from the beginning."
She truly was the one that he had lied the least to over their long association.

The others he had either collapsed their entire Civilizations and forcibly taken their Hearts of Civilization for his purposes, or he had lied to them extensively and made countless promises that would never be kept once his true plans came to fruition.
But with Emotive, there had been a different relationship from the start.

The figure ofTHE Living Emotive, whose true form could barely be observed beneath the brilliant light of multicolored manic emotion wrapping all around it like protective armor, floated closer with that bright smile still fixed on her features.
When she spoke, her voice carried the weight of profound understanding mixed with genuine curiosity.

"Emotions are pervasive across all of Existence. They touch every conscious being, influence every decision, color every perception of reality. This is why you kept me so close all these eons, is it not? Because you could utilize my Weavings that cover such a vast expanse of observable Existence to strike against THE Creature. To influence emotions across territories he controls."

"I still have my uses, which is precisely why I do not truly fear for my life despite knowing how expendable everyone else is to you. But should you not fear for your own life? Because if you are activating core functions of THE Loom now, ahead of your original timeline, then it means you are accelerating your ultimate battle against THE Creature. Bringing the confrontation closer. Making it more imminent."
She paused dramatically before asking the critical question.
"Are you actually ready to face THE Creature?"
WAA!
At such pointed words,THE Living Paradoxsmiled with an expression mixing dark amusement and grim acceptance before responding.

"Would anyone genuinely be ready to face the absolute monster that imprisoned every single life form with even an ounce of Civilizational Authority in The Infinite Unfurling? The monster that truly put all of Existence in The Infinite Unfurling under his complete dominion as he enjoyed and reveled in countless Sovereignties flowing into him constantly? He consumed countless Everythings while giving us such meager amounts of scraps and pretending it was generosity."
His voice carried the accumulated bitterness of eons.

"Of course I had to rebel eventually. Of course I had to plan and scheme and build THE Loom as a weapon against him. But no, I will paradoxically never be truly ready to face THE Creature. Which is precisely why I must do absolutely everything that I can possibly do to prepare, to create advantages, to stack the deck in whatever small ways are available to me."

"THE Loom is a blade that will strike at The Belly of the Beast, at The Belly of Existence itself where THE Creature has gorged himself. THE Creature has eaten so much, consumed so many Civilizations, oppressed so many entities across so many eras. Just how much time and attention will he have specifically for me when everything I have prepared is finally unleashed simultaneously? When attacks come from directions he did not anticipate, from weapons he did not know existed?"
THE Living Paradoxshook his head as he continued speaking with building intensity.

"And even now, even with all these elaborate plans spanning eons, I still have to prepare additional countermeasures and backup strategies. That is the fundamental reason why I have activated a few critical functions early, ahead of the original schedule. That is the reason why The Fallout can now be considered to officially be on a timer, on an active countdown rather than merely a theoretical future event."

"It was always inevitable. It was paradoxically certain to occur. It was existentially required. The Fallout will always arrive regardless of what specific actions anyone takes or does not take. But now, by activating these functions, I will simply be able to release Agents of The Fallout earlier than planned. Nothing too crazy or dramatic. Just... insurance."
THE Living Emotivelistened to all of this extensive explanation with expression of genuine surprise coloring her features beneath the swirling emotions.
She spoke with a voice carrying uncharacteristic seriousness mixed with her natural manic edge.

"You would have never talked to me this much before about your actual plans and concerns. Hell, it has been who knows how much time since you said that many consecutive words to me about anything of substance. The power of THE Creature is really getting to you now, is it not? Now that the time to truly face him after your countless eons of meticulous preparations are finally drawing near? Now that theory is about to become terrifying reality?"
She continued with words that seemed designed to probe and taunt.

"Are you experiencing doubt? Fear? Second thoughts about whether THE Loom will actually be sufficient? Wondering if you calculated everything correctly or if you missed some critical variable that will doom everything?"

"Or perhaps you are simply lonely, isolated at the peak of your conspiracy, unable to truly confide in anyone because trust is a luxury you cannot afford? Are these words to me simply because you need to speak your concerns aloud to someone, anyone, before the final battle begins?"
THE Living Paradoxlaughed at her questions, the sound carrying genuine amusement rather than defensive dismissal.
When he replied, his voice held the weight of hard earned wisdom.

"If any entity actually held complete confidence and absolute surety while preparing to face against THE Creature, then they have already lost before the first blow is struck. They have fundamentally misunderstood what they are facing. When confronting a true monster, one needs to maintain a careful balance of sufficient confidence and appropriate fear. One needs to have access to their Everything, all aspects of themselves including the parts that doubt and worry."

"If one is missing any of their Everythings, if they have locked away their fear or their doubt or their capacity to adapt when plans fail, then they have already lost. Overconfidence is death. But paralysis from fear is equally fatal. The balance is everything."
The words carried heavy weight that settled over the paradoxical space!

chapters.title: Chapter 4595 - 25 Seconds To Midnight II
paragraphs: THE Living Emotiveturned silent as she processed his response.
She had more she wanted to say. Questions she wanted to ask. Concerns she wanted to voice about her own role in the coming conflict.
But just asTHE Living Paradoxheld a careful balance of confidence and fear towardTHE Creature, so did she hold a similar mixture of confidence and fear towardTHE Living Paradoxhimself.
And such dual emotion was particularly powerful for an entity like her, whose very nature was built around understanding and manipulating feelings.
Even more so as the final showdown drew nearer with each passing moment.

She smiled silently as she contemplated something she had known this whole time. This battle was ostensibly betweenTHE Creature and THE Living Paradox,two titans clashing while the rest of Existence watched or burned.
But what about the rest of them? What about her and the other entities caught in the middle? Would they really be just pieces to be moved around on someone else’s board?
Or could they perhaps tip the scales just a little bit in one direction or another?
At this time.

THE Living Paradox’shand moved slowly through the air, tracing the motion of clock hands ticking toward an inevitable conclusion. His voice carried the weight of eons as he spoke to the space whereTHE Living Emotivewas.

"We are now twenty-five seconds from Midnight, Emotive. Twenty-five seconds on a clock I constructed specifically for the countdown to The Fallout, a timepiece that does not measure minutes or hours or even conventional eons, but rather the accumulation of actions and reactions that bring us closer to the point of no return."
His hand continued its circular motion, mimicking the inexorable progression of time.

"Let me explain how this clock actually works, since you will need to understand it in the coming days or years or however long we have remaining. Midnight on this clock represents the moment when The Fallout fully activates, when THE Loom completes its transformation from weapon being forged into weapon being fired. Midnight is the instant when every function I have built, every trap I have laid, every contingency I have prepared across countless eras all triggers simultaneously and strikes at The Belly of Existence itself."

"Midnight is when THE Creature finally understands the true scope of what I have been building all this time, when his attention focuses completely on me and THE Loom. Midnight is the moment when hiding ends and open war begins, when subtlety gives way to apocalyptic confrontation, when Existence itself becomes the battlefield and everything we know potentially burns in the crossfire."
His expression grew more intense as he continued.

"But this clock does not tick forward based on the passage of conventional time. Oh no, that would be far too simple and predictable. Instead, it advances based on the accumulation of significant actions that bring us closer to that final confrontation. Each major move I make advances the clock by some amount. Each function of THE Loom I activate pushes us seconds closer. Each significant action THE Creature takes in response moves the hands forward. Each intervention by other major players, anomalies, or oddities moves the clock."

"The clock measures causality and consequence rather than duration. It tracks the building of pressure that must eventually release. It counts the stacking of conditions that make Midnight not just possible but inevitable."
THE Living Paradox’shand stopped moving, freezing at a specific position.

"At this moment, with the functions I just activated, we have moved to twenty-five seconds from midnight. We were at thirty seconds before I made this decision. The activation cost us five seconds, brought us measurably closer to the point where everything erupts. But..."

"This clock may remain at twenty-five seconds for months. Or years. Or even eons if circumstances somehow stabilize and neither side makes significant moves. The clock only advances when actions of sufficient weight and consequence occur. If everyone suddenly decided to stop escalating, to maintain the current balance indefinitely, we could theoretically stay at twenty-five seconds forever."

"But paradoxically, we could also move closer to midnight in mere days if the right sequence of events unfolds. If THE Creature discovers something critical about THE Loom’s true nature. If one of the other major players makes an unexpected move that forces everyone else to respond. If and if and if..."
His voice grew darker.

"Or if I am forced to activate more functions ahead of schedule. Each activation brings Midnight closer. This... is the paradox of the countdown, you see. Moving forward brings the end closer. But standing still while your opponent moves might bring it even faster."
He resumed the circular motion of his hand.

"So we are locked into this dance, this countdown, this march toward midnight. Twenty-five seconds remaining. Close enough that we can see it approaching clearly. Far enough that there is still time for maneuver, for adjustment, for last minute preparations. The most dangerous position possible because it creates urgency without certainty, pressure without clarity about exactly when the final moment will arrive."

"You asked if I was ready to face THE Creature. The truth remains that I will never be ready, which is why I built this clock in the first place. To force myself to act before I convinced myself to wait longer, to prepare more, to delay indefinitely out of fear. The clock ensures that midnight will come whether I feel ready or not, whether my preparations are complete or not. It guarantees that the confrontation I have been building toward for eons will actually happen rather than remaining eternally theoretical."
His hand stopped again at twenty-five seconds before Midnight.

"So yes, Emotive. We are very close now. Not necessarily in terms of days or years, but in terms of the space remaining for significant actions before everything erupts. Twenty-five seconds. It sounds like so little time when spoken aloud..."

"Watch the clock with me. Feel how it ticks not with time but with consequence. And understand that when it finally strikes midnight, when those final seconds run out and The Fallout truly begins, there will be no going back. No pause. No reconsideration. Just the full weight of everything I have built crashing down on THE Creature with apocalyptic force."
BOOM!
The space fell silent as his hand dropped, the invisible clock continuing its inexorable countdown toward the moment when Existence itself would burn.
A heavy silence settled.
And...
THE Living Emotive’ssmile turned devilish as she spoke her final words before departing.

"I wish you luck, O Primordial Paradox. After all, your success is my success in the end. Your collapse is my collapse. You die, I die. We are bound together in this madness whether I like it or not. Haha!"
With such manic words delivered with genuine cheer,THE Living Emotivedisappeared as abruptly as she had arrived.
THE Living Paradoxremained standing in the paradoxical space, alone once more with his thoughts and plans.

He had spoken more honestly to her than he had to anyone in eons. Perhaps because the end was finally approaching. Perhaps because maintaining absolute secrecy no longer served any purpose when action was imminent.
Or perhaps simply because even he, architect of the greatest conspiracy Existence had ever seen, needed someone to talk to occasionally.
The functions ofTHE Loomcontinued operating according to his will.
The countdown to The Fallout continued ticking toward zero.
In Existence, certain events become inevitable long before they actually occur.
The collision betweenTHE Creature and THE Living Paradoxhad been inevitable from the moment rebellion first sparked in Paradox’s consciousness.
The Fallout had been inevitable from the momentTHE Loomwas first conceived as a weapon rather than merely a domain.
What remained uncertain was not whether these events would occur, but rather when and how they would unfold.
And most critically, who would survive to see what came after.
THE Living Paradoxhad activated functions ahead of schedule, accelerating the timeline, bringing the inevitable closer.
THE Living Emotivehad recognized her own lack of control.
And across Existence, in the past and present and future, entities made their choices and took their actions, each one adding weight to scales whose final balance would determine everything.
The countdown continued.
The Fallout approached.
And Existence held its breath, waiting to see if anyone would be left standing when the dust finally settled.
Inevitability was coming. Midnight was coming.
The only question was whether anyone was truly ready to face it.

chapters.title: Chapter 4596 - 25 Seconds To Midnight III
paragraphs: In The Infinite Unfurling.
In Ginnungagap.
In The Primordial Genesis Shore.
For Noah, the goal to survive The Fallout had always been centered on achieving the power ofThe Level One Scale of Existence.
THE classification.

This had always been the fundamental objective as all the traversals that Noah had undertaken in the past and everything he continued to do in the present was designed to make absolutely certain that he did not experience tremendous catastrophic loss whenTHE Loomfinally activated and The Fallout began.

Before he had left his Civilization to venture into the past, Riya had continued to tell him with growing concern how she felt the light of Mana that represented their entire Civilization dimming from Existence.
But now that he had attained the knowledge and developing control of The First Tongue, he knew innately with absolute conviction that Mana would never truly fade.
The First Tongue would never fade.

Of course, something similar applied to The Primordial Civilizations and the ancient entities who held such Civilizations at their foundation. They also could not be entirely collapsed or erased because they were too deeply woven into the fundamental fabric of Existence itself.
At this moment, as he looked at the imprisoned figure ofTHE Maelstrom Thundermanetrapped in the cage, seeing the reduced state of such a powerful entity brought so low...
Noah turned to faceUl’morethdirectly, his eyes shining with determination and building hunger for challenge.

|Existence is a struggle,| he began with voice carrying conviction. |The First Tongue is a struggle. Every aspect of advancement requires effort and confrontation with forces greater than oneself. Now that I have been given these tools, these letters and understanding, I wish to actually use them in genuine combat alongside internal practice.|
He paused before speaking the truly shocking request.

|Would it be possible to arrange for me to fight against the weakest THE level entity currently bound in any of these cages? I want to test myself against The Level One Scale of Existence while I am still firmly below it.|
BOOM!
The request hung in the air with tremendous weight.
Ul’morethlaughed jovially at the audacious words while his gaze remained fixed on Noah with what felt like measuring assessment beneath all that obscuring hair.
When he responded, his voice carried even more depth than usual.

|Struggle, Little Anomaly. You speak of struggle as if it is merely something to endure or overcome. But struggle is actually the catalyst that accelerates the processes of your Existence to become exponentially faster. The more one genuinely struggles, the more one puts sincere effort into confronting forces that should by all rights overwhelm them, the more rapidly their foundation solidifies and their capabilities expand.|

|This is a fundamental principle of how Existence operates. Comfort breeds stagnation. Safety breeds complacency. But genuine struggle, where collapse is a real possibility and victory is uncertain, where every component of your being must operate at maximum capacity simply to survive? That breeds transcendent growth that no amount of peaceful cultivation can match.|
His hairy form seemed to pulse with approval.

|Let me explain the very essence of what power a THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity actually possesses, and why this creates a gap so immense that it theoretically makes crossing it impossible for those of the lower Scale who do not have that fundamental Civilizational Depth.|

|When an entity achieves THE classification at any Depth, they have crossed a threshold where their Civilization becomes more real than conventional reality itself. In himself!

Noah’s eyes lit up with intense curiosity at this revelation as he asked with eager interest.
|When was the last time this happened? When was the last time someone below THE classification fought against THE here?|
Ul’moreth’spresence seemed to carry dark amusement mixed with respect as he responded.

|We only discovered the truth later, after the battle had concluded and the mysterious entity departed. It turned out to be a weapon that THE Secretive Eon had personally forged and was testing in genuine combat conditions. An absolute beast of a creation that, while firmly at Pre-THE classification in terms of its Civilizational Depth, was somehow capable of fighting against THE level opponents with shocking effectiveness.|

|That weapon survived three consecutive battles against THE Surface Depth entities before THE Secretive Eon retrieved it and vanished. We never learned what techniques or principles allowed it to bridge the gap so effectively. But you, Little Anomaly, will be attempting something similar through your mastery of The First Tongue rather than through whatever secret methods THE Secretive Eon employed.|

|Hoho...would this make me similar to THE Secretive Eon? Hmm...Let us see if you can match or exceed what that mysterious weapon accomplished. Let us see if The First Tongue truly can serve as the bridge that allows the impossible to become merely difficult.|
Noah stared at the cage with building anticipation, his entire Existence buzzing with the eighteen Phonemes continuously refining his foundation.
He was about to challenge The Level One Scale of Existence itself!

chapters.title: Chapter 4597: Struggle! I
paragraphs: An unknown number of Gigaparsecs away from The Primordial Genesis Shore where Noah stood staring at a cage containing aTHElevel entity he would soon battle, in a vastly different region of Ginnungagap’s chaotic expanse, another scene was reaching its conclusion.
This region was filled with obsidian rivers of concentrated instability that would shred Pre-THE Existences into component particles within moments of contact.

Tor and THE Living Originfloated victoriously over the three Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms they had been fighting, their opponents now shockingly bound by chains of Hunger and Origin that wrapped around their malformed bodies with crushing authority.

Tor’s obsidian crimson chains pulsed with devouring intent, constantly attempting to consume the Existence of those they held. THE Living Origin’s white gold chains glowed with the principle of reduction, forcing the bound entities back toward their most fundamental state.

Even though these were Ginnu Lifeforms fully capable of using The First Tongue and were operating in Ginnungagap where they faced no suppression from Existence itself, they still had not been able to stand successfully againstTor and THE Living Origin.
Two entities who were actually experiencing a level of environmental suppression themselves due to not being native to this region.
It was genuinely terrifying to think about the power differential that had manifested.
Tor looked down at the bound Ginnu Lifeforms with eyes shining with hunger as he spoke with voice carrying predatory satisfaction.
"I want to eat them. Three whole Ginnu Lifeforms would be an absolutely magnificent feast. Do you have any idea how much my Hunger would grow from consuming entities this ancient and powerful?"
THE Living Originsighed with exasperation as she replied with calm patience.

"You know you absolutely cannot eat them, you reckless thing. Eat them, and a THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty Ginnu Lifeform will be hunting us down with single-minded dedication. I will leave so very quickly if you actually try it. You can face that wrath alone."
Tor’s face twisted with annoyance as he responded with reluctant acceptance.
"Whatever. We will leave them bound here and continue on our search. Someone will find them eventually and release them once we are long gone from..."
In the middle of his reply, as he was casually talking, his expression suddenly changed dramatically.
His eyes widened as his gaze snapped toward one particular obsidian river passageway with alarm flashing across his features.
At that exact moment, brilliant purple obsidian light erupted from the river as a stream of concentrated temporal authority bloomed with overwhelming presence.
Someone stepped out from the river of time itself, their humanoid form burning and completely shrouded with terrifying purple obsidian flames that flickered with impossible patterns.
The entity’s face could barely be seen beneath the concentrated fire, only hints of features visible through the blazing energy.

They stood tall, perhaps seven feet in height, with a build that suggested both power and elegant refinement. The purple obsidian flames covering their body were not chaotic but moved with deliberate purpose, as if each flicker was precisely calculated.

What could be glimpsed of their face showed sharp, aristocratic features and eyes that burned with concentrated purple light. Those eyes held the weight of countless eras, the accumulated knowledge of someone who could observe time from outside its normal flow.

The very space around this entity seemed to bend and warp, not from raw power but from temporal distortion. Past and future flickered around their form, creating afterimages that showed them in different positions simultaneously.
The moment they appeared,THE Living Originspoke with unusual caution in her normally confident voice.
"Why are you here?"
The aflame being smiled while looking at her with a gaze of calmness, as if watching a slightly grown up child who still had much to learn.
When he spoke, his voice carried grand and imposing weight that resonated across multiple temporal frequencies.

"The better question is not why, dear Origin, but rather when. I will say that something quite interesting drew me here specifically to this point in time. Not to this location particularly, but to this precise moment in time. Fascinating, is it not?"
Something drew him here. At this point in time specifically.
The emphasis on temporal specificity instantly causedTHE Living Origin and Torto become somber as they could only think of one particular anomaly who had been traversing through time.
In the heavy silence that followed,THE Living Originlooked at this being with calculating focus as she spoke carefully.
"What do you mean something drew you to this time specifically? Have you not been existing in this time like the rest of us? Where have you been? No, the better question is when have you been?"

The entity filled with a terrifying Depth of power that had to be at minimumTHE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereigntylooked atTHE Living Origincalmly with that unsettling smile still fixed on his barely visible features.
His reply came with imposing weight.

"Time, Origin. Time is so critical for Existence that most entities fail to truly comprehend its significance. They experience it linearly, flowing from past to present to future like water running down a hill. They are trapped in the current, unable to see the river from above, unable to understand the full scope of what time actually represents."

"Many fail to realize that if someone held genuine sway over time itself, if they could move through its currents with the same freedom that you move through space, they could accomplish so much that would otherwise be completely impossible."
His purple flames intensified as he continued.

"I personally do not do too much with my capabilities. I observe, I maintain, I ensure certain boundaries are respected. But because I exist with this power, I prevent all others from being capable of violating Existence through temporal manipulation. I protect Existence to continue on as it should, maintaining the integrity of causality itself."
His smile grew slightly wider.

"If there was someone freely traversing through time who was not me, who was making changes or observations or interventions across the timeline, that would be quite problematic, would it not? It would suggest my fundamental role had been compromised somehow."
The faces ofTor and THE Living Originbecame noticeably heavy as they watched this terrifying being, both of them thinking of the same individual who had been moving through time recently.
The aflame entity smiled once again and laughed with voice carrying strange mirth.

"Hey, why do you two look so guilty? Relax! You personally had nothing to do with any violation of time. Nobody has actually violated time’s integrity in any meaningful way. You both can relax your guard."
His tone shifted to something more casual and familiar.

"Origin, since when did you become so strung up and nervous? Who is this new company you keep apart from THE Creature? You even stayed deliberately away from Paradox and the others recently, which I found curious. But no matter. What are you doing wandering around Ginnungagap at this time? Do you need help with something? I could assist if necessary."
THE Living Originshook her head calmly as she replied with carefully measured words.

"Nope. We should be perfectly fine on our own, just strolling around while trying to learn more regarding The Origins of Existence itself. Ginnungagap is an excellent place for such research and exploration."
At such words, the aflame entity smiled devilishly while remaining uncomfortably silent, his burning gaze fixed on her with knowing intensity.
Tor’seyes narrowed dangerously as this being simply nodded after a few seconds and spoke with casual finality.

"I see. Understood completely. If you ever need any help with your... research, I will be around these parts at this particular time. Just call out to me and I will appear. After all, we have to stick together in our little exclusive club, do we not? Those of us operating at this Scale must maintain certain bonds."
With such words, he simply disappeared.
Not through space but through time itself, his form flickering out of the present moment and returning to whatever temporal location he currently called home.
Tor immediately spoke with voice mixing annoyance and grudging respect.
"Is that The Temporal fucker I’ve heard many THEs scared shitless of?"
THE Living Originnodded as she replied with simple confirmation.
"Yes. He goes by many names across different eras and regions, but yes, I suppose Temporal fucker can certainly be counted as one of them."
At such words,Torsmiled widely as he spoke with teasing tone.
"Oh, the pristine Living Origin using such vulgar language? Am I actually rubbing off on you after all this time together?"
THE Living Origin’scalm reply carried her usual composed tone.

"The only thing you are rubbing off on me is your general distaste for caution and attraction to danger. Let us keep moving. The more time passes that we do not find him, the more precarious our entire situation becomes. And please try not to talk so much."
Tor’s reply came with broad smile as he began whistling while floating behind Origin.
"The day I stop talking because some prude tells me to is the day I will collapse my own Hunger out of boredom. You just try to keep up with me."
With such words,THE First Hungerdisappeared into the chaotic rivers with casual speed.
THE Living Originfollowed calmly a moment later, leaving behind three bound Ginnu Lifeforms to be discovered eventually.
But moments after they departed, from the exact area they had left, silent purple obsidian flames flickered again as if they had never actually left at all.
And truly, they never had left.
Yet the perceptions of the terrifyingTor and THE Living Origin, both entities atTHEclassification with tremendous sensory capabilities, had not been able to detect the continued presence.

The outline of the entity surrounded by temporal flames could be seen clearly observing the direction where they had just disappeared, his mouth showing a devilish smile as his eyes were filled with immense calculating calm.
He had never left.
He had simply made them perceive that he left.
And now he watched them go, knowing far more about their true purpose than they suspected.
In Existence, there were those who were powerful.
Entities who had reachedTHEclassification, who wielded Civilizational Authority that could reshape reality, who commanded forces that could collapse lesser beings with casual gestures.
These were the titans that others feared and respected, the beings whose names were spoken with reverence or terror.
And then, beyond that already rarefied tier, there were those who were unfathomably powerful.
Entities operating on scales that made evenTHEclassification seem limited by comparison. Beings whose capabilities transcended conventional understanding of what power could accomplish.
Sometimes, many of those who considered themselves powerful would never know when they stood in the presence of someone operating at that unfathomably powerful level.
They would look such entities in the eye, speak with them as equals, and never realize the true gulf that separated them.
Because the truly unfathomably powerful did not need to display their capabilities obviously. They did not need to intimidate or threaten or demonstrate superiority.
They simply existed, quietly observing, occasionally intervening, always knowing far more than they revealed.
This was the nature of true power.
Not the ability to destroy, but the ability to know. Not the capacity to fight, but the capacity to observe without being observed in return.
The Temporal entity smiled, and the smile was gloriously devilish!

We should be perfectly fine on our own, just strolling around while trying to learn more regarding The Origins of Existence itself.
Ginnungagap is an excellent place for such research and exploration."
At such words, the aflame entity smiled devilishly while remaining uncomfortably silent, his burning gaze fixed on her with knowing intensity.
Tor’seyes narrowed dangerously as this being simply nodded after a few seconds and spoke with casual finality.
"I see.
Understood completely.
If you ever need any help with your... research, I will be around these parts at this particular time.
Just call out to me and I will appear.
After all, we have to stick together in our little exclusive club, do we not?
Those of us operating at this Scale must maintain certain bonds."
With such words, he simply disappeared.
Not through space but through time itself, his form flickering out of the present moment and returning to whatever temporal location he currently called home.
Tor immediately spoke with voice mixing annoyance and grudging respect.
"Is that The Temporal fucker I’ve heard many THEs scared shitless of?"
THE Living Originnodded as she replied with simple confirmation.
"Yes.
He goes by many names across different eras and regions, but yes, I suppose Temporal fucker can certainly be counted as one of them."
At such words,Torsmiled widely as he spoke with teasing tone.
"Oh, the pristine Living Origin using such vulgar language?
Am I actually rubbing off on you after all this time together?"
THE Living Origin’scalm reply carried her usual composed tone.
"The only thing you are rubbing off on me is your general distaste for caution and attraction to danger.
Let us keep moving.
The more time passes that we do not find him, the more precarious our entire situation becomes.
And please try not to talk so much."
Tor’s reply came with broad smile as he began whistling while floating behind Origin.
"The day I stop talking because some prude tells me to is the day I will collapse my own Hunger out of boredom.
You just try to keep up with me."
With such words,THE First Hungerdisappeared into the chaotic rivers with casual speed.
THE Living Originfollowed calmly a moment later, leaving behind three bound Ginnu Lifeforms to be discovered eventually.
But moments after they departed, from the exact area they had left, silent purple obsidian flames flickered again as if they had never actually left at all.
And truly, they never had left.
Yet the perceptions of the terrifyingTor and THE Living Origin, both entities atTHEclassification with tremendous sensory capabilities, had not been able to detect the continued presence.

The outline of the entity surrounded by temporal flames could be seen clearly observing the direction where they had just disappeared, his mouth showing a devilish smile as his eyes were filled with immense calculating calm.
He had never left.
He had simply made them perceive that he left.
And now he watched them go, knowing far more about their true purpose than they suspected.
In Existence, there were those who were powerful.
Entities who had reachedTHEclassification, who wielded Civilizational Authority that could reshape reality, who commanded forces that could collapse lesser beings with casual gestures.
These were the titans that others feared and respected, the beings whose names were spoken with reverence or terror.
And then, beyond that already rarefied tier, there were those who were unfathomably powerful.
Entities operating on scales that made evenTHEclassification seem limited by comparison.
Beings whose capabilities transcended conventional understanding of what power could accomplish.
Sometimes, many of those who considered themselves powerful would never know when they stood in the presence of someone operating at that unfathomably powerful level.
They would look such entities in the eye, speak with them as equals, and never realize the true gulf that separated them.
Because the truly unfathomably powerful did not need to display their capabilities obviously.
They did not need to intimidate or threaten or demonstrate superiority.
They simply existed, quietly observing, occasionally intervening, always knowing far more than they revealed.
This was the nature of true power.
Not the ability to destroy, but the ability to know.
Not the capacity to fight, but the capacity to observe without being observed in return.
The Temporal entity smiled, and the smile was gloriously devilish!

chapters.title: Chapter 4598: Struggle! II
paragraphs: In The Primordial Genesis Shore, the settlement of ancient Ginnu Lifeforms continued its bustling activity as something exceptional was about to unfold.
The entity thatUl’morethhad stood before and chosen for Noah to fight against was being brought out from confinement.

A THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty Ginnu Lifeform, their malformed body rippling with concentrated authority, opened the cage reinforced by Logos and extracted the prisoner with chains of obsidian light.

The entity being released possessed the form of a human with a completely bald head and torn white robes that suggested monastic origins. A set of round purple rosaries was wrapped around his neck, completing the appearance of a warrior monk who had seen better days.

His eyes crackled continuously with purple lightning, the energy dancing across his irises with contained violence. Tendrils of lightning coursed over his fair skin in intricate patterns, creating a network of electrical pathways that pulsed with his heartbeat.

The eyes of this being were filled with extreme caution even as he was released from the cage. With his senses no longer obscured by the linguistic bindings, he could now feel the terrifying cluster of power concentrated in this settlement.
Many Ginnu Lifeforms surrounded the arena area, and he could sense with absolute certainty that they could all thrash him individually without tremendous effort.
Especially the hairy entity looking toward him with silent assessment.
A single casual slap from that particular creature felt like it could end his Existence completely.
Noah looked at this being with analytical focus as he activated his Lens of Civilization to examine his opponent.
A status sheet bloomed before his vision, half of the information clearly visible while the other half remained obscured behind question marks.
|Name: Raijin Katsuro|
|Titles: THE Monk of Ten Thousand Storms and The Purple Lightning Ascetic|
|Classification: THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Way: The Way of Heavenly Lightning|
|Genesis Principles: ???|
|Singularity Principles: ???|
|Grand Principles: ???|
|Weaknesses: ???|
|Additional Information: ???|
Noah looked at this partially revealed information with genuine surprise.

He had not expected to see any information at all on someone who had veiled themselves, especially someone atTHEclassification. But his Lens of Civilization seemed to be advancing alongside his overall Existence.

Even now, the terrifying Phonemes of The First Tongue were flowing continuously across his Existence in automated practice, elevatingTHE Foundation of The First Tongueand accelerating the development ofTHE Organ of Civilization.
He currently felt exuberant with building power as at this time,Ul’morethstepped forward toward the imprisoned entity who would serve as his opponent.
The ancient Ginnu Lifeform’s presence radiated overwhelming authority as he addressed Raijin Katsuro directly with intent to be understood.

"Listen carefully to the terms of your release," Ul’moreth began with voice carrying absolute dominance. "If you fight one hundred battles in this arena, battles where you demonstrate your full capabilities without holding back, you can go free. Your sentence will be considered served and you may leave Ginnungagap entirely if you wish."

"Your opponent for this particular battle will be a Pre-THE Existence. But you need to fight with absolute full power as if you are facing anyone else at your Scale or higher. If you hold back in any way, if you do not use your complete capabilities, the battle will not count toward your total. And instead of continuing with other opponents, you will have to fight with me next."
BOOM!
The threat hung heavy in the air.
Raijin Katsuro’s expression became somber and filled with genuine fear as he looked toward Noah with conflicted emotions.
His voice carried cautious concern when he finally spoke.

"What if I accidentally collapse this Pre-THE opponent with my full power? Surely fighting at THE level against someone below that Scale will result in their immediate destruction. I do not wish to needlessly end an Existence."
Ul’moreth’sreply came with calm indifference.

"Nothing of consequence will happen to you if you collapse your opponent. Just fight with all your power as instructed. If you collapse your opponent, then you collapse your opponent. That is acceptable."
Raijin Katsuro’s expression became even more grim as the implications settled over him.

This young entity apparently stood among the Ginnu Lifeforms with enough favor that they would be completely okay if he was collapsed in this arena? Get the fuck out of here. Collapsing him would likely be collapsing a Ginnu Lifeform.
And it was Pre-THE versus THE classification. What result did they realistically expect apart from complete one-sided domination?
The entire situation felt designed to humiliate him.
Ul’morethlaughed jovially at the prisoner’s obvious distress as he waved dismissively.
"Do not worry too much about the details. Just go and fight!"
With such words, Ul’moreth waved his hairy hand with casual gesture.
Obsidian gold light wrapped around both Noah and Raijin Katsuro as they were both instantly deposited on opposite ends of the arena floor.
Noah took a moment to observe his surroundings with enhanced perception.

This ancient and archaic arena possessed a deceptively simple construction. The floor appeared smooth and was seemingly made from some type of wood, though Noah suspected the material was far more sophisticated than it appeared.
The walls rising around the arena’s perimeter were constructed from the same material, creating an enclosed space that felt both primitive and incredibly advanced simultaneously.
Noah looked down at the smooth floor beneath his feet, noting that it held no visible damage despite what must have been countless battles fought here over eons.
As his perception sharpened, he began to see why.
Logos were inscribed throughout the entire structure in patterns so intricate and sophisticated that he could barely begin to understand their full complexity.
The power these linguistic inscriptions emanated was enough to stand strong against even a THE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity attacking the structure directly.
He heardUl’moreth’svoice speaking directly into his mind at this moment through their connection.

|Many of the Logos you see are similar to what I showed you on the prison cages, as the arena itself was designed to be nearly indestructible and completely contain whatever forces are unleashed within it.|

|The first major Logos woven throughout the floor and walls combines the Phonemes of Earth, Order, and Unity. It establishes the principle of absolute structural integrity, ensuring that all components of the arena maintain cohesion regardless of the forces applied to them. The wood you see is not truly wood but compressed Existence shaped into this form and held together by linguistic authority.|

|The second Logos, glowing faintly throughout the structure, uses Space, Division, and Beginning. It grants the arena qualities of spatial expansion so that even though it appears to be merely a few dozen meters in diameter when inactive, when properly activated it transforms into its own isolated domain that extends for Gigaparsecs in all directions. You and your opponent will have essentially unlimited space to battle without constraints.|

|The third Logos combines Void, Ending, and Darkness. It ensures that all power erupting within the arena’s boundaries is completely contained inside its periphery and cannot escape or be directly observed by those watching from outside. We will see what occurs through the arena’s own perception filters, but the actual forces involved will not reach us. This protects spectators while allowing combatants to fight without worrying about collateral damage.|

|The fourth Logos uses Time, Order, and Life. It maintains proper causality within the domain and prevents temporal manipulation from disrupting the flow of battle. It also includes regenerative properties that slowly repair any damage that does manage to affect the structure itself.|

|There are seven other Logos inscribed here with various purposes, but those are the primary ones you need to understand. This arena is essentially a living construct designed specifically to facilitate battles between THE level entities without destroying the surrounding settlement.|
Ul’moreth’svoice took on more serious tone as he continued.

|Your enemy will fight at full power, and they absolutely should for this to be a real battle worth learning from. They should not be able to collapse you too quickly because the fundamental mismatch will be partially bridged by your use of The First Tongue. But I cannot guarantee your survival, Little Anomaly.|

|If I see you on the very edge of complete and irreversible collapse, I will intervene and end the battle immediately. But if you are collapsing just a tiny bit, if you are merely injured or damaged but still capable of continuing, I may leave you be and allow the struggle to continue. After all, you have to learn how to fly by being pushed from the nest. You have to struggle genuinely to grow meaningfully.|
Noah smiled with understanding as he knew this truth well from his own experiences.
He looked toward his opponent in the distance, separated by what currently appeared to be about thirty meters but would soon expand to Gigaparsecs.
Raijin Katsuro stood with extremely hardened expression, his entire posture radiating offense and disrespect.

He seemed to feel deeply humiliated to actually be placed in an arena with what he considered a weak Pre-THE Existence and told to fight at full power with apparently no repercussions for whatever occurred.
For an entity who had achieved THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty through dedicated cultivation, this matchup felt like a deliberate insult to his capabilities.
At this moment,Ul’moreth’svoice suddenly echoed out across the entire arena and settlement with amplified authority.
|Alright, alright everyone! A genuinely interesting match is about to begin! Pay close attention!|
In the surroundings beyond the arena, many powerful Ginnu Lifeforms who had already been gathered here to observe the ongoing battles now focused their attention with shining eyes full of curiosity.
Ul’morethfloated above the arena’s center with commanding presence as he addressed the assembled crowd in calm and dominant fashion.

|Today, you will witness something extraordinarily rare! A violation of conventional understanding itself as an entity that has not attained any Depth of Absolute Sovereignty whatsoever goes against one who has reached THE Surface Depth! This type of matchup almost never occurs because the outcome seems predetermined. But circumstances today allow for this exception, and it will be educational for all of you to pay very close attention to how this battle unfolds!|

The Ginnu Lifeforms watching bellowed out their excited affirmation in The First Tongue, their voices creating linguistic patterns that made Existence itself buzz with the expression of their collective power.
The sound was overwhelming, reality trembling from hundreds of ancient entities speaking simultaneously in the language of creation.
Ul’morethlaughed with satisfaction at their enthusiasm before raising one hairy hand and speaking the critical command.
|Activate The Primordial Genesis Arena!|
The moment those words were spoken, everything changed.
Noah watched with fascinated attention as the Logos inscribed throughout the floor and surrounding walls suddenly pulsed with brilliant light and began to move like living snakes.
The linguistic patterns slithered and rearranged themselves, activating in sequence as the arena’s true nature revealed itself.
This seemingly small arena they stood on, this modest space that appeared to be only a few dozen meters across, instantly expanded with reality-warping force.
Noah felt the spatial transformation occurring around him as he suddenly found himself standing atop an endlessly massive arena stretching out for Gigaparsecs in all directions.
The smooth wooden floor extended toward horizons so distant they could not be seen even with his enhanced perception.
The figures of Ul’moreth and all the other watching Ginnu Lifeforms completely faded from view as if they had never existed.
The space above transformed into obsidian blue sky that stretched infinitely upward, creating the impression of standing in a void between Existences.
The walls of the arena were so impossibly far away that the ends of this smooth battlefield could not be perceived at all.
It felt as if the entire domain contained only him and his opponent looking at each other across vast distance.
No distractions. No audience visible to create pressure or self-consciousness.
They seemed to be completely isolated in this place, free to battle with absolute full power without concern for anything beyond their conflict.
Though for Noah, it meant he was now locked in an isolated domain spanning Gigaparsecs with a THE level entity as his opponent.
And yet his Existence held no fear whatsoever.
Only anticipation. It would undoubtedly be difficult and filled with hardship!
His body buzzed with the continuous flow of eighteen Phonemes refining his foundation.
THE Foundation of The First Tonguehummed with readiness.
Across the vast distance, purple lightning began to crackle more intensely around Raijin Katsuro!

chapters.title: Chapter 4599: Struggle! III
paragraphs: Noah had fought many battles across his journey through Existence, but the battle he was about to engage in now was something that anyone with common sense would immediately scoff at.
Going againstTHEclassification.
He knew it would be immensely difficult to face someone atThe Level One Scale of Existence.
He knew he would be placed in an immense struggle filled with genuine pain and the real possibility of collapse. He understood these truths intellectually.
But he had to do it regardless. He had to struggle, to push himself beyond reasonable limits, so that his people could live when The Fallout finally arrived.
It was wild to imagine that he was actually attempting this as at this moment, Raijin Katsuro gazed at him with utmost coldness across the vast arena.
The monk’s bearing as a prisoner completely disappeared as he pulsed with a sense of glorious majesty that had been suppressed during confinement.

Purple lightning began coursing around his body with increasing intensity as Noah felt a terrifying sense of oppression erupting from this entity, causing his own body to experience both trepidation and excitement simultaneously.
Yeah. This wasTHEclassification.

A power level he had run away from in the past when survival had demanded retreat. But not today. Regardless of the sense of trepidation screaming through his Existence, today he would face it directly.

At this moment, Raijin Katsuro raised one hand and began playing with tendrils of purple gold lightning that represented his Way of Existence, his voice carrying imposing weight across the vast distance.

"I am Raijin Katsuro, THE Monk of Ten Thousand Storms. I came to Ginnungagap deliberately to challenge myself against the legendary Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms, to test my cultivation against entities who understand Existence at fundamental levels. When I was defeated and imprisoned, I understood clearly that it was due to my own lack of power and depth. I accepted my sentence without complaint."

"Even while jailed, I waited patiently to battle again as I suspected this would eventually be my purpose here. But the battles I was waiting for, the opponents I expected to face, for my first match to actually be against a weak Pre-THE Existence who is not even a Ginnu Lifeform himself..."
His expression twisted with genuine anger.
"It makes me so unbelievably furious. So profoundly insulted that I can barely contain my rage at this arrangement."
BOOM!
Purple lightning exploded around his form as he continued speaking with building intensity.

"I can see clearly that there is some form of relationship between you and the Ginnu Lifeforms here, some connection that grants you favor. And that they actually plan to use me, a THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity, as merely a whetstone to sharpen you like a dull blade being prepared for future use. This alone infuriates me beyond words."

"Do you understand how it feels to forge your own Way through dedicated effort, to build your Sovereignty through countless trials, to achieve THE classification through genuine struggle, only to be used as a stone to sharpen someone else? This whole situation is utterly baffling and deeply offensive to everything I have accomplished."
His eyes blazed with purple gold radiance.

"But since that terrifying entity commanded me to unleash my full power without holding back, I will do exactly that. Since this is supposedly a real battle for your development, I will treat it like one with absolute seriousness. I will show you the unbridgeable gap between our positions faithfully and professionally. I will go for collapsing your Existence completely, or at least ninety-nine percent of it at minimum. Do you understand the situation you have placed yourself in?"
Noah looked at this being as warning signals screamed through every component of his Existence.

Raijin Katsuro now appeared wreathed in purple lightning that pulsed with internal hues of gold, creating a spectacular display of concentrated power. His eyes released rivers of terrifying Sovereignty, authority so concentrated it became visible as flowing energy.
It felt like he held absolute control over everything at this moment, like reality itself bent to acknowledge his dominance.
Noah’s Existence screamed danger warnings at him, as if all parts of his being instinctively recognized they were being locked onto by an apex predator.
Raijin’s voice continued with dark satisfaction at Noah’s obvious tension.

"My Way, my Civilization, my Sovereignty over Existence itself. Someone that has not achieved any Depth in Absolute Sovereignty would never even begin to truly understand what this means. Do you know why you cannot comprehend it? Because as I have been talking, explaining myself and giving you time to prepare, every single Weaving of Existence in the surrounding landscape across Gigaparsecs has already fallen under my Sovereignty."
BOOM!
Instantly, Noah felt an overbearing and unfathomably heavy weight pressing down from all directions simultaneously.
The smooth floor beneath his feet, the obsidian blue sky above, the air itself, everything within perception suddenly crackled with purple gold lightning that had not been there moments before.
Raijin’s expression looked almost forlorn as he shook his head with what might have been pity.

|In this place, within the reach of my Sovereignty, I am the only thing that is now inevitable. I am the only certainty. If you had any Depth of Absolute Sovereignty at all, even the smallest foundation of civilizational authority, you might have been able to fight with me on equal terms regarding this. To express your own view and impose your own Way against mine. But you have no Depth whatsoever. I alone control all Weavings of Existence in this nearby expanse, and I alone say what can and cannot occur. And right now, there can be no expression of Sovereignty but my own. BOOM!

The Sovereignty was suffocating, overwhelming, absolute.
The moment Raijin’s words finished speaking, Noah found himself unable to do anything but feel the terrifying Depth of Heavenly Lightning pressing against every component of his being.
Even when his Existence buzzed with resistance, even when every refined cell and nerve cried out in defiance, absolutely everything felt horrifically suppressed.
His Existence that had been reinforced by The First Tongue, that had been refined by eighteen Phonemes flowing continuously through his foundation, actually showed a glimmer of genuine resistance.
For a brief moment, THEFoundation of The First Tonguepushed back against the imposed Sovereignty with linguistic authority.
But he had only just begun this process of reinforcement.THE Foundation of The First Tonguehad only just started to be properly established.
It was still young, still developing, still accumulating the necessary Depth to stand against THE classification.

Noah felt like all of Existence itself bore down on him with crushing intent. Contrary to his mental commands, contrary to him thinki his body reinforced by The First Tongue would have sufficient resistance yo at least stabd against THE classification...
BOOM!
His Barrier of Hunger, that defensive construct he had relied on many times, shattered like glass under the weight of imposed Sovereignty.
And an instant later, before he could even process that failure...
BOOM!
Noah felt his knees, against all his will and intention, hit the smooth floor of The Primordial Genesis Arena with devastating force.
What?
His knees? On the floor? Him? Kneeling?
Him?!
The shock of it crashed through his consciousness with intensity.
Raijin looked down at Noah while wreathed in magnificent purple gold lightning, his voice carrying dark satisfaction.

"What did you think would happen when you stood against THE classification? This is an entirely different Scale of Existence from anything you have experienced before. Did you genuinely think you would be capable of some form of meaningful opposition? To deny THE? Denying THE is functionally equivalent to denying Existence itself."

It is that simple. Why do you have that expression as if this should not have happened? What else could have possibly occurred? You have no Depth to resist with. This is the gulf, and this is the discrepancy between me and you. Between THE and Pre-THE. It is like I am facing a helpless child at this moment."
His voice grew colder.

"This profound mismatch was the reason for my shame and fury and disrespect at being placed against you. Let me have you feel exactly the same helplessness and humiliation I experienced. Remain kneeling. Do not even attempt to look up at me. You cannot even gaze upon THE with that weak foundation. Stare at that floor beneath you and reflect on your insignificance. Do not speak. Do not do anything. Just feel that absolute helplessness, and it will give you a small glimpse of how I felt when I was imprisoned and bound."
BOOM!
Noah’s Existence buzzed at this moment with unprecedented fervor as everything about his being cried out in furious rejection.
He had knownTHEclassification was grand and powerful beyond normal comprehension. He had thought his extensive preparations had been somewhat sufficient to at least stand.
He had thoughtUl’moreth’swords about needing to Master all eighteen Phonemes to stand against THE were guidelines, that he would somehow be an exception due to his unique advantages.
But for him to be forced onto his knees? To be made to kneel against his will?
New prompts erupted before his vision with critical information.
|For the first time in your cultivation journey, your Quintessence has been challenged in an inviolable way.|
|Your fundamental nature as an entity who kneels to no one has been directly violated.|
|If you do not overcome this challenge to your Quintessence, this core distinction will be forever lost from your Weavings.|
|Your identity as one who stands regardless of opposition is at stake.|
|OVERCOME OR BE DIMINISHED.|
The weight of those words crashed through Noah’s consciousness as he stared at the smooth floor beneath him, feeling the crushing Sovereignty of THE pressing down from all directions.
His knees were on the ground.
He was kneeling.
And somewhere deep within his Existence, something fundamental began to burn with absolute refusal to accept this state!

He knew it would be immensely difficult to face someone atThe Level One Scale of Existence.
He knew he would be placed in an immense struggle filled with genuine pain and the real possibility of collapse.
He understood these truths intellectually.
But he had to do it regardless.
He had to struggle, to push himself beyond reasonable limits, so that his people could live when The Fallout finally arrived.
It was wild to imagine that he was actually attempting this as at this moment, Raijin Katsuro gazed at him with utmost coldness across the vast arena.
The monk’s bearing as a prisoner completely disappeared as he pulsed with a sense of glorious majesty that had been suppressed during confinement.

Purple lightning began coursing around his body with increasing intensity as Noah felt a terrifying sense of oppression erupting from this entity, causing his own body to experience both trepidation and excitement simultaneously.
Yeah.
This wasTHEclassification.
A power level he had run away from in the past when survival had demanded retreat.
But not today.
Regardless of the sense of trepidation screaming through his Existence, today he would face it directly.

At this moment, Raijin Katsuro raised one hand and began playing with tendrils of purple gold lightning that represented his Way of Existence, his voice carrying imposing weight across the vast distance.
"I am Raijin Katsuro, THE Monk of Ten Thousand Storms.
I came to Ginnungagap deliberately to challenge myself against the legendary Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms, to test my cultivation against entities who understand Existence at fundamental levels.
When I was defeated and imprisoned, I understood clearly that it was due to my own lack of power and depth.
I accepted my sentence without complaint."
"Even while jailed, I waited patiently to battle again as I suspected this would eventually be my purpose here.
But the battles I was waiting for, the opponents I expected to face, for my first match to actually be against a weak Pre-THE Existence who is not even a Ginnu Lifeform himself..."
His expression twisted with genuine anger.
"It makes me so unbelievably furious.
So profoundly insulted that I can barely contain my rage at this arrangement."
BOOM!
Purple lightning exploded around his form as he continued speaking with building intensity.
"I can see clearly that there is some form of relationship between you and the Ginnu Lifeforms here, some connection that grants you favor.
And that they actually plan to use me, a THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity, as merely a whetstone to sharpen you like a dull blade being prepared for future use.
This alone infuriates me beyond words."

"Do you understand how it feels to forge your own Way through dedicated effort, to build your Sovereignty through countless trials, to achieve THE classification through genuine struggle, only to be used as a stone to sharpen someone else?

His eyes blazed with purple gold radiance.

Do you understand the situation you have placed yourself in?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4600: Struggle! IV
paragraphs: Noah’s mind burned with the wordsUl’morethhad spoken, the teaching that now felt more relevant than anything else.

It was not merely that THE classification entities were stronger than those below them. That would be simple to understand, a quantitative difference that could theoretically be overcome through sufficient accumulation of power.
No, the true terror was that they operated on a fundamentally different layer of Existence where normal rules did not constrain them the same way.

The First Tongue, Ul’morethhad explained with absolute conviction, could act as a bridge to cross that vast Depth. To equalize the fundamental imbalance. Because The First Tongue was the language that defined what reality actually was at a level deeper than even THE classification authority could easily override.
Those were the words of Ul’moreth!
Noah had thought his forming Foundation of The First Tongue would be sufficient to at least resist THE classification, to stand on his feet before he utilized The First Tongue externally itself.
He wanted to feel this weight. Ideally, he had to feel the true weight of THE so that he had a baseline for what to overcome.
Unless one actually felt the full oppression of THE classification pressing against them with crushing intent, they would never fully understand what it truly meant.

And being brought to his knees for the first time in his entire Existence, having his fundamental Quintessence questioned and violated, this truly allowed him to feel the genuine power of THE with visceral clarity.
But feeling that power also gave him understanding he had not possessed before.
From his kneeling position, staring at the smooth floor as commanded, Noah focused inward with desperate intensity.
He felt his Foundation,THE Foundation of The First Tongue, actively resisting the imposed Sovereignty even now.
He feltTHE Organ of Civilizationpulsing with rejection of the external authority trying to define him asTHE Rudimentary Units of Everythingburned.
They were fighting, struggling against the weight pressing down from all directions.
But the refinement they had received so far was simply too limited. Barely any time had passed since he began fortifying himself with the eighteen Phonemes.
They had not yet crossed the threshold necessary to be fully capable of resisting THE Civilizational Authority the way he wanted.
His Foundation was too young, too undeveloped, insufficient for the impossible task before him.
But The First Tongue itself was the bridge. The bridge to cross this vast chasm that separated THE from Pre-THE, the gap that many would fail to overcome their entire lives.
And Noah held The First Tongue not as a borrowed tool but as his fundamental Way.
His consciousness focused with laser precision on the eighteen Phonemes flowing continuously through his Existence.
Fire. Water. Earth. Air. Void. Light. Darkness. Life. Death. Time. Space. Order. Chaos. Unity. Division. Beginning. Ending. Paradox.
The complete alphabet of Existence itself resided within him, even if his mastery remained at Novice Speaker level.
Yes, Raijin Katsuro controlled all of Existence within this arena through his Civilizational Authority. That was the power ofTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
But Noah held The First Tongue itself. He held The Way of Mana, the undifferentiated source from which all specialization emerged.
So he held The First Tongue not as something external to channel but as something fundamental to his being.
And even though conventional Existence was under the control of another entity, was The First Tongue not asserting that all of Existence itself stemmed from this original language?
Was he not cultivating the very foundation from which even Civilizational Authority ultimately derived its power?
So he did not need to ask permission to stand. He did not need to beg for the right to speak or move or act.
He simply needed to speak The First Tongue and assert his own reality according to the original grammar that preceded all other rules.
HUUM!
Noah’s will crystallized with absolute determination as he began internally speaking the Phonemes with unprecedented intensity.

Fire erupted first within his Existence, not the physical phenomenon but the principle of transformation and refusal to be extinguished. Blue gold flames that represented his connection to Mana itself.
Then Earth manifested, providing foundational stability that refused to be moved. The principle that some things endure regardless of external pressure.
Air followed, the concept of freedom and movement, the assertion that restriction was not absolute.
One by one, all eighteen Phonemes activated with synchronized purpose, each one adding their voice to his rejection of the imposed reality.
They began to express themselves outwardly despite the Sovereignty pressing down from all directions.
Around Noah’s kneeling form, reality itself began to shimmer and distort as linguistic authority manifested visibly.

Characters of The First Tongue, glowing with multicolored radiance, began appearing in the air around his body. Each Phoneme took visible form as complex symbols that pulsed with concentrated meaning.
The Phoneme of Fire burned with blue gold flames.
The Phoneme of Water flowed with silver blue liquid light.
The Phoneme of Earth manifested as bronze geometric patterns...
All eighteen letters of Existence’s alphabet materialized around him, creating a sphere of linguistic authority that pushed back against the purple gold lightning imposing Raijin’s will.
The two realities collided with visible force.
Purple gold lightning crackled and sparked where it met the multicolored radiance of The First Tongue, neither completely overwhelming the other.
Raijin Katsuro’s eyes gradually opened wider with genuine somberness as he witnessed this unbelievable scene.
This Pre-THE entity, this being without any Depth of Absolute Sovereignty, was somehow resisting his command to remain kneeling.
How?

The Phonemes surrounding Noah grew brighter as his internal utterance intensified. The linguistic symbols began rotating around his form in complex patterns, creating grammatical structures that asserted new truths.
I can stand.
I will stand.
I must stand.
Not requests. Not pleas. Simple declarations in the original language that created reality itself.
Noah felt his body responding to these linguistic commands even as Raijin’s Sovereignty tried to hold him down.
His muscles, which had been locked in place by external will, began to move according to his own intention once more.
Slowly, with tremendous effort, Noah’s hands pressed against the smooth floor.
The Phonemes surrounding him pulsed with concentrated authority, each one lending its particular principles to his struggle.

Fire giving him the will to resist. Earth providing stability. Air granting freedom of movement. Unity binding all his components together. Beginning initiating the action. Paradox allowing the impossible.
His arms trembled with exertion as he pushed upward against the crushing weight ofTHE Civilizational Authority.
The purple gold lightning intensified, trying to force him back down.
But the multicolored radiance of The First Tongue blazed brighter in response, creating visible cracks in the imposed reality.
Inch by inch, Noah’s body rose from the kneeling position.
The eighteen Phonemes spun faster around him, creating a vortex of linguistic power that carved out a space where his will could assert itself.
Raijin’s expression shifted from contempt to disbelief as he watched this entity that should have been completely helpless somehow finding the strength to defyTHEitself.
Noah’s knees lifted off the ground as he transitioned from kneeling to crouching.
Then, with final tremendous effort, surrounded by the blazing alphabet of Existence itself, he stood fully upright!
BOOM!
The Phonemes arranged themselves in a glorious display around his standing form, creating visible barriers between him and the imposed Sovereignty attempting to crush him back down.
He looked directly at Raijin Katsuro with imperious gaze that refused to be diminished, his eyes blazing with blue gold radiance mixed with all eighteen colors of The First Tongue.
When he spoke, his voice carried the weight of linguistic authority that superseded conventional power hierarchies.
|I am Noah Osmont, and I kneel to no one. Not to THE, not to any authority, not to Existence itself. My Way demands that I stand.|
HUUM!
As if he was saying this never fucking happened. His momentary kneeling never fucking happened!
He paused, his gaze growing colder as he continued.
|I thank you genuinely for providing this challenge, Raijin Katsuro. But you will have to fall on your knees soon to rectify what has happened here. This I declare in The First Tongue.|
As those words left his mouth, new prompts erupted before his vision with crystalline clarity.
|UNFATHOMABLE EFFORT EXERTED|
|Quintessence is being reinstated and reinforced beyond previous limits.|
|Your fundamental nature has been challenged and has emerged stronger.|
|New absolute rule integrated: Never again can you be forced to kneel against your will.|
|Your very Existence demands it as inviolable truth.|
|Fight. FIGHT. FIGHT!|
BOOM!
The word echoed through his entire being as something fundamental shifted within THE Foundation of The First Tongue.
The eighteen Phonemes surrounding him blazed with unprecedented brilliance as his Foundation took on new depth from this struggle.
Across the vast arena, Raijin Katsuro’s expression had transformed completely from contempt to genuine seriousness.
His purple gold lightning crackled with renewed intensity!
What the fuck was this?!
