Across the vast arena, Raijin Katsuro’s expression had transformed completely from contempt to genuine seriousness.
His purple gold lightning crackled with renewed intensity!
What the fuck was this?!

chapters.title: Chapter 4601: The First Lesson I
paragraphs: He stood.
As the overwhelming pressure ofTHE Civilizational Authoritybore down upon him from all directions, he stood.
This alone was a terrifying act of defiance that should not have been possible.
Noah could see the shocked gaze of Raijin Katsuro fixed on him, those purple gold eyes wide with disbelief.

This being looked like he desperately wanted to break into the usual dialogue of "What is this? How is this possible? Did you hide your true power all along?" or any other sort of predictable bullshit that entities always spouted when confronted with the unexpected.
But Noah was utterly tired of all the endless talking.
He needed to focus with absolute concentration, and he needed tangible results immediately.
What he was doing right now was only barely gaining the capability to stand againstTHE Civilizational Authoritywithout being crushed. That was it. Nothing more.

He realized with crystal clarity howTHE Foundation of The First Tonguewas still in its earliest stages of emergence, how the process of his entire Existence being refined by The First Tongue and him mastering the Phonemes was proceeding slowly.
It was naturally a slow and grueling process. That was the nature of Existence itself.Slow, grinding, heavy.
Across his entire journey through cultivation, the one resource he always fundamentally lacked was time.
He had come to The Earliest Folds and now The Infinite Unfurling precisely because he did not have sufficient time in his original era.
But there was a place that could give him time. Vast amounts of accelerated time.
Time to practice The First Tongue extensively. Time to refine his being through concentrated effort.
At this moment, he found himself thinking of something he had not yet wished to fully commit to, but which would now be absolutely ideal and necessary for survival.
So he asked the question internally with decisive focus.
’What is the current state ofTHE Infinite Desmoterionbeing forged withinTHE Organ of Civilization?’
THE Infinite Desmoterion.
A Sovereign Prison Domain forged within him by taking direct reference fromTHE Northern Unfurling Node of Existence of THE Creature.
His Organ had developed significantly since that construct was first initiated. Where was its advancement now?
Clean and crisp prompts materialized before his vision with updated specifications.
|The Infinite Desmoterion - Updated Status|
|THE Organ of CivilizationDevelopment: 18.00%|
|Temporal Dilation: 10,000x faster than external reality|
|Maximum Prisoner Capacity: 18 entities with established Sovereignties|
|Current Prisoners: 0/18|
|Maintenance Cost: 10 Rudimentary Units of Everything per 24 hours (inactive until prisoners held)|
|Domain Stability: Absolute|
|All other core features remain operational as designed.|
At such words revealing the current parameters, a decisive light flashed in Noah’s eyes as he spoke with absolute conviction.
"I have a prisoner for The Desmoterion."
New prompts appeared immediately in response.
|Review of combat records indicates Master has not defeated any viable prisoners with established Sovereignties yet.|
|No entities meeting imprisonment criteria detected.|
Yet Noah’s reply came without hesitation as he clarified his intention.

"I have. I have kept them inside my Existence this entire trip through time. They will not truly be a traditional prisoner as I want to make the first genuine prisoner this fucker standing before me. But at this moment, for this unique purpose, let The Infinite Hunger reside in a new home. Let Ozymandias enter THE Infinite Desmoterion as its first occupant, and let me buy myself the time I desperately need. Ten thousand seconds in The Desmoterion for every single second out here in reality. Time to practice The First Tongue extensively. Time to advance my Way at accelerated pace."
Ruination seemed stunned into complete silence at the audacity and implications of what he was proposing.
After several moments, her voice returned with warning.
|This action is irreversible once initiated. Your counterpart, Ozymandias will be permanently bound to The Desmoterion.|
"Yes."
Ruination said nothing more, recognizing that his decision had already been made with full awareness.
He had to be ruthless in order to overcome the challenges Existence placed before him.
He could be ruthless to others when necessary, but more critically, he needed to be ruthless to himself.
He needed time, so he would create time through whatever means available.

He had been contemplating this specific action for a while as Ozymandias had stayed peacefully within his Existence since he first arrived in The Infinite Unfurling. Now, he was simply pulling the trigger on a decision that had been forming for some time.
New prompts bloomed with official confirmation.
|Prisoner Designation Accepted|
|Subject: Ozymandias, The Infinite Hunger|
|Classification: Paradoxical Entity - Another body of yours that is simultaneously you and yet not you|
|Follows: The Way of Mana and Hunger|
|Civilization: The Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger|
|Status: Deemed defeated and subordinate under your Weavings of Existence|
|Imprisonment Initiated|
|Transferring subject to THE Infinite Desmoterion...|
|Transfer complete.|
|Active Prisoners: 1/18|
|Maintenance Cost: Now active - 10 Rudimentary Units of Everything per 24 hours|
|Temporal Dilation: 10,000x operational|
|Special Notation|
|Subject Ozymandias represents a paradoxical part of yourself imprisoned for mutual advancement.|
|Resistance to Mana influence: None (identical Way and Civilization)|
|Cultivation cooperation: Perfect synchronization|
|All advancement made by Ozymandias in The Way of Mana and Hunger will reflect as direct enhancement to Master’s Way of Mana and Hunger.|
|Refinement efficiency: Unprecedented due to being essentially the same Existence.|
WAA!

Thereafter, Noah, while still surrounded by the blazing Phonemes of The First Tongue creating protective barriers around his standing form, closed his eyes with focused intention as he ignored the shocked Raijin Katsuro who had begun speaking again with demands for explanation.
But Noah did not listen to a single word.
After he closed his eyes, his consciousness focused inward on his mind where a certain magnificent Organ spun with concentrated authority.
THE Organ of Civilization.
And inside of it, in a space that existed beyond normal dimensions,THE Infinite Desmoterionmanifested.
The domain possessed undeniable qualities of both Mana and Hunger woven into its fundamental structure.
The space itself was vast, stretching for what appeared to be endless Gigaparsecs in all directions. The sky above pulsed with blue gold radiance that represented pure Mana given visual form.
The ground below was formed from crystallized Hunger, dark obsidian surfaces that seemed to devour light itself.
At this moment, in a central region of this new prison domain, vibrant blue gold chains hung suspended in the air, binding nothing yet as they waited for true prisoners to restrain.
Ozymandias could be seen standing unbound in the center of the space.
His obsidian gold humanoid visage, formed from countless writhing tentacles that maintained coherent shape, turned slowly as he examined his new home with calm acceptance.
With expression showing no distress or complaint, only serene focus, Ozymandias began uttering the Phonemes of The First Tongue with methodical precision.
Fire. Water. Earth. Air. Void. Light. Darkness. Life. Death. Time. Space. Order. Chaos. Unity. Division. Beginning. Ending. Paradox.

The complete alphabet of Existence flowed from his being as the Phonemes began to manifest around him in visible form, creating the same multicolored radiance that surrounded Noah in the external arena.
Inside THE Infinite Desmoterion. Inside THE Organ of Civilization itself!
The cultivation of The First Tongue had truly begun at accelerated temporal flow.
BOOM!
As such a terrifying wonder unfolded in the space within his Organ, Noah opened his eyes back in the external arena.
Already, he could feel the difference immediately.
The Phonemes of The First Tongue surrounding his physical form seemed to shine noticeably brighter, pulsing with increased authority and refined structure.
New prompts materialized with extraordinary implications.
|Unprecedented Cultivation Age Initiated|
|An unprecedented era of accelerated cultivation has been ushered within THE Organ of Civilization.|
|The First Tongue is being actively utilized and practiced in a unique domain of extreme temporal dilation.|
|All advancements made by Ozymandias in The Way of Mana and Hunger will directly elevate The Way of Mana.|
|All refinements achieved in mastery of The First Tongue’s Phonemes will immediately reflect in Master’s capabilities.|
|Current Temporal Ratio: 10,000:1|
|Effective result:For every 1 second in external reality, 10,000 seconds (2.78 hours) of First Tongue practice occurs within The Desmoterion.|
|Mastery progression of all eighteen Core Phonemes accelerating exponentially.|
|Foundation Advancement Accelerated|
|THE Foundation of The First Tongue is being refined at unprecedented pace.|
|Your resistance to THE Civilizational Authority is continuously increasing.|
|Estimated time to reach Fluent Speaker classification: Dramatically reduced.|
|Synergistic Cooperation Detected|
|Ozymandias is practicing The First Tongue with perfect dedication.|
|Unique circumstance: Imprisoned entity is paradoxically part of yourself, creating perfect synchronization.|
|Result: Efficiency multiplied exponentially beyond normal Desmoterion parameters.|
|This configuration represents the ideal template - imprisoning aspects of yourself for accelerated mutual growth.|
After Noah finished reading these profound prompts detailing the significance of what he had just initiated, he now fully turned his gaze toward the stern figure of Raijin Katsuro.
The warrior monk’s expression had grown increasingly dark with anger at being completely ignored during what should have been a critical confrontation.
Raijin’s voice erupted with genuine fury.
"Did you fucking hear me?!"
Noah looked at this being that he knew with absolute certainty would be unfathomably difficult to even stand against in genuine combat, much less actually defeat.
But even acknowledging that overwhelming power gap, he simply shook his head with calm dismissal as he spoke with voice carrying no fear whatsoever.
After all.
This was existence.
Existence was unfair. Existence was a struggle.
Existence...simply was.

"No, I did not hear you, nor do I particularly care what you were saying. Let us get a move on with this battle. Let us see the full display of what THE classification can truly accomplish when unleashed without restraint."
His eyes blazed with multicolored radiance as the Phonemes surrounding him pulsed with building intensity.
Inside The Desmoterion, Ozymandias continued his relentless practice.
Outside, Noah prepared to face the full wrath ofTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
And every passing second gave him hours of advancement that would make the impossible merely difficult!

chapters.title: Chapter 4602: The First Lesson II
paragraphs: Each of the Phonemes of The First Tongue surrounding Noah’s body allowed him to feel a distinct sense of protection againstTHE Civilizational Authority of Heavenly Lightningpressing down from all directions.

Fire provided the will to resist being extinguished. Earth granted foundational stability that refused to be moved. Air represented freedom from constraint. Unity bound all his components together against external force.
Even now, Raijin’s overwhelming Sovereignty continued to be exerted onto his Existence with crushing intent, commanding him to kneel and submit.
And yet the surging Phonemes of The First Tongue denied this exertion of power, creating barriers of linguistic authority that operated on principles deeper than Civilizational Authority alone.
Raijin’s expression became noticeably heavy as he observed this continued resistance.
After several moments of contemplative silence, he nodded with what might have been grudging respect and spoke with voice carrying building intensity.

"There are oddities everywhere in Existence, I suppose. You have managed to bear the mere expression of my Sovereignty without collapsing, which is noteworthy for someone with no Depth whatsoever. Very well. I will not be tied down fighting conservatively against an entity lacking Civilizational Authority, so let me show you what actual power looks like. Begone."
HUUM!
The moment that word left his mouth, booming drums began to play across the vast arena as if reality itself had become an orchestra.
A glorious symphony kicked off with building crescendo as the sky above transformed.
In the surroundings spanning Gigaparsecs in all directions, colorful lightning began descending like drops of rain to batter everything below.
Purple. Gold. White. Violet. Amber. Colors that should not exist in electrical phenomena cascaded down with beautiful and terrifying majesty.
And each tendril of lightning carried unique power, an undeniable brilliance that could be felt resonating through Existence itself at fundamental levels.
The moment this transformed lightning appeared and began its descent...
BOOM!
Half of the Phonemes surrounding Noah were instantly crushed and shattered as if they had never existed.
The protective barriers of linguistic authority simply could not withstand the overwhelming force being brought to bear.
The pressure Noah felt increased tenfold in a single instant as he struggled to maintain his standing position.

He kept his expression outwardly calm despite the internal alarms screaming through his Existence, his consciousness immediately moving to utter more Phonemes of The First Tongue to replace those that were shattered.
Fire. Earth. Air. Water. Void....
But as soon as they began forming around him...
CRACK!
Any newly formed Phonemes were immediately cracked and splintered under the overbearing pressure of the descending lightning before they could fully manifest their protective effects.
New prompts appeared with critical information.
|All currently expressed Phonemes around your form have the passive support of Grand and Singularity Principles from nearby Existence.|
|However, at this time, the grandeur of a Genesis Principle has manifested in the expression of Raijin’s Civilizational Authority of Heavenly Lightning.|
|Genesis Principle Detected: The Principle of the Unstoppable Storm|
|Classification: Genesis Principle combining concepts of Heavenly Authority, Elemental Dominance, and Purifying Destruction|
|Effect: All lightning manifested carries the weight of existential judgment and the authority of natural disaster elevated to conceptual absolute|

|Because a Genesis Principle itself is fundamentally composed of complex expressions of The First Tongue at the Logos level and beyond, even though it is being utilized crudely and without conscious understanding by Raijin, it still represents a form of more sophisticated linguistic construction than individual Phonemes.|
|Your own Phonemes will continue to be broken with increasing intensity if nothing changes in your approach.|
|Individual letters cannot withstand complete words backed by Genesis authority.|
If nothing changes.
Okay.
Noah’s mind processed this information with crystal clarity even as more Phonemes shattered around him.
He had not elected to fight a THE level entity first without having some semblance of a plan in mind.

He could have taken the safer route of fighting multiple Pre-THE entities, imprisoning them one by one in The Desmoterion, and working his way up gradually to face THE classification after extensive preparation.
But where was the Quintessence in such cautious progression? And more critically, he simply did not have the time for such methodical advancement.
If he wanted genuine pressure to forge himself stronger, here was pressure in abundance.
If he wanted to struggle in ways that would catalyze explosive growth, here was struggle of the highest order.
Here was Existence itself testing him!
Now, he simply needed to be forged and reborn anew in the fires of this impossible challenge.
While Phonemes continued to break around him in cascading failures, while he formed them continuously only to watch them shatter moments later, his eyes flashed with decisive determination.
He knew all eighteen letters of The First Tongue’s alphabet. He had personally practiced each Phoneme internally.
And he had seen a few complete words, the Logos of The First Tongue inscribed on the prisons and throughout this very arena.
He had observed their structure, their grammatical patterns, how individual letters combined into meaningful expressions.

And as the seconds passed here in external reality, Ozymandias inside The Desmoterion had already undergone hours of new understanding and practice of The First Tongue under extreme temporal dilation.
That knowledge flowed back into Noah’s own comprehension through their paradoxical connection.
Now, even if he was not a natural genius at The First Tongue, he had given himself time through Ozymandias.
And with enough time, one did not need to be a genius to eventually exceed.
So at this moment, Noah raised his right hand and focused his will with absolute precision.
On his fingertip, a Phoneme of Fire appeared, blazing with concentrated blue gold radiance.
As it manifested, he thought carefully about what Ul’moreth had mentioned regarding Inscription of The First Tongue.
The technique was mainly used on objects like weapons or armor, mostly on anything other than one’s own Existence.
Because forcing The First Tongue onto living beings who were not aligned with it risked catastrophic collapse.
But he was fundamentally different from other entities.
His Existence itself was perfectly aligned with the very letters he wanted to inscribe because his Way was Mana, which was The First Tongue in its undifferentiated form.

So even though he knew absolutely nothing about the formal techniques of Inscription of The First Tongue, even though he had not learned any proper methodology from Ul’moreth, why could he not simply decide for himself what method to use?
After all, he was Mana. His Way was Mana. His Way was The First Tongue itself.
Could he really not do something as conceptually simple as writing his own native language onto himself?
So at this critical moment, he made his decision.
He would use his finger as his pen. The Phoneme of Fire blazing on his fingertip would serve as his ink.
And he would write directly onto his own flesh.
Noah’s thought process crystallized with perfect clarity as colorful lightning continued raining down around him.
Since there was lightning threatening to collapse him, he needed to protect himself from electrical phenomena.
So he simply had to arrange the correct sequence and variations of Phonemes to spell out a complete word, a Logos that would provide the protection he required.
A word that most closely translated to the concept ofInsulation.
Being protected from electrical flow. Being rendered immune to lightning’s destructive passage through matter.
His mind worked rapidly to construct the proper linguistic pattern.
He would need the Phoneme of Void, representing separation and the space between things that prevents interaction.
The Phoneme of Division, creating distinction between himself and external forces.
The Phoneme of Ending, terminating the flow of energy before it could affect him.
The Phoneme of Order, establishing the rule that electricity could not pass through.
And the Phoneme of Unity, binding these concepts together into coherent whole.
Five Phonemes arranged in specific grammatical structure to create...The Logos of Insulation!

He could have taken the safer route of fighting multiple Pre-THE entities, imprisoning them one by one in The Desmoterion, and working his way up gradually to face THE classification after extensive preparation.
But where was the Quintessence in such cautious progression?
And more critically, he simply did not have the time for such methodical advancement.
If he wanted genuine pressure to forge himself stronger, here was pressure in abundance.
If he wanted to struggle in ways that would catalyze explosive growth, here was struggle of the highest order.
Here was Existence itself testing him!
Now, he simply needed to be forged and reborn anew in the fires of this impossible challenge.
While Phonemes continued to break around him in cascading failures, while he formed them continuously only to watch them shatter moments later, his eyes flashed with decisive determination.
He knew all eighteen letters of The First Tongue’s alphabet.
He had personally practiced each Phoneme internally.
And he had seen a few complete words, the Logos of The First Tongue inscribed on the prisons and throughout this very arena.
He had observed their structure, their grammatical patterns, how individual letters combined into meaningful expressions.

And as the seconds passed here in external reality, Ozymandias inside The Desmoterion had already undergone hours of new understanding and practice of The First Tongue under extreme temporal dilation.
That knowledge flowed back into Noah’s own comprehension through their paradoxical connection.
Now, even if he was not a natural genius at The First Tongue, he had given himself time through Ozymandias.
And with enough time, one did not need to be a genius to eventually exceed.
So at this moment, Noah raised his right hand and focused his will with absolute precision.
On his fingertip, a Phoneme of Fire appeared, blazing with concentrated blue gold radiance.
As it manifested, he thought carefully about what Ul’moreth had mentioned regarding Inscription of The First Tongue.
The technique was mainly used on objects like weapons or armor, mostly on anything other than one’s own Existence.
Because forcing The First Tongue onto living beings who were not aligned with it risked catastrophic collapse.
But he was fundamentally different from other entities.
His Existence itself was perfectly aligned with the very letters he wanted to inscribe because his Way was Mana, which was The First Tongue in its undifferentiated form.

So even though he knew absolutely nothing about the formal techniques of Inscription of The First Tongue, even though he had not learned any proper methodology from Ul’moreth, why could he not simply decide for himself what method to use?
After all, he was Mana.
His Way was Mana.
His Way was The First Tongue itself.
Could he really not do something as conceptually simple as writing his own native language onto himself?
So at this critical moment, he made his decision.
He would use his finger as his pen.
The Phoneme of Fire blazing on his fingertip would serve as his ink.
And he would write directly onto his own flesh.
Noah’s thought process crystallized with perfect clarity as colorful lightning continued raining down around him.
Since there was lightning threatening to collapse him, he needed to protect himself from electrical phenomena.
So he simply had to arrange the correct sequence and variations of Phonemes to spell out a complete word, a Logos that would provide the protection he required.
A word that most closely translated to the concept ofInsulation.
Being protected from electrical flow.
Being rendered immune to lightning’s destructive passage through matter.
His mind worked rapidly to construct the proper linguistic pattern.
He would need the Phoneme of Void, representing separation and the space between things that prevents interaction.
The Phoneme of Division, creating distinction between himself and external forces.
The Phoneme of Ending, terminating the flow of energy before it could affect him.
The Phoneme of Order, establishing the rule that electricity could not pass through.
And the Phoneme of Unity, binding these concepts together into coherent whole.
Five Phonemes arranged in specific grammatical structure to create...The Logos of Insulation!

chapters.title: Chapter 4603: The First Lesson III
paragraphs: Noah envisioned the complete word in his mind first, seeing how each letter connected to the next, how the grammatical flow created meaning beyond what individual components could express.
Then, with the blazing Phoneme of Fire serving as his writing implement, he began inscribing directly onto the back of his left hand.
His finger moved with deliberate precision, tracing the first character.
Void manifested as acircular patternthat seemed to contain infinite depth.
Then Division, represented by alinethat separated the circle into distinct halves.
Ending appeared as apointof termination, the grammatical period that concluded expression.
Order took form as geometricpatternsestablishing consistent rules.
And finally Unity, flowing curves that bound all the previous characters into unified whole.
As Noah inscribed each component of the Logos onto his own flesh using fire as his medium, Existence itself began to vibrate with unprecedented intensity.
The arena floor hummed. The distant walls resonated. Reality trembled at what was occurring.
The Logos of Insulation, written in The First Tongue, seamlessly melded with his Existence as if it had always belonged there.
In the next moment, a unique eruption of brilliance unfolded and illuminated the entire vast region of the arena.
Noah’s body momentarily turned glass-like, becoming translucent as the inscribed Logos integrated at cellular and conceptual levels simultaneously!
Light blazed from within him as transformation occurred.
New prompts materialized with glorious implications.
|Unprecedented Achievement|
|A Logos has been correctly constructed and inscribed onto your Existence simultaneously.|
|An unfathomable effort worthy of even more unfathomable harvest.|
|No recorded precedent exists for this methodology.|
|Inscription Modus Operandi Established|
|The Somatic Inscription Method has been attempted successfully for the first time.|
|Mechanism: Using one’s own body as canvas and Phonemes as ink to inscribe Logos directly onto Existence.|
|Only viable for entities whose Way is perfectly aligned with The First Tongue.|
|Proceed with extreme caution for future inscriptions.|
|Logos Successfully Formed and Branded|
|The Logos of Insulation has been inscribed onto your left hand.|
|The simultaneous formation and Inscription has activated a complex mix of supporting Principles.|
|Supporting Framework: 10 Grand and Singularity Principles providing foundational structure|
|Passive Genesis Principle Support Detected: The Principle of Existential Boundary|
|Genesis Principle Effect: Establishes absolute barriers between distinct states of being, ensuring separation remains inviolable at conceptual level|
|New Capability Acquired|
|Due to the inscribed Logos of Insulation, you have gained complete Immunity to all lightning-based Principles and Sovereignties ofTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.|
|Electrical phenomena cannot affect you regardless of source or intensity.|
|Classification: Selective Elemental Immunity|
|This immunity is permanent as long as the Logos remains intact.|
|The Logos draws continuous power from supporting Principles rather than your personal reserves.|
BOOM!
The prompts were unfathomably glorious in their implications.

And as a consequence of feeling their profound majesty, of experiencing the radiant Logos and the unique power it brought surging through his Existence, Noah’s concentration wavered for a critical moment.
The rest of the Phonemes of The First Tongue that had been protecting him from the descending lightning shattered completely.
He had nothing left to stop the radiant onslaught ofTHE Civilizational Authority of Heavenly Lightningfilled with the overwhelming power of a Genesis Principle as it rained down toward him.
The attack crashed down with devastating force.
Time seemed to slow as the vibrant waves of colorful lightning descended.
Purple tendrils crackling with judgment. Gold streamers carrying the weight of THE authority. White bolts pulsing with purifying destruction!
Oh!
All of it converged on Noah’s standing form as Raijin watched with expectation of witnessing the beginning of total collapse.
The thick tendrils of Genesis Principle-enhanced lightning smashed into Noah’s body with tremendous impact.
The electrical force coursed through him, seeking to unmake his Existence from the inside out.
But then, impossibly, the lightning splashed outward onto the surroundings as if striking rubber or an impenetrable barrier.
Noah remained standing completely unharmed.
A full devastating attack from aTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentity wielding Heavenly Lightning backed by a Genesis Principle had crashed directly onto him.
And his left hand shone brilliantly as the inscribed Logos of Insulation pulsed with authority, supported by the light of The Genesis Principle of Existential Boundary.
The Genesis Principle backing his defense heavily denied and completely nullified the expression of Raijin’s overwhelming Sovereignty.
Noah’s eyes shone brightly with satisfaction as he remained utterly calm in the face of what should have been annihilation.
He flexed the hand bearing the inscribed Logos, watching it pulse with linguistic power.
When he spoke, his voice carried quiet triumph.
"Now...we are getting somewhere meaningful."
HUUM!
Yes. This was the path forward.
Nobody else could accomplish what he had just done, combining formation and inscription of a Logos onto their own Existence in the midst of battle.
The First Tongue was indeed the bridge he could assemble to breach the impossible gap againstTHEclassification.
At this moment, he felt like he was finally, truly building that bridge with his own hands.
The first successfully formed and inscribed Logos served as a glorious pillar of foundation for everything to come.
The Phonemes and the Logos of The First Tongue were the answer to surviving and eventually defeating THE.
He had constructed one word. Now he needed to forge more and ensure that in this battle, he could not merely defend but also meaningfully attack and breach THE classification’s defenses!
He needed to look at an entity of The Level One Scale of Existence standing impossibly high above him and prove himself capable of dragging that entity down to his level!

Outside of The Primordial Genesis Arena, in the space where hundreds of powerful Ginnu Lifeforms had gathered to observe the unprecedented battle, there were no shouts or bellows of excitement at how events were unfolding.
There was not a single entity screaming about the extraordinary fact that someone who had not attainedTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntywas actually standing up against someone who had.

There was just an immense and heavy silence blanketing the entire gathering as the Ginnu Lifeforms remained focused with laser intensity on Noah’s left hand where he had inscribed a Logos directly onto his own flesh.
They replayed the outrageous thing he had accomplished in their minds again and again, analyzing every component of what they had witnessed.
This was the reason for the profound silence in the surroundings.
No excitement. No celebration. Just stunned contemplation.
At this moment in the skies above the arena, watching this entire spectacle unfold with his own ancient awareness, floatedUl’moreth.
Suddenly, a THEIntermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentity appeared beside him without warning.

The newcomer possessed the form of a crimson-skinned humanoid with outstretched horns curving backward from her temples. Her entire body radiated concentrated authority that marked her as one of the more powerful entities in this settlement.
When she spoke, her voice carried genuine confusion mixed with respect.

"Sir Ul’moreth, was that just now a new form of Inscription of The First Tongue that we do not know about? Did Sir Ul’moreth design this innovative methodology and pass it on to your student? What exactly is it? How does it function?"
The questions hung heavy in the air with tremendous weight.
And Ul’moreth, for perhaps the first time in eons, did not have a satisfactory answer to provide.
Because just like all the others gathered here, he was also witnessing all of this for the very first time.
His student had created something entirely new!

chapters.title: Chapter 4604: The First Lesson IV
paragraphs: Inside The Primordial Genesis Arena, lightning continued to fall all around Noah’s position like judgment made manifest.
But gloriously, the crushing immensity and overwhelming weight that should have been forcing him to his knees could no longer be felt pressing against his Existence.
The inscribed Logos of Insulation on his left hand pulsed with steady brilliance as it performed its function flawlessly.
However, the power descending still held a sense of tremendous weight that was being received and processed by the vibrant Logos.

Even though Noah now possessed complete immunity to all lightning-based Sovereignties and Principles, this protection was only fully applicable againstTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentities wielding electrical phenomena.

And even with that immunity functioning perfectly, if one stripped away the specific identity and elemental expression ofThe Way of Heavenly Lightningfrom Raijin’s attacks, the very Weavings of power from an entity atTHE Surface Depthstill held tremendous fundamental weight.
It was like being hit with a hammer that could release lightning. The lightning was nothing crazy, but there was still the weight and physicality of the hammer!
The sheer density of refined Civilizational Authority, the accumulated pressure of a higher Scale of Existence, these elements Noah still had to bear and withstand.
And in the moment that Raijin utilized any forms of attack that were not pure lightning phenomena, Noah would find himself back at square one facing potentially overwhelming force.
But it was still a glorious achievement worth celebrating internally!
The scene was so utterly incredulous that the figure of Raijin Katsuro stood looking at Noah while seemingly at a complete loss for words.
Then his eyes became firm and focused in the next moment as he sensed with absolute clarity the unmistakable aura of a Genesis Principle rotating around Noah’s inscribed hand.
The Principle of Existential Boundary supporting the Logos of Insulation.

Noah was also at this very moment getting accustomed to wielding this new power while simultaneously trying to fully grasp exactly what terrifying capabilities he had called down just from properly arranging words of The First Tongue.
So he did his best to analyze the situation while continuing to actively plan for how to actually take down this overwhelmingly powerful enemy standing before him.
When Noah spoke, his voice carried calm determination.
"No need to express any shock or surprise or even ask how such things are possible. Just wait for me."
Wait for him.
Raijin absolutely did not want to do such a fucking thing as his expression became unfathomably serious with building intent.
Noah kept his gaze fixed on this terrifying being and prepared himself to respond to any incoming attack.
Because at this moment, he was not simply waiting passively.
His mind was actively working at maximum capacity.

He was taking all the gains and insights Ozymandias was continuously making regarding The Way of Existence and increasing proficiency with The First Tongue, then attempting variations of different combinations of Phonemes to form entirely new Logos.
And as he engaged in this linguistic construction, he was also becoming increasingly more perceptive to the structure of his own nurtured and established Principles.

He now felt like he could begin to actually read the underlying Weaving that formed them, the specific Logos composition whether it consisted of a single word or a very complex lengthy expression or even paired words working in grammatical harmony.
He felt like he was extremely close to fully deciphering the linguistic structure of his own Principles.
Of Perpetual Harvest and The Cheating Architect.
And when he finally accomplished that breakthrough, he expected to become capable of modifying the potency and relevancy they held across Existence.
They would no longer remain static Grand or Singularity Principles once he could directly edit their linguistic code.

If he could tweak them the same way he was currently manipulating individual Phonemes, he would witness his Principles ascending to the elevated tier of Genesis Principles through conscious refinement!
But for now, he had more immediate concerns.
His eyes lit up with focused activity as he raised his right hand once more.
The Phoneme of Fire blazed brightly on his fingertip as he had already calculated another viable Logos variation in his mind that seemed entirely feasible to construct.
He began the process of designing it mentally and inscribing it simultaneously onto his body.
Since The First Tongue was the bridge allowing him to stand against THE classification, he had to continue building that bridge relentlessly.

He needed to forge more and more complete words until the linguistic construction was lengthy and sturdy enough for him to stand upon it and look at THE entities without feeling overwhelming trepidation, and he could look up and says...get the fuck down!
His finger moved with practiced precision as he inscribed his second Logos.
This one would provide general defensive capabilities beyond just electrical immunity.

He combined the Phonemes of Earth for foundational stability, Unity for binding his Existence together against fragmenting forces, Order for establishing consistent protective rules, and Ending for terminating incoming attacks before they fully manifested their effects.
The Logos of Fortificationtook shape on his right forearm, glowing with bronze and gold radiance.
|Logos Successfully Inscribed|
|The Logos of Fortificationhas been branded onto your right forearm.|
|Effect: Comprehensive defensive enhancement against all forms of attack of THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Supporting Principles: 8 Grand and Singularity Principles|
|Passive Genesis Support: The Principle of Enduring Foundation|
|Your Existence gains significant resistance to all damage sources of THE Civilizational Authority|
Immediately after completing that inscription, Noah moved to his third Logos without pause.
This one needed to provide offensive capability, the ability to bypass defenses and deal meaningful damage to THE Surface Depth entities.

He combined the Phonemes of Fire for transformative destruction, Division for separating defensive barriers from their targets, Chaos for breaking established patterns of protection, Void for creating spaces where defenses could not exist, and Paradox for allowing attacks to be both resistible and irresistible simultaneously.
The Logos of Penetrationmanifested on his right palm, blazing with multicolored aggressive light.
|Logos Successfully Inscribed|
|The Logos of Penetrationhas been branded onto your right palm.|
|Effect: Offensive attacks bypass conventional defenses and resistances of THE Civilizational Authority|
|Supporting Principles: 12 Grand and Singularity Principles|
|Passive Genesis Support: The Principle of Inevitable Violation|
|Your attacks can somewhat, slightly, and meaningfully damage entities at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.|
For his fourth and final Logos in this initial construction phase, Noah needed something to help bridge the vast power gap more generally.

He combined the Phonemes of Beginning for initiating what should be impossible, Air for freedom from constraints, Light for clarity of purpose and execution, Space for manipulating the distance between power levels, and Unity for bringing disparate elements together into functional whole.
The Logos of Elevationtook form across his chest, shining with radiant white-gold brilliance.
|Logos Successfully Inscribed|
|The Logos of Elevationhas been branded onto your chest.|
|Effect: Temporary elevation of your effective power level when facing superior opponents|
|Supporting Principles: 10 Grand and Singularity Principles|
|Passive Genesis Support: The Principle of Aspirational Transcendence|
|The gap between you and THE classification entities is partially bridged during active combat. Partially.|
HUUUM!
Noah now stood with four distinct Logos inscribed across his body, each one pulsing with its own unique radiance and supported by Genesis Principles operating passively.
His left hand glowed with the defensive Insulation against lightning.
His right forearm shone with the general Fortification against all attacks.
His right palm blazed with the offensive Penetration to breach defenses.
His chest radiated with the power-bridging Elevation.
The brilliance surrounding him had intensified dramatically, creating a visual display of linguistic authority that rivaled even THE classification entities.
At this precise moment, his enemy across the vast arena had not been idle.
Raijin Katsuro had been undergoing his own transformation this entire time, his full Sovereignty now put on complete display without any restraint.

His body had grown to nearly twelve feet in height, muscles defined with purple gold lightning coursing through every fiber. His eyes burned with cosmic radiance. The rosaries around his neck floated independently, each bead pulsing with concentrated Genesis Principle authority.
When he spoke, his voice carried genuine respect mixed with self-recrimination.

"I sincerely apologize for treating you like a mere Pre-THE entity. It seems I was actually facing a THE classification entity playing elaborate games with their apparent power level, and I did not take this battle seriously enough from the beginning. That ends now."
BOOM!
The weight of his fully manifested Sovereignty crashed across the arena with devastating intensity, no longer holding anything back!

|Passive Genesis Support: The Principle of Inevitable Violation|
|Your attacks can somewhat, slightly, and meaningfully damage entities at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.|
For his fourth and final Logos in this initial construction phase, Noah needed something to help bridge the vast power gap more generally.

He combined the Phonemes of Beginning for initiating what should be impossible, Air for freedom from constraints, Light for clarity of purpose and execution, Space for manipulating the distance between power levels, and Unity for bringing disparate elements together into functional whole.
The Logos of Elevationtook form across his chest, shining with radiant white-gold brilliance.
|Logos Successfully Inscribed|
|The Logos of Elevationhas been branded onto your chest.|
|Effect: Temporary elevation of your effective power level when facing superior opponents|
|Supporting Principles: 10 Grand and Singularity Principles|
|Passive Genesis Support: The Principle of Aspirational Transcendence|
|The gap between you and THE classification entities is partially bridged during active combat.
Partially.|
HUUUM!
Noah now stood with four distinct Logos inscribed across his body, each one pulsing with its own unique radiance and supported by Genesis Principles operating passively.
His left hand glowed with the defensive Insulation against lightning.
His right forearm shone with the general Fortification against all attacks.
His right palm blazed with the offensive Penetration to breach defenses.
His chest radiated with the power-bridging Elevation.
The brilliance surrounding him had intensified dramatically, creating a visual display of linguistic authority that rivaled even THE classification entities.
At this precise moment, his enemy across the vast arena had not been idle.
Raijin Katsuro had been undergoing his own transformation this entire time, his full Sovereignty now put on complete display without any restraint.
His body had grown to nearly twelve feet in height, muscles defined with purple gold lightning coursing through every fiber.
His eyes burned with cosmic radiance.
The rosaries around his neck floated independently, each bead pulsing with concentrated Genesis Principle authority.
When he spoke, his voice carried genuine respect mixed with self-recrimination.
"I sincerely apologize for treating you like a mere Pre-THE entity.
It seems I was actually facing a THE classification entity playing elaborate games with their apparent power level, and I did not take this battle seriously enough from the beginning.
That ends now."
BOOM!
The weight of his fully manifested Sovereignty crashed across the arena with devastating intensity, no longer holding anything back!

chapters.title: Chapter 4605: The First Lesson V
paragraphs: How did one suppress a Way of Existence?
This was a fundamental question that entities across all eras and territories had grappled with when facing opponents whose power seemed insurmountable.
The answer, like most profound truths, was both simple and extraordinarily complex.

One could suppress a Way of Existence through overwhelming superiority in the same domain. Fire could be extinguished by greater Fire. Water could be absorbed by vaster Water. This was the brute force approach, requiring exponentially more power than the opponent possessed.

Or one could suppress a Way through opposing principles. Fire countered by Water. Chaos balanced by Order. Lightning grounded by Earth. This was the strategic approach, requiring deep understanding of fundamental interactions.

Or one could suppress a Way by denying it expression entirely. Not through opposition but through removal of the stage upon which it performed. A swordsman rendered ineffective not by superior swordsmanship but by being placed in a space where swords could not exist.
This final method was the most elegant and the most difficult to achieve.
It required understanding not just what the Way was, but what allowed it to function at all.
And then systematically removing those foundational permissions until nothing remained but potential without manifestation.
Inside The Primordial Genesis Arena, Noah’s body moved with building confidence as he became increasingly familiar with the four Logos inscribed across his flesh.
Raijin’s attacks came with devastating variety now that lightning proved ineffective.
The warrior monk had shifted tactics entirely, abandoning his signature element and instead wielding multiple Singularity Principles that had nothing to do with electrical phenomena.

He manifested the Singularity Principle of Crushing Gravity, and Noah felt his bones compress under impossible weight of THE Civilizational Authority until the Logos of Fortification on his forearm blazed brighter and bore the load.

He invoked the Singularity Principle of Spatial Severing, and reality itself tried to cut Noah into component pieces until the Logos of Elevation on his chest elevated his existential density to withstand the attack.

He called upon the Singularity Principle of Temporal Decay with his Civilizational Authority, attempting to age Noah’s Existence into dust across compressed centuries, but the combined defensive Logos held firm against even this assault.
Each attack pushed Noah backward across the vast arena floor, forcing him to give ground despite his inscribed protections.
The Logos absorbed tremendous punishment but could not completely negate the fundamental power differential between Pre-THE and THE classification.
But as Noah defended desperately against this onslaught, he moved to usher in a new wave of possibilities.
He had performed the difficult and nearly impossible task of Inscription first, writing Logos directly onto his own flesh.
But when it came to simply speaking Logos by arranging variations of Phonemes in proper grammatical patterns and uttering them aloud, that came even more naturally to him.
His Way was The First Tongue itself. Speaking it should be as instinctive as breathing.
So as another wave of Spatial Severing crashed toward him, Noah opened his mouth and spoke his first complete Logos in combat.
He combined the Phonemes of Unity, Order, Space, and Ending into the Logos of Coherent Wholeness.
The word left his mouth with concentrated authority, declaring that hisExistence remained unified and could not be separated into pieces.
The Spatial Severing crashed against this spoken declaration and shattered.
Raijin’s eyes widened with shock as his THE Civilizational Authority was casually nullified by a single word.
Noah smiled as understanding flooded through him.
This was it. This was the bridge he needed to build.
Not just inscribed Logos for permanent enhancement, but spoken Logos for dynamic response to whatever the opponent attempted.
He felt like he was constructing that bridge between Pre-THE and THE with every word he spoke, every linguistic pattern he mastered through actual combat application.
Because so often, many entities were too scared to attempt something or convinced themselves they could never accomplish it.
But unless one actually attempted the impossible, they would never discover their true limits.

As Raijin manifested the Singularity Principle of Molecular Disintegration with his THE Civilizational Authority, Noah spoke the Logos of Structural Permanence combining Earth, Life, Order, and Unity.
His body refused to disintegrate because the language of Existence itself declared his structure permanent.

As Raijin invoked the Singularity Principle of Conceptual Erasure attempting to remove Noah from reality’s memory, Noah spoke the Logos of Undeniable Presence combining Light, Beginning, Fire, and Paradox.
Reality could not forget him because his presence was linguistically undeniable.
With each spoken Logos, Noah’s confidence grew exponentially.
And then, as he successfully rebuked another devastating attack fromTHE Surface Depthentity, his figure began moving forward with genuine purpose and building tyranny.
His mind raced with strategic calculation.
How could he actually suppress this THE entity rather than just defending indefinitely?
He did not necessarily need to somehow penetrate Raijin’s defenses and collapse his entire Way. That was far too difficult given the power differential.
But... had he not observed many prisons outside this very arena?
Had Ul’moreth not explained in explicit detail exactly how THE entities were imprisoned using specific Logos working in systematic harmony?
So what if Noah simply adopted that methodology of suppression and created his own personal cage specifically designed to contain THE classification entities?
It was not his personal power making any of this possible. It was the power of The First Tongue itself providing the bridge.
But wasn’t he The First Tongue made manifest? Wasn’t his Way fundamentally identical to the source language?
With this realization crystallizing into decisive action, Noah’s movements became purposeful and rapid.
He began forming the seven Logos that comprised the prison cages exactly as Ul’moreth had explained their structure and function.
The Logos of Absolute Separation combining Void, Division, and Space.
The Logos of Predetermined Failure combining Order, Unity, and Ending.
The Logos of Temporal Constraint combining Time, Beginning, and Order.
Even though these Logos seemed relatively simple with only three Phonemes each, they possessed their own difficulty in proper grammatical construction.
The Logos of Self-Destructive Force combining Fire, Death, and Chaos.
The Logos of Living Structure combining Life, Unity, and Water.
The Logos of Mutual Blindness combining Darkness, Void, and Paradox.
And the Master Keystone Logos combining all eighteen Phonemes in the specific pattern that bound everything together.
After he felt confident he could speak each one with proper pronunciation and grammatical flow, Noah raised his right hand with deliberate intent.
In his palm, something began to manifest.
A stick.
Simple. Unadorned. Wooden in appearance.
A stick.
The Goad. The implement connected directly toTHE Creature’sFirst Lesson, the teaching method used to instruct and discipline those learning fundamental truths.
But at this moment, Noah’s eyes blazed with determination as he spoke aloud with voice carrying absolute conviction.
No longer would it have any connection withTHE Creature.
"This will be my First Lesson to a THE entity. My Goad. My First Lesson."
The moment those words left his mouth, the stick transformed dramatically.
It became filled with his Way, shining with brilliant blue gold radiance that illuminated the entire vast arena.
It burned with pure Primus Mana, the undifferentiated source from which all specialization emerged.
It pulsed with Pure First Tongue, the language of Existence given physical form.
Thereafter, Noah began the process of Inscription.
Using the blazing Phoneme of Fire still active on his fingertip, he started writing the prison Logos directly onto the surface of The Goad.
The first Logos of Absolute Separation manifested along the stick’s length, glowing with deep purple radiance.
The second Logos of Predetermined Failure wrapped around it in silver white spirals.
The third Logos of Temporal Constraint pulsed with golden amber light.
But as Noah inscribed this third Logos, The Goad trembled violently as if the wooden implement could not sustain any additional linguistic weight without shattering.
Noah nodded with understanding. Three inscribed Logos seemed to be the maximum this manifestation could bear.
He proceeded to speak aloud the remaining four prison Logos that Ul’moreth had described and that he himself had observed on the actual cages.
His voice rang out across the arena with building authority.
|Logos of Self-Destructive Force!| The words manifested as crimson and black energy swirling around Raijin’s position.
|Logos of Living Structure!| Emerald green light formed barriers that adapted and flowed.
|Logos of Mutual Blindness!| Pale violet concealment wrapped around the target.
|Master Keystone Logos!| Prismatic radiance bound all seven Logos together into unified whole.
These rulings of The First Tongue, these declarations of how reality would function within their influence, began actively surrounding Raijin Katsuro despite his attempts to resist.
Despite his billowing THE Civilizational Authority!
And as the linguistic prison took shape, Noah raised The Goad high and swung it downward with purposeful force.
The stick enlarged dramatically as it descended, growing to become twice as massive as Raijin’s transformed twelve-foot form.
It had become a weapon of judgment, reality itself condensed into a tool for delivering The First Lesson!
Raijinn roared as the grandeur of a Genesis Principle burned all around him!
HUUUM!
The scene unfolded with terrible beauty.
Noah gradually cornered the THE entity through systematic application of The First Tongue, each spoken and inscribed Logos reducing Raijin’s capacity to express his overwhelming power.
The light of the Gensis Principle he was trying to express could not be fully called out!
The Logos of Absolute Separation prevented him from drawing upon external resources or receiving support from his Civilization.
The Logos of Predetermined Failure ensured any attempt to break free concluded in failure before it could fully manifest.
The Logos of Temporal Constraint locked his perception of time into linear flow, preventing temporal manipulation.
The Logos of Self-Destructive Force turned his own strength against him whenever he attempted to force his Way through the barriers that had begun forming and closing in around him!
His lightning...was becoming contained.
His Sovereignty was becoming suprressed by The First Tongue itself.

He was being told but his glorious Civilizational Authority that could impose itself on existence...could actually not impose itself here. Because an entity had been rewriting the very rulings of Existence to be completely against him. To be specifically against him to the point that he could not even express his authority.

When one stopped to worry whether they could or could not, and they simply changed how existence operated based on the enemy that they faced...the results that could unfold were unfathomably glorious.
The Logos of Living Structure adapted to counter whatever technique he deployed.
The Logos of Mutual Blindness isolated him conceptually from the outside arena.
And the Master Keystone Logos bound all these restrictions together into inescapable whole.
Into a glorious, unfathomable net of The First Tongue.
Until ultimately, after what felt like both an eternity and mere moments, Raijin Katsuro stood frozen.
His entire form surrounded by a radiant blue gold hazy prison formed from The Seven Logos of Imprisonment.
The containment felt eerily similar to the physical cage he had been confined in before, but this one was far more sophisticated because it existed as living language rather than static structure.
He could not see anything outside the linguistic barriers now containing him.
He could not express his Civilizational Authority beyond the boundaries defined by The First Tongue.
He could only stand with expression mixing rage and profound shock at what had been done to him.
At such a moment, the glorious scene played out as if in slow motion.
Noah stood before aTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentity who genuinely could not express their power at this moment because Noah himself had caused such suppression.
Time seemed to slow to a crawl as Noah lifted his First Lesson, his Goad, the stick burning with blue gold Mana and linguistic authority.
He moved it with deliberate precision to Raijin’s shoulder.
Using the implement’s end, he tapped it gently against the warrior monk’s form and then pushed downward with steady pressure.
Not tremendous force. Not overwhelming power.
Just gentle, inexorable insistence backed by seven Logos declaring how reality would function in this space.
Moments later, the impossible occurred.
Raijin Katsuro, THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entity, The Monk of Ten Thousand Storms, slowly fell to his knees.
His body moved against his will, compelled by linguistic authority that superseded even his Civilizational power.
First one knee touched the smooth arena floor.
Then the other.
Until he knelt completely, trapped within a cage of words, forced into the same position he had earlier imposed on Noah.
An immense silence reigned over the entire arena.
Existence itself seemed to hold its breath.
No prompts materialized before Noah’s vision.
No notifications appeared celebrating this achievement.
Everything was utterly, quintessentially silent, as if Existence itself had to bear witness to this in silence!
An entity that had not attained THE classification had forced aTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntybeing to kneel, locked within a cage constructed entirely from Logos of The First Tongue.
The silence stretched.
And in that profound quiet, reality itself seemed to acknowledge that something fundamental had shifted.
That a bridge had been fully constructed where none should have been possible.
That the impossible... had become merely difficult.
Merely.
Merely!

chapters.title: Chapter 4606: The First Lesson VI
paragraphs: Far from The Primordial Genesis Shore, countless Gigaparsecs away within the chaotic expanse of Ginnungagap, two figures floated above an obsidian sea that crackled with visible instability.
Tor and THE Living Originremained utterly still, their forms hovering motionless as if they had become statues carved from compressed authority.
The silence between them stretched with building tension untilTorfinally spoke.
"THE Barrier of Hunger I placed on him has faded. Cracked completely. The connection has been severed."
THE Living Originremained silent initially, her white-gold eyes closing as she focused her awareness inward to sense through her own connection.
After several moments, she opened her eyes and spoke with a carefully measured tone.
"I innately feel that his Origin has not been collapsed. He still exists somewhere within Ginnungagap. The fundamental thread connecting him to Existence remains intact."
Tor’s expression darkened as he processed this information, his mind racing through possibilities.
"If a THE level entity attacked him and managed to overcome his defenses..."
THE Living Origin considered his words before responding thoughtfully.

"It is not always collapse. Ginnu Lifeforms at times take hostages rather than simply collapsing those who enter their territories. They have settlements, laws, customs. Some use prisoners for studying or as meals."
Tor’s eyes narrowed dangerously as he turned to face her directly.
"Oh, so we need to locate a Ginnu Settlement and just walk directly in?"
THE Living Originmet his gaze with calm assessment before asking the critical question.
"How far are you willing to go for this? For him?"
Tor did not even hesitate or look away as he replied with voice carrying absolute conviction.
"As far as I need to go."
He thought of The Little Devil. He thought of Khor as he sighed internally. Even if he collapsed in the future, he had to ensure she had a future.
Origin nodded slowly as if she had expected exactly such an answer.

"Very well, then let us follow the flow of concentrated power. The most densely accumulated authority in Ginnungagap will mark the locations of major Ginnu Settlements. Let us pay them a visit and see what we find."
With such words carrying ominous promise, the two began heading in a different direction with renewed purpose, their forms cutting through the chaotic environment toward their destination.

In the distant Primordial Genesis Shore where Noah’s unprecedented battle had just concluded, Ul’moreth found himself surrounded by multiple Ginnu Lifeforms who seemingly wanted answers to questions they could barely formulate.
A THE Surface Depth Ginnu with crystalline protrusions covering their malformed body spoke first with voice mixing awe and confusion.

|Sir Ul’moreth, we all witnessed what occurred in the arena. But we need clarification... Most of us at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty can at most proficiently utter the eighteen Core Phonemes with reasonable consistency. We practice for years to achieve even that level of competency.|
A THE Intermediate Depth Ginnu whose body appeared to be formed from flowing liquid metal continued the thought.

|Forming complete Logos by combining multiple Phonemes together is extraordinarily dangerous and prone to catastrophic failure. Even those of us who have studied The First Tongue for countless ages sometimes make critical mistakes when attempting to construct words from individual letters.|
Another voice chimed in, this one belonging to an ancient Ginnu whose form shimmered with temporal distortion.

|The difficulty lies in the connections between Phonemes. Each letter must flow into the next with perfect grammatical precision. At any point during the process of forming a Logos, if the strokes and linguistic patterns do not connect effectively, it represents a violation of Existence itself. Everything explodes violently. The one forging the Logos becomes injured, sometimes severely enough to damage their foundation permanently.|
The crystalline Ginnu gestured toward the arena with clear disbelief.

|And yet the Anomaly in that arena, the entity we all just watched, formed multiple complex Logos in rapid succession. He strung together different combinations of Phonemes with perfect fluency. And not once, not a single time, did he make any connection errors. Not once did he fail or cause a linguistic detonation. Every single Logos he constructed manifested flawlessly.|
The liquid metal Ginnu’s voice carried profound weight.

|Even those of us at THE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty cannot claim that we could always successfully form Logos with one hundred percent consistency. There is always risk, always the possibility of catastrophic error no matter how experienced we become. And moving beyond just formation, the difficulty of actual Inscription is exponentially greater!|

|The precision required to write The First Tongue onto objects or Existences without causing reality to reject the patterns is something that takes millennia to master even partially. And he inscribed multiple Logos onto his own flesh in the middle of combat without a single failure...|
All eyes turned to Ul’moreth with expressions demanding explanation.
|So how, Sir Ul’moreth? How was what we just witnessed even remotely possible?|
Some of the gathered Ginnu looked like they desperately wanted to voice another question entirely.
Please teach us the same methodology! Share this technique!
ButUl’morethremained silent, his hairy form giving away nothing.
How could he possibly tell them the truth?

That he had only just met this Little Anomaly recently. That he had not even begun to teach him how to properly form Logos from combined Phonemes. That all he had done was provide the complete alphabet, the eighteen Core Phonemes of The First Tongue, and nothing more beyond basic explanations.
The entity had taught himself everything else through pure necessity and impossible talent.
Ul’moreth’s silence spoke volumes that he could not put into words.
Oh!
In this region of The Primordial Genesis Shore, a heavy and immense silence of profound shock settled over the assembled witnesses.
At the same precise time as all of this occurred, in the periphery of the settlement far from the central gathering, there sat a peculiar figure.
A humanoid Ginnu Lifeform perched casually on the branch of a tall obsidian tree, his position granting clear line of sight toward the arena where Noah had just accomplished the impossible.
This entity possessed a form that appeared almost perfectly human at first glance, lacking the extreme malformations common to most Ginnu.

His skin held a subtle iridescent quality that shifted between colors depending on the angle of observation. His eyes were completely black, no iris or pupil visible, just pure darkness that seemed to absorb light.
He wore simple robes of deep violet that somehow remained pristine despite the chaotic environment of Ginnungagap.
Most notably, he was filled with an aura of profound mystery, as if his true nature remained deliberately concealed beneath layers of misdirection.
In his hand, he held a fruit that pulsed with concentrated THE Civilizational Authority, each bite releasing waves of refined power into his system.

At this moment, as he observed Noah using a stick to cause aTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentity to kneel, he began speaking in whispers that were actually messages being transmitted across vast distances.
|Sir, I have just witnessed something that you may find genuinely interesting and worth your attention. I am compiling and sending over all observations relating to the incident now.|
His body pulsed with brilliant light as concentrated information began flowing outward in linguistic patterns, traveling through specialized channels toward a distant location.
The mysterious Ginnu continued eating his fruit calmly as he floated down from the obsidian tree branch, his form drifting closer to the arena.
His black eyes remained fixed on Noah’s position with unwavering focus, as if he wanted to observe even more of what this unprecedented entity might stand for, what else he might show from here.
In the shadows of The Primordial Genesis Shore, forces began to watch and move with immensity!

sentences.text: Far from The Primordial Genesis Shore, countless Gigaparsecs away within the chaotic expanse of Ginnungagap, two figures floated above an obsidian sea that crackled with visible instability.
Tor and THE Living Originremained utterly still, their forms hovering motionless as if they had become statues carved from compressed authority.
The silence between them stretched with building tension untilTorfinally spoke.
"THE Barrier of Hunger I placed on him has faded.
Cracked completely.
The connection has been severed."
THE Living Originremained silent initially, her white-gold eyes closing as she focused her awareness inward to sense through her own connection.
After several moments, she opened her eyes and spoke with a carefully measured tone.
"I innately feel that his Origin has not been collapsed.
He still exists somewhere within Ginnungagap.
The fundamental thread connecting him to Existence remains intact."
Tor’s expression darkened as he processed this information, his mind racing through possibilities.
"If a THE level entity attacked him and managed to overcome his defenses..."
THE Living Origin considered his words before responding thoughtfully.
"It is not always collapse.
Ginnu Lifeforms at times take hostages rather than simply collapsing those who enter their territories.
They have settlements, laws, customs.
Some use prisoners for studying or as meals."
Tor’s eyes narrowed dangerously as he turned to face her directly.
"Oh, so we need to locate a Ginnu Settlement and just walk directly in?"
THE Living Originmet his gaze with calm assessment before asking the critical question.
"How far are you willing to go for this?
For him?"
Tor did not even hesitate or look away as he replied with voice carrying absolute conviction.
"As far as I need to go."
He thought of The Little Devil.
He thought of Khor as he sighed internally.
Even if he collapsed in the future, he had to ensure she had a future.
Origin nodded slowly as if she had expected exactly such an answer.
"Very well, then let us follow the flow of concentrated power.
The most densely accumulated authority in Ginnungagap will mark the locations of major Ginnu Settlements.
Let us pay them a visit and see what we find."
With such words carrying ominous promise, the two began heading in a different direction with renewed purpose, their forms cutting through the chaotic environment toward their destination.

In the distant Primordial Genesis Shore where Noah’s unprecedented battle had just concluded, Ul’moreth found himself surrounded by multiple Ginnu Lifeforms who seemingly wanted answers to questions they could barely formulate.

Most of us at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty can at most proficiently utter the eighteen Core Phonemes with reasonable consistency.
We practice for years to achieve even that level of competency.|

Even those of us who have studied The First Tongue for countless ages sometimes make critical mistakes when attempting to construct words from individual letters.|

Each letter must flow into the next with perfect grammatical precision.
At any point during the process of forming a Logos, if the strokes and linguistic patterns do not connect effectively, it represents a violation of Existence itself.
Everything explodes violently.
The one forging the Logos becomes injured, sometimes severely enough to damage their foundation permanently.|

He strung together different combinations of Phonemes with perfect fluency.

Not once did he fail or cause a linguistic detonation.
Every single Logos he constructed manifested flawlessly.|
The liquid metal Ginnu’s voice carried profound weight.
|Even those of us at THE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty cannot claim that we could always successfully form Logos with one hundred percent consistency.
There is always risk, always the possibility of catastrophic error no matter how experienced we become.
And moving beyond just formation, the difficulty of actual Inscription is exponentially greater!|

And he inscribed multiple Logos onto his own flesh in the middle of combat without a single failure...|
