chapters.title: Chapter 4607: The First Lesson VII
paragraphs: How does one conduct themselves when they stand in a position of genuine superiority?
This was a question that revealed the true character of entities across all of Existence.

Many, when they achieved victory or accumulated power or wealth beyond their opponents, felt an overwhelming urge to express that superiority loudly and visibly. They needed others to witness and acknowledge their elevation.
The rich would throw gold coins at the poor in contempt, not to help but to humiliate.
The powerful would grind the weak into dust while laughing, not because it served any purpose but simply to demonstrate that they could.
These beings who expressed their superiority through such displays held immense arrogance and pride.
And more often than not, such beings were inevitably the first to collapse spectacularly and lose absolutely everything they had accumulated.
Because they mistook temporary advantage for permanent supremacy. They confused a single victory for eternal dominance.
No, the truly superior entities did not revel excessively in their gains or gloat over their elevated position.
They simply kept moving forward steadily because this was what they needed to do.
Not out of humility or false modesty, but out of understanding that superiority was not a destination to celebrate but merely a waypoint on an endless journey.
To keep moving forward without pause.This was the way.
At this moment, Noah was moving forward.
He looked down at the figure of Raijin Katsuro kneeling on the smooth arena floor, his tremendous power unable to be expressed despite his repeated desperate attempts.
The warrior monk’s body trembled with contained fury and shock as he tried again and again to break free from the linguistic prison surrounding him.
Noah felt the seven Logos of Imprisonment pulse and tremble under the constant pressure.
THE Civilizational Authority was so overwhelmingly powerful that even contained by The First Tongue itself, it continuously strained against the barriers.
Noah had to constantly smooth out and reinforce the connections between individual Phonemes that comprised each Logos, ensuring the grammatical links remained intact under impossible stress.
If it was not him specifically, if any other entity attempted to maintain this prison, Raijin would be able to exploit the smallest weakness and shatter the containment to continue the battle.
This was the terrifying nature of THE classification.

Even while completely surrounded by multiple Logos of The First Tongue working in perfect harmony, Raijin’s sheer existential weight was almost breaking apart the very links and linguistic locks that bound him.
Noah had to continuously monitor each connection, each grammatical flow, ensuring no critical links fractured while simultaneously preparing for the next phase.
Anyone else who did not possess his Way, anyone whose Existence was not fundamentally aligned with The First Tongue itself, would not be capable of maintaining such precise control.
So no, Noah did not stand on ceremony at this critical moment.
He did not gloat over his impossible achievement or waste time celebrating.
He had promised to bring this entity to his knees, and so he had done exactly that.
Now the noise of recognition and reward could begin.
BOOM!
Prompts erupted before his vision with concentrated significance.
|Unquantifiable Harvest Initiated|
|You have suppressed an entity of a fundamentally higher Scale of Existence.|
|Harvest being collected and amplified exponentially by Perpetual Harvest and The Cheating Architect.|
|Resource generation has exceeded normal calculation parameters.|
|All gains multiplied by factors beyond conventional measurement.|
|Quintessential Declaration Recorded|
|Your Way of Existence has quintessentially exerted itself without question or doubt.|
|Your Way has declared itself supreme even against an entity of a higher Scale.|
|Quintessence permanently reinforced through this expression of absolute conviction.|
|Future challenges to your fundamental nature will face increased resistance.|
|Mastery Elevation Achieved|
|Your proficiency in The First Tongue has been elevated from Novice Speaker to Fluent Speaker.|
|Contributing factors: Extensive cultivation by Ozymandias withinTHE Infinite Desmoterionunder extreme temporal dilation, and direct combat application forming multiple complex Logos under pressure.|
|The formation and successful deployment of functional Logos in genuine battle definitively establishes Fluent Speaker classification.|
|You can now consistently form Logos of 5-10 Phonemes with no error risk.|
|Inscription capabilities significantly enhanced.|
|Foundation Development Accelerated|
|THE Foundation of The First Tongue has experienced dramatic growth through combat refinement.|
|Resistance to THE Civilizational Authority elevated substantially.|
|Estimated time to Perfect Speaker classification: Significantly reduced through maintained practice.|
|THE Organ of Civilization - Developmental Growth|
|THE Organ of Civilization Development; 24.00%|
|Major advancement triggered by successful imprisonment of THE classification entity.|
|All derivative capabilities enhanced proportionally.|
|Maximum Prisoner Capacity: 18 to 27 entities|
|Temporal Dilation: 10,000x to 15,000x faster than external reality|
|Lineage Emergence Progressing|
|The identity of your emerging unique lineage is becoming increasingly clear.|
|The Distinction of The Early Creature, Osmont is being systematically dissolved and replaced.|
|Your heart continues seeking emergence of lineage directly from The First Tongue itself.|
|Bloodline formation: 47% complete|
|New fundamental identity crystallizing around linguistic supremacy.|
|New Distinction Acquired|
|Your unprecedented action of suppressing an entity of a higher Scale of Existence has earned you a unique Distinction.|
|Distinction Gained:THE Scale Breaker|
|Effect: When facing entities of higher Scales of Existence, the gap between your power and theirs is reduced by a fixed percentage.|
|The impossible becomes merely difficult when you confront those who should be unreachable.|
|This Distinction will grow stronger with each additional entity of higher Scale you suppress or defeat.|
Noah observed all of these prompts with outward calm, his expression revealing none of the satisfaction burning within.
After reading through the significance of what he had accomplished, he spoke aloud with voice carrying quiet finality.
"I have the first true official prisoner of THEInfinite Desmoterion."
The moment those words left his mouth, reality shifted.
Noah’s head began to glow with terrifying intensity, brilliant light erupting from his skull as his consciousness connected directly toTHE Organ of Civilizationspinning within his mind.
Tendrils of blue and gold energy that resembled writhing tentacles burst forth from the light, extending outward with purposeful intent.
They wrapped around Raijin’s body with irresistible force, binding him even more thoroughly than the Logos already containing him.
Raijin’s Civilizational Authority defied and struggled violently against this new restraint, his entire being fighting desperately against imprisonment.
But Noah simply made the surrounding seven Logos of Imprisonment even tighter, reinforcing their grammatical structure and eliminating any possibility of escape.
In the next moment, Raijin Katsuro and his terrifying grandeur of power simply disappeared from the arena.
Vanished entirely as if he had never existed at all.
Noah stood there calmly in the vast empty space, still holding his stick.
Still gripping The Goad that had delivered The First Lesson.
He did not bellow out in triumphant fervor or scream his victory to the watching crowd.
This was simply Existence unfolding as it should.
And he was only just getting started on his path.
New prompts bloomed with extraordinary implications as consequences of imprisoning aTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentity.
|THE Infinite Desmoterion- Critical Update|
|First THE classification prisoner successfully imprisoned.|
|Active Prisoners: 2/27|
|Prisoner 1: Ozymandias (willing cooperation, perfect synchronization)|
|Prisoner 2: Raijin Katsuro, The Monk of Ten Thousand Storms (resistant, requiring containment)|
|Maintenance Cost: 20 Rudimentary Units of Everything per 24 hours|
|Unprecedented Cultivation Configuration Achieved|
|Two entities now cultivating within The Desmoterion under 15,000x temporal dilation.|
|Ozymandias continues perfecting The First Tongue and The Way of Mana and Hunger.|
|Raijin Katsuro will be compelled to refine The Way of Heavenly Lightning.|
|All advancement made by both prisoners reflects as enhancement to your Way of Mana and Hunger.|
|Synergistic effect detected: Having multiple prisoners accelerates overall cultivation efficiency beyond linear addition.|
|The Way of Heavenly Lightning - Integration Initiated|
|As Raijin cultivates and refines his Way within The Desmoterion, aspects of The Way of Heavenly Lightning will gradually become accessible to you.|
|His Singularity and Genesis Principles will be studied and potentially replicated.|
|Estimated time for meaningful integration: Variable based on Raijin’s cooperation level|
|Note: Resistant prisoners provide slower but still significant benefits.|
|Mana Influence Process Activated|
|Raijin Katsuro is now being gradually influenced by Mana as foundational authority.|
|His Way will slowly align more closely with The First Tongue over extended imprisonment.|
|Resistance expected but ultimately futile given temporal scale and environmental pressure.|
After reading through these significant updates, Noah closed his eyes and turned his awareness inward.
His consciousness descended into THE Organ of Civilization whereTHE Infinite Desmoterionexisted as a vast domain.
InsideTHE Infinite Desmoterion, the sky pulsed with blue gold radiance while the ground remained formed from crystallized Hunger.
Into this space, Raijin Katsuro descended surrounded by vibrant chains of Mana and linguistic authority.
Even more chains materialized from the environment itself, wrapping around his limbs and torso with irresistible binding force.
His vision returned abruptly as he looked around in absolute shock at his new surroundings.
This was not the arena. This was somewhere else entirely, somewhere that felt impossibly vast yet simultaneously confined.
His Civilizational Authority tried to erupt with full force, attempting to shatter these new restraints and escape this unknown prison.
But an unfathomable power wrapped around him immediately, crushing his attempted rebellion.
For Noah, internally voicing The First Tongue within his own Organ of Civilization was even easier than external expression.
Here, in this domain that was literally part of his Existence, The First Tongue flowed from him with perfect fluency.
At this moment, across the vast expanse of The Desmoterion, Ozymandias looked toward the figure of Raijin descending and struggling against his bonds.
From Ozymandias’s hand, a stick materialized with casual authority.
Another Goad, identical to the one Noah wielded externally.
And this one was already covered with inscribed Logos of Imprisonment, pulsing with concentrated linguistic power.
Even more Logos formed in the air around Raijin as Ozymandias approached with calm deliberation.
Seven additional layers of containment wrapped around the struggling prisoner.
Ozymandias spoke with voice carrying absolute finality.
"Get down."
Instantly, the authority of The First Tongue spoken within this domain crashed against Raijin with overwhelming force.
BOOM!
Raijin’s figure was driven downward violently, crashing to the ground surrounded by multiplying chains as he looked toward Ozymandias with expression mixing shock and growing horror.
His voice erupted with desperate confusion.
"What is this?! Who are you?! What do you Ginnu monsters want with me?! What are these twisted games you are playing?!"
Ozymandias rose to his full height, the Goad in his hand pulsing with authority as he shook his head with what might have been pity.

"Hush with all of that pointless questioning, and begin your cultivation immediately. You lost your battle because your Way was fundamentally weak and underdeveloped compared to what it could become. You now have an effective eternity in here under extreme temporal dilation to perfect your Way and advance beyond your current limitations, so get started without further delay."
He paused before adding with a voice carrying strange encouragement.
"Mana will help you whether you want it to or not. The First Tongue will refine you. Eventually, you may even thank us for this opportunity."
BOOM!
A terrifying progression of accelerated cultivation bloomed within The Infinite Desmoterion as both prisoners began their eternal refinement.
In Existence, there were many paths to power and countless methodologies for advancement.
Some entities accumulated strength through patient cultivation across eons, building their foundations slowly and carefully.
Some stole power from others through violence and consumption, growing rapidly but unstably.
Some inherited power from ancient lineages or were born with advantages others could never possess.
But the rarest path, the one that defied all conventional understanding, was the path of those who built bridges where none should exist.
Who looked at the impossible gap between themselves and entities of higher Scales and decided that gap was merely an engineering problem to be solved through sufficient understanding and effort.
Noah had just demonstrated that The First Tongue could serve as such a bridge.
Not through overwhelming personal power, but through linguistic authority that operated on principles deeper than Civilizational classification.
The battle against Raijin had proven something fundamental: mastery of The First Tongue could allow those of lower Scales to stand against, suppress, and even imprison those of higher Scales.
The bridge had been built and tested.
And Noah stood upon it calmly, already looking toward the next impossible challenge.
Because truly superior entities did not stop to celebrate their achievements.
They simply kept moving forward.
Always forward.
Toward whatever came next.

What are these twisted games you are playing?!"
Ozymandias rose to his full height, the Goad in his hand pulsing with authority as he shook his head with what might have been pity.
"Hush with all of that pointless questioning, and begin your cultivation immediately.
You lost your battle because your Way was fundamentally weak and underdeveloped compared to what it could become.
You now have an effective eternity in here under extreme temporal dilation to perfect your Way and advance beyond your current limitations, so get started without further delay."
He paused before adding with a voice carrying strange encouragement.
"Mana will help you whether you want it to or not.
The First Tongue will refine you.
Eventually, you may even thank us for this opportunity."
BOOM!
A terrifying progression of accelerated cultivation bloomed within The Infinite Desmoterion as both prisoners began their eternal refinement.
In Existence, there were many paths to power and countless methodologies for advancement.
Some entities accumulated strength through patient cultivation across eons, building their foundations slowly and carefully.
Some stole power from others through violence and consumption, growing rapidly but unstably.
Some inherited power from ancient lineages or were born with advantages others could never possess.
But the rarest path, the one that defied all conventional understanding, was the path of those who built bridges where none should exist.
Who looked at the impossible gap between themselves and entities of higher Scales and decided that gap was merely an engineering problem to be solved through sufficient understanding and effort.
Noah had just demonstrated that The First Tongue could serve as such a bridge.
Not through overwhelming personal power, but through linguistic authority that operated on principles deeper than Civilizational classification.
The battle against Raijin had proven something fundamental: mastery of The First Tongue could allow those of lower Scales to stand against, suppress, and even imprison those of higher Scales.
The bridge had been built and tested.
And Noah stood upon it calmly, already looking toward the next impossible challenge.
Because truly superior entities did not stop to celebrate their achievements.
They simply kept moving forward.
Always forward.
Toward whatever came next.

chapters.title: Chapter 4608: Ginnungagap Festival I
paragraphs: In Existence, if one could not fly, then they should at least run with everything they had.
If you could not run, then at least walk with steady determination.
If you could not even walk, then doevery damn thing within your power to at least crawl forward.
Even if you lost your arms and legs, if your body was shattered and your foundation cracked, still find some way to keep moving forward through sheer force of will.
Whatever one did, however they accomplished it, they had to keep moving forward without pause.
This was not merely philosophical wisdom. This was survival imperative.

Because the moment you stopped moving forward, the moment you allowed yourself to believe you had reached a destination worth resting at, Existence would crush you under forces you were no longer prepared to face.
Stagnation was death. Complacency was collapse. Only forward motion, relentless and unceasing, offered any hope of enduring what came next.
Even though Noah had just made a ridiculous accomplishment that even he had not fully expected to achieve, he would continue moving forward without pause.
So he took a moment to consolidate his gains internally.
He closed his eyes, feeling the Logos inscribed across his body pulse with steady authority.
He opened them with renewed clarity.
And then he took a single step forward.
A moment later, the isolated vastness of The Primordial Genesis Arena began to fade as the spatial expansion deactivated.
The surroundings filled with hundreds of gathered Ginnu Lifeforms became visible once more.
Noah found himself faced with a heavy, profound silence.
The Ginnu Lifeforms were looking at him with eyes shining with complex emotions that mixed wonder, shock, calculation, and something approaching interest.
They observed him as if they were witnessing some unprecedented monster that had emerged from impossible circumstance.
An entity that should not exist, accomplishing what should not be possible.

The moment Noah’s figure was fully revealed standing alone in the now-normal-sized arena, The Goad still gripped casually in his hand while absolutely no trace of Raijin Katsuro remained anywhere, Ul’moreth’s presence expanded dramatically.
His hairy form rose high above all the assembled Ginnu Lifeforms as obsidian gold light radiated from him with crushing celebratory authority.
And at this moment, booming laughter erupted from THE Primeval Titan that shook the entire settlement.
|BAHAHA! ARE YOU NOT ENTERTAINED?!|
His voice thundered across the space with infectious enthusiasm.
|Look upon this glory! Witness this wonder! Pre-THE against THE classification, and what is the result before your eyes? The impossible made manifest!|
He paused dramatically before continuing with building fervor.
|Roar for his glory! Scream for his virtue! Scream for... err...|
Ul’morethpaused awkwardly in his grand pronouncement.
Noah could feel the ancient being’s smile through their connection asUl’morethwhispered directly into his mind.
|Little Anomaly, what do you want to be referred to as publicly? What name should they chant?|
Noah shook his head calmly as he replied without hesitation.
|The Scale Breaker is fine.|
Ul’moreth’slaughter intensified with satisfaction as his voice bellowed out again with renewed grandeur.
|Roar for his glory! Scream for his virtue! Scream for THE SCALE BREAKER!|
The Ginnu Lifeforms nearby looked at each other with uncertain expressions before the excitement became infectious.
They began to roar out in The First Tongue, their voices creating linguistic patterns that made reality vibrate.
|THE SCALE BREAKER! THE SCALE BREAKER! THE ANOMALY! THE ANOMALY!|
The chant built in intensity as hundreds of powerful entities raised their voices in genuine celebration.
Noah listened to all of this while shaking his head with mixture of embarrassment and acceptance.
In the next moment,Ul’moreth’slaughter continued as he raised his voice even louder, a sense of pride evident in his voice.

|To mark this glorious occasion, I shall unleash my personal boons from THE Vaults of Ginnungagap! I shall usher in A Ritual Festival of Existence to commemorate what we have witnessed! And I hope the rest of you will not be cheap with your contributions! COME!|
The atmosphere transformed instantly, becoming booming and raucous with building celebration.
In the region above the core settlement of The Primordial Genesis Shore,Ul’morethraised one hairy hand and caused a massive Logos to be written directly into the sky itself.
Noah looked up at it with analytical focus, his eyes immediately breaking down its component structure.
The Logos combined the Phonemes of Fire, Unity, Beginning, Life, and Light into a complex word that translated most closely to "Eternal Celebration" or "Festival Without End."
In the next moment after the Logos fully manifested, the entire sky of this region flickered and transformed into brilliant, vibrant flames.
Not destructive fire, but celebratory radiance.

The heavens became painted in colors associated with ancient festivals across countless eras. Deep crimsons mixed with golden yellows. Emerald greens danced with sapphire blues. Violet purples intertwined with amber oranges.
It looked like vibrant flames formed entirely from visible Phonemes dancing above in complex patterns, creating a shifting aurora of linguistic celebration.
Down below on the ground, the Ginnu Lifeforms entered fully into the festive mood.
Some began making ancient music through their Weavings of Existence, creating sounds that resonated across multiple frequencies simultaneously.

Deep drumming that felt like heartbeats of reality itself. Melodic tones that seemed to come from instruments that did not physically exist. Harmonic chanting in The First Tongue that created layers of meaning beneath the celebration.
Others conjured Phonemes directly in the air around them, writing out variations and permutations that released ancient archaic melodies with their very existence.
A Ginnu formed the Phoneme of Air in twelve different variations simultaneously, each one producing a different musical note that harmonized with the others.
Another created the Phoneme of Water in flowing script that generated sounds like rushing rivers and cascading waterfalls.
The entire settlement transformed into a celebration of linguistic and existential wonder.
Then the Ginnu Lifeforms began thumping their chests with ritualistic fervor as their bodies released unique items that seemed to materialize from within their very beings.
Each treasure pulsed with concentratedTHE Civilizational Authority.
|I shall contribute to the festival!| one THE Surface Depth Ginnu declared as they produced a crystallized fruit that glowed with internal radiance.
|I offer my boon as well!|another called out, releasing a jewel that seemed to contain compressed starlight.

Noah observed with fascinated attention as unique fruits, jewels, crystallized essences, metallic flowers, prismatic stones, and other naturally forming treasures began accumulating in the vibrant colorful skies above.
Each one filled with different expressions ofTHE Civilizational Authority.
Many Ginnu repeated the action of contributing their own treasures as a terrifying concentration of wonders began gathering overhead like a second sky made entirely from compressed value.
Noah activated his Lens of Civilization to examine what was being offered.
His gaze fixed on a particular jewel floating among the accumulating treasures.
|Treasure Analysis|
|Name: The Chaos-Edged Genesis Shard|
|Classification: Naturally Formed Civilizational Treasure|
|Composition: Pure undifferentiated unstable THE Civilizational Authority (Chaos-aligned)|
|Effect: Consumption increases Depth of Sovereignty by refining foundational authority|
|Warning: Authority contained within is highly unstable and will actively resist integration|
|Note: If one can correct or sufficiently handle the instability while devouring this treasure, significant advancement in Civilizational Depth can be achieved|
|Origin:THE Vaults of Ginnungagap|
He shifted focus to examine a vibrant fruit nearby.
|Treasure Analysis|
|Name: The Order-Touched Sovereign Fruit|
|Classification: Naturally Formed Civilizational Treasure|
|Composition: Pure undifferentiated unstable THE Civilizational Authority (Order-aligned)|
|Effect: Consumption increases Depth of Sovereignty by expanding authority foundation|
|Warning: Authority is unstable and requires careful refinement during absorption|
|Note: Entities capable of stabilizing the contained authority will experience dramatic growth in their Civilizational classification|
|Origin:THE Vaults of Ginnungagap|
Noah’s eyes narrowed as he continued scanning the accumulating treasures.
The vast majority of them, perhaps ninety percent or more, all shared the same origin notation.
THE Vaults of Ginnungagap.
So while Ginnu Lifeforms ushered inTHE Ritual Festival of Existenceunder Ul’moreth’s enthusiastic direction, Noah found himself wondering with building curiosity.
What exactly wereTHE Vaults of Ginnungagap?And more importantly, where was it located?
It looked like a place someone with his particular appetites would very much enjoy exploring personally.
But even as all of this celebratory chaos unfolded around him, Noah shook his head internally.
As amazing as this festival was, as valuable as these treasures clearly were, he had actually wanted to keep his momentum going and jump directly into the next battle without pause.
To work his way systematically through imprisonedTHEentities or even challengeTHE Maelstrom Thundermaneimmediately!

chapters.title: Chapter 4609: Ginnungagap Festival II
paragraphs: He wanted to continue rapidly increasing the tally of his prisoners inTHE Infinite Desmoterion.
Because more prisoners meant his Way would advance even faster. His progression in mastering The First Tongue would accelerate exponentially.

If he had twenty-sevenTHE Surface Depthentities all imprisoned and cultivating their Ways of Existence under extreme temporal dilation, all of their advancement feeding directly into his own growth, how rapidly would he reach THE classification even with his ridiculously demanding foundation requirements?
And part of the reason he wanted to keep moving at breakneck pace was a growing sense of unease.
Since arriving in Ginnungagap, he could objectively be considered to have experienced extremely and unfathomably glorious fortune.
Learning The First Tongue directly fromTHE Primeval Titan Ul’moreth. Successfully suppressing his first THE classification entity. Acquiring treasures and knowledge beyond measure.
This was all far too much concentrated luck and opportunity.
He half expected everything to collapse catastrophically at any moment!
Existence was fundamentally unfair. Existence would not remain on easy mode indefinitely.
If fighting a THE entity and nearly losing his Quintessence could even be considered "easy mode."
He even looked around cautiously as if expecting some monstrous creature to emerge from nowhere at any second to fuck everything up spectacularly.
But instead of disaster,Ul’morethwas the only one who approached him.
The ancient being’s presence radiated amused understanding as he spoke.

|Haha, I can see a look of worry and impatience burning in your eyes, Little Anomaly. Did you want to continue battling immediately without rest? Are you worried that Existence will shatter in the next moment to ruin all your carefully laid plans?|
He paused before continuing with reassuring authority.

|While such catastrophic interruption may indeed be possible, I will tell you plainly not to worry excessively. Because I, your Teacher, am here beside you! I may be excessively hairy and difficult to look at, but I am actually somewhat powerful when circumstances demand it. Somewhat...|
His tone became more serious despite the underlying humor.

|Loosen up just a little bit, Little Anomaly. Even if Existence itself begins to fall apart around us, I will personally hold it together long enough for you to accomplish what you need. Now come and participate properly in the festival. You are the entire reason it began, after all. This is the first time since the weavings of THE Secretive Eon that someone has broken the Scales...|
WAA!

|This will also be an excellent opportunity for you to acquire treasures and boons that can significantly aid the progression of your Way. Some of what will be offered can even directly elevate your proficiency in The First Tongue itself beyond what normal practice could achieve.|
Ul’moreth said such words with genuine encouragement.
Noah’s eyes shone brightly with renewed interest at that final revelation.
His naturally cautious nature did not change fundamentally. He still fully expected and remained prepared for the absolute worst possible outcome.
But for now, he would focus on acquiring whatever treasures this festival offered.
And gathering critical information.
His thoughts formed into a direct question sent toUl’moreth.
|What exactly are THE Vaults of Ginnungagap?|
Ul’moreth and Noah floated together toward the center of the festivities where Ginnu Lifeforms had shockingly begun performing ritual dances.
They moved in precise circles around massive flames formed entirely from the Phoneme of Fire written repeatedly in intricate patterns that resembled a bonfire.

The ritual had distinct structure. Ginnu danced in concentric circles around the central flames, their movements following ancient patterns that created secondary linguistic expressions through pure motion.
The swirling Phonemes of Fire blazed higher with each completed rotation of the dancers.
Archaic and melodic sounds echoed continuously from all directions, creating an atmosphere that felt timeless and profound.
In the midst of such celebration,Ul’morethsmiled beneath his obscuring hair as he began his explanation with voice carrying mysterious weight.

|Many entities do not know this truth, but Ginnungagap alone is actually even more vast than The Infinite Unfurling that contains it. The chaotic space between ordered reality extends farther than most can comprehend or survive exploring.|

|There exist countless Weavings of The First Tongue and concentrated expressions of pure Existence scattered throughout this vast expanse. Places and phenomena that none of us fully understand despite eons of study.|

|THE Vaults of Ginnungagap are specific locations that hold extremely concentrated Weavings of either The First Tongue in its purest form or raw undifferentiated Existence itself. These places naturally generate Civilizational Treasures that would be extraordinarily useful for entities at any Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.|
His voice took on more serious tone.

|But these Vaults are not merely treasure repositories waiting to be plundered. They are genuinely dangerous places where reality operates according to rules that shift constantly. Where The First Tongue speaks itself without conscious direction, creating effects that can elevate or annihilate those who venture inside.|

|Some Vaults contain time that flows backward or sideways. Others hold spaces where all eighteen Phonemes manifest simultaneously in chaotic superposition. Still others are places where Existence itself is still deciding what it wants to become, making them fundamentally unstable at levels that even THE Intermediate Depth entities struggle to withstand.|
|I have found many profound things when venturing into various Vaults across the eons. Treasures, knowledge, understanding of The First Tongue that cannot be gained through any other method.|
He gestured toward the accumulated treasures floating in the sky.

|But the gift I will give you right now to commemorate your grand accomplishment will be treasures that even I have been personally enjoying and benefiting from. Items I will now pass down to you because I judge you capable of making better use of them than I can at this stage of my existence.|
After saying this with genuine generosity, Ul’moreth reached into the space near the ritual Phonemes of Fire and withdrew something extraordinary.
Vibrant obsidian Lotuses materialized in his hands, each one shaped in unique variations of different Phonemes rather than having normal petal structure.
One Lotus was formed entirely from the Phoneme of Light written in flowing script.
Another took the shape of the Phoneme of Time inscribed in crystallized moments.
A third embodied the Phoneme of Paradox in contradictory geometries.
Noah could sense terrifically potent Weavings of The First Tongue emanating from these strange flowers.
He immediately activated his Lens of Civilization to examine them in detail.
|Treasure Analysis|
|Name: The Primordial Comprehension Lotus (Phoneme Variation: Light)|
|Classification: Vault-Born Treasure of The First Tongue|
|Composition: Crystallized comprehension of linguistic fundamentals shaped by concentrated exposure to pure First Tongue expression|
|Effect: Consumption induces a unique state of profound comprehension in The First Tongue|
|Primary Function: Allows observer to perceive all variations of Phonemes and the infinite different Logos that could potentially be formed from various combinations|
|Note: Variations are truly endless - this treasure provides temporary access to perceiving that infinite possibility space|

|Secondary Effect: If consumed by an entity who has not yet learned The First Tongue, this item would place them in an elevated state where they could potentially learn one or more variations of Core Phonemes directly|
|Comprehension state is temporary but insights gained are permanent|
|Duration: Variable based on consumer’s affinity with The First Tongue|
|Origin: THE Vaults of Ginnungagap - Vault of Infinite Expression|
Noah observed the detailed analysis of such an extraordinary treasure.
Instantly, his eyes pulsed with building majesty and barely contained tyranny.
This...looked unfathomably glorious!

Noah could sense terrifically potent Weavings of The First Tongue emanating from these strange flowers.
He immediately activated his Lens of Civilization to examine them in detail.
|Treasure Analysis|
|Name: The Primordial Comprehension Lotus (Phoneme Variation: Light)|
|Classification: Vault-Born Treasure of The First Tongue|
|Composition: Crystallized comprehension of linguistic fundamentals shaped by concentrated exposure to pure First Tongue expression|
|Effect: Consumption induces a unique state of profound comprehension in The First Tongue|
|Primary Function: Allows observer to perceive all variations of Phonemes and the infinite different Logos that could potentially be formed from various combinations|
|Note: Variations are truly endless - this treasure provides temporary access to perceiving that infinite possibility space|

|Secondary Effect: If consumed by an entity who has not yet learned The First Tongue, this item would place them in an elevated state where they could potentially learn one or more variations of Core Phonemes directly|
|Comprehension state is temporary but insights gained are permanent|
|Duration: Variable based on consumer’s affinity with The First Tongue|
|Origin: THE Vaults of Ginnungagap - Vault of Infinite Expression|
Noah observed the detailed analysis of such an extraordinary treasure.
Instantly, his eyes pulsed with building majesty and barely contained tyranny.
This...looked unfathomably glorious!

chapters.title: Chapter 4610: The Discovery
paragraphs: Enjoy the little things.
This alone was something that very few truly understood over the years as they continued to work and struggle endlessly.
Noah understood this principle a while ago as even amidst apocalypses and existential struggles, he made conscious effort to enjoy the little things.

He had a side profession as a farmer and chef after all as he even had a Cooking Sovereign Spire of Osmont, and he kept the company of multiple vibrant entities that formed his family across realities.

He enjoyed the small moments of peace amidst the constant struggle because if one only struggled and did nothing else, by the time their life was done they would inevitably ask themselves a terrible question.
What was all that struggle for if I spent eons doing it and nothing else?
So for now, even though he still half expected and remained prepared for something obscene to occur at any moment, he loved to be proven wrong as he looked at the festival unfolding around him.
The feel of the celebration carried weight that went beyond simple enjoyment.
There was ancientness here, ritual wonder that spoke of traditions older than most realities.

The Ginnu Lifeforms danced around the flames of Phonemes with movements that had been perfected across countless eons. Their steps created secondary linguistic patterns in the air, their rhythm generating waves that resonated with fundamental frequencies of Existence itself.
After completing particular sequences of the dance, individual Ginnu would reach up into the swirling cluster of treasures circling overhead in the vibrant sky.
They would pluck a fruit or jewel, take a bite or absorb a portion of its concentrated authority, revel in the sensation of power flooding through them, and then return seamlessly to the dance.
It felt surreal to witness.
These were entities with their own complete Weavings of Existence and their own complex lives stretching across unfathomable timespans.
And here they were, celebrating together with genuine joy rather than the usual cold calculation that dominated interactions between powerful beings.
As Noah looked at all of them participating in this timeless ritual, something in his expression shifted slightly as he missed his family.
Ul’moreth noticed immediately.

|What is that nostalgic look I see crossing your face, Little Anomaly? Come on, live in the present moment! Here is my gift to you, take it all. I’ll let you continue your relentless struggle in a little bit since I understand your impatience well enough, but participate properly in the festival just to have it marked across Existence that one day, in Ginnungagap, The Scale Breaker was here. The Anomaly was here. Dance, eat, celebrate!|
The words boomed with infectious enthusiasm.
Right after Ul’moreth spoke, Noah felt all the radiant Lotuses flowing toward him as if drawn by irresistible gravity.
Clean prompts bloomed before his vision.
|Festival Boon Acquired|
|The Primordial Comprehension Lotus (Phoneme Variation: Light) x3|
|The Primordial Comprehension Lotus (Phoneme Variation: Time) x3|
|The Primordial Comprehension Lotus (Phoneme Variation: Paradox) x2|
|The Primordial Comprehension Lotus (Phoneme Variation: Water) x2|
|The Primordial Comprehension Lotus (Phoneme Variation: Fire) x2|
|The Primordial Comprehension Lotus (Phoneme Variation: Void) x2|
|Total Primordial Comprehension Lotuses Acquired: 14|
Noah looked at all of them with eyes shining with profound satisfaction before immediately putting them away into secure storage.
He sent half of the total directly towardTHE Infinite Desmoterion.
Part of the reason he could even convince himself to take a moment to live in the present and participate in this festival was simple calculation.
Another part of him was currently insideTHE Infinite Desmoterioncontinuing to advance his Way and deepen his study of The First Tongue at fifteen thousand times temporal dilation.
So Noah was still working hard in that space. Fifteen thousand times as hard, in fact!
Or more accurately, he was making progress at such a multiplied rate that it justified taking brief moments to exist normally in external reality.
So he would participate properly in the festival and see about obtaining more treasures from the swirling cluster circling above.
Because The Primordial Comprehension Lotuses alone represented extraordinary opportunity.
He could give these to his people.
How glorious would it be if Khor quickly gained the capability to utilize The First Tongue? If Moiraine, Malphas, Riya, and all the others acquired this fundamental linguistic authority as well?
His eyes brightened with expanding possibilities as he looked toward the distant cages whereTHE Maelstrom Thundermaneremained imprisoned alongside other captured entities.
His gaze sharpened as he sent them a silent message.
Wait for me. I’m coming for all of you soon enough.
While a festival of linguistic wonder unfolded in Ginnungagap, reality continued itsrelentlessmotion elsewhere.
In the current Era, on the other side of The Veil that continued breaking down piece by piece, deep within The Lands of The Dead, The Great Usurper known as Eckert continued his idle existence.
He continued passively expanding his Derivative Civilization of Idle Existence in the most grand manner possible.
By doing absolutely nothing.
But sometimes, this approach alone was more terrifying than any active conquest or violent expansion.
His existence spread exponentially across The Lands of The Dead while remaining completely unobservable by any other entities who might wish to detect or interfere with his growth.
His entire Weaving of Existence had expanded to cover such a vast area that at this particular moment, something unexpected occurred.
"Hmm?"
Eckert blinked, in his formless state anyways, with mild surprise as he felt his existence extend into a region spanning several Gigaparsecs of seemingly empty murky obsidian space.
But there was something unusual here.
There seemed to be a point of concentrated singularity where his passively spreading existence suddenly spilled into something hidden within this apparently vacant region.
And as more of his Idle Existence flowed into this concealed space, his awareness expanded to encompass what lay within.
His expression shifted to genuine shock.
He could feel an extremely exuberant cluster of concentrated power residing in this hidden location.
This was a veiled pocket of existence, a deliberately concealed space folded away from normal observation.
The pocket itself measured perhaps a few hundred thousand kilometers across, small by cosmic standards but densely packed with authority that made Eckert’s senses sharpen immediately.
The space had strange properties. Reality here felt different, as if it operated according to rules that predated current Existence.
And at the center of this veiled pocket, Eckert’s spreading awareness encountered three circular bubbles of brilliant radiance.
Each bubble was approximately a kilometer in diameter, suspended in perfect equidistant formation from each other.
Inside each bubble, he could sense a distinct presence.
Three Early Creatures, their forms visible but completely inactive.
They appeared to be in some form of suspended animation or deep stasis, their existences preserved but not actively functioning.
And wrapped around each bubble was unique scripture written in a language Eckert could not understand despite his vast knowledge.
The writing pulsed with authority that felt impossibly ancient, and it held power that exceeded any of the Guiders of Order he saw!
As he looked at all of this with growing fascination, prompts materialized before his awareness.
|Your Idle Existence has passively spilled into a Veiled Pocket of Existence belonging to THE Creature|
|Classification: Hidden Storage Space|
|Contents Detected: The Inactivated Disciples of THE Creature|
|Status: Three Early Creatures in suspended stasis|
|Preservation Method: Unknown linguistic containment beyond current comprehension|
|Security Level: Extreme - designed to remain hidden from all observation|

|Note: Your unique method of passive expansion through Idle Existence has bypassed standard detection barriers since...it is a Derivative Civilization stemming from Existence itself. Otherwise. you would have not been able to enter.|
|Critical Decision Point|
|Current Mode: Passive Observation through Idle Existence|
|Your presence remains undetected due to nature of Idle Existence|
|Question: Would you like to switch to Active Mode?|
Eckert stared at the prompts with expression mixing curiosity and calculation.
Three disciples of THE Creature itself, hidden away in suspended stasis within a veiled pocket of existence.
Preserved by linguistic scripture that even he could not decipher!

chapters.title: Chapter 4611: Bloody Peace!
paragraphs: Would he like to switch to active mode?
Was this even a question worth asking?
Eckert laughed internally as he didn’t even bother answering the prompt, simply looking curiously at the massive Early Creatures that seemed simultaneously Dead and not Dead.
As he observed them with growing fascination, his existence continued spreading calmly.
It flowed around the protective bubbles containing each Disciple like water finding every gap and crevice.
And since his Idle Existence was fundamentally no different from the surrounding ambient reality itself, it permeated effortlessly into the bubbles without resistance.
Even the radiant strokes of ancient language covering the protective barriers didn’t activate or respond.
Why would they when effectively, there wasn’t any foreign influence nearby?
Just existence being existence, flowing where it naturally would.
But his spreading awareness permeated through the barriers until it covered the Early Creatures themselves, wrapping around their suspended forms like invisible threads.
And then something extraordinary occurred.
BZZT!
Prompts materialized with significant implications.
|Integration Protocol Detected|
|Due to the Sealed State of The Inactivated Disciples of THE Creature, their Weavings of Existence currently hold no prevailing identity or consciousness|
|Your Weavings of Existence have begun flowing into their dormant forms|
|Additional Information Being Obtained as your existence flows into and integrates with their Weavings of Existence|
|Process: 17% Complete|
Eckert felt genuine surprise as he faced an unexpected influx of information flooding into his awareness.
Information that felt far too grand and complex for his current mental framework to fully process, but it made the situation significantly more clear despite the overwhelming volume.
New prompts bloomed with extraordinary detail.
|Information Database Updated|
|The Inactivated Disciples of THE Creature have been protected inside barriers preserved by the Phonemes of The First Tongue|
|Barrier Function: Maintain stasis while preventing external corruption or interference|
|Critical Discovery: Due to their completely inactive state with no prevailing consciousness, your Idle Existence is now filling up their empty Weavings of Existence|
|Projection: You will gain full control of their physical bodies momentarily|
|Classification: If and when successful, these three entities can be considered Secondary Extensions of your will|
|Authority: They can be commanded by you to perform whatever actions you wish|
|Control Method: Direct consciousness integration through passive existence overlay|
Eckert’s metaphorical eyes opened wide at this unfolding reality.
The First Tongue? What the hell was that? Did Osmont know about this?
He couldn’t help but laugh with genuine amazement at the absurdity and opportunity of what was occurring.
He loved being idle, yes. That was his entire fundamental nature.
But he also wanted to help the big guy, the monstrous Osmont, if he possibly could so that he wasn’t struggling against the weight of Existence completely alone.
It was hard to bear that crushing burden without any support.

And if all the information he had been receiving about Existence, about THE Loom and The Fallout and the conflicts tearing reality apart, if all of it was actually true rather than exaggeration, then he wouldn’t be able to enjoy his peaceful Idle Existence if everything collapsed around him anyway.
These Disciples of THE Creature felt monumentally more powerful than any Guiders of Order he had previously encountered.
Additional prompts confirmed his assessment.
|Sealed Weaving Analysis|
|Within the dormant Weavings of The Disciples of THE Creature, complete structures of Singularity Principles can be sensed|
|Additionally, fragments of a Genesis Principle are detectably present within their foundations|
Unique prompts continued blooming one after another as Eckert brought himself to sharper focus.
Already, he could sense the hands of The Disciples beginning to twitch slightly as his consciousness filled their empty vessels.
He would gain full control over them very soon.
After that happened, well, maybe he might actually be a little bit more active in how he engaged with Existence.
After all, there had to be beautiful and intact Weavings of reality remaining if he wanted to properly enjoy an Idle life in the future.
Sometimes protecting the conditions for idleness required brief moments of action.

On the other side of The Veil, in The Lands of The Living, where the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds used to exist but were now just a vast region of spatial collapse and distorted reality, Alexander Asmodeus stood with one hand pressed against his chest.
He could feelThe Shattered Part of THE Heart of Lawpulsing there.
Well, reallyTHE Heart of Lawitself, or at least a fragment of it.
A piece of the heart belonging to an entity of a fundamentally higher Scale of Existence.
He was thinking deeply at this moment while he watched the forces of Osmont’s people defend desperately against overwhelmingly powerful enemies.

He saw The Infiniverse surging with brilliant authority as she went directly against a terrifying Disciple of THE Creature that shone with the light of a Principle even Alexander could not yet fully grasp or comprehend.
He saw Khor charging forward with absolute lividity toward Schrodinger, whose eyes looked extremely eerie and unsettling at this moment as if something fundamental had shifted in that being’s nature.
He saw the millions of Primus Inevitabilities fighting alongside The First Farmer and countless others as this battle raged across collapsed dimensions.
And throughout all of this observation, he had been asking himself a critical question.
What was his role in all this conflict?
It was a question he had been toiling with since his conversation withTHE Living Law.
A question that continued haunting him even after he obtained this piece of their Heart.
And at this moment, watching everything unfold with sharp clarity, he came to a final decision.
He closed his eyes and spoke internally with genuine emotion.
’I am truly sorry.’
BOOM!
He meant those words with complete sincerity.
And they were directed at none other than the fragment ofTHE Heart of Lawglimmering with concentrated Civilizational Authority within his chest.
A reply echoed through his consciousness with unexpected warmth and understanding.

"Haha, what could you possibly be sorry for? Paradox collapsed my entire Civilization, yes, but it will rise again eventually through other means. Do what you must with some of its remnants. I give you permission freely. Use it well. Through your Peace, there may be Law and Order."
The voice ofTHE Living Lawresonated in his mind with genuine encouragement rather than reproach.
Alexander nodded with grim determination.
And in the very next moment, he acted.
CRACK!
He deliberately shattered the alreadyShattered Part of THE Heart of Lawfurther, breaking it down into its fundamental components.
It began dissolving directly into his own Weaving of Existence.
And then he set it ablaze, burning it as fuel under his conscious direction to forge something entirely new.
His voice rang out with calm and glorious conviction as he spoke his truth to reality itself.

"Peace is a fortress that must be built upon the broken spine of Chaos itself. Existence is a ravenous tide seeking only to drown all of us in endless entropy and dissolution. To survive against the consuming void, one does not negotiate diplomatically with the storm. One breaks the storm completely until it learns absolute submission."

"Sometimes, Peace has to be brutal and dominating in order to ensure it remains stable. Sometimes, Peace can only be bought with a river of necessary blood flowing from those who would shatter it. I will not follow The Way of Law as it currently exists, but I will enact a bloody path toward Peace. A Way of Peace that will ensure lasting prosperity for those who deserve it, no matter how many must die to achieve that outcome."
With such words carrying absolute conviction, a silver-white brilliance began overflowing from Alexander’s entire being.
At this moment, he took a tiny piece of a Heart that had belonged to a THE entity who may have reachedTHE Intermediate or even Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
And he dissolved it completely to forge his own unique Way. His own emerging Civilization.
It was an action of profound significance.
A choice that, once made, could not be unmade.
A choice that caused the previously calm and silent figure of Schrodinger to suddenly shift his eerie gaze toward Alexander for a long moment of complete silence!

A choice that caused the previously calm and silent figure of Schrodinger to suddenly shift his eerie gaze toward Alexander for a long moment of complete silence!

chapters.title: Chapter 4612: A Period of Quintessential Progress! I
paragraphs: THE Ritual Festival of Existence in The Primordial Genesis Shoreunfolded with tremendous glory, and Noah was a full participant in it all.
He observed with fascinated attention all the unique ways that these lifeforms touched by The First Tongue acted and expressed themselves.
How they utilized the individual letters of The First Tongue to manifest and produce sounds and melodies completely unique to their particular Weavings of Existence.
Dances and rituals unfolded next to a swirling storm of Phonemes combining Fire, Light, and Darkness into a constantly shifting vortex of linguistic celebration.
He experienced it all for more than an hour of external time.
And was actually profoundly appreciative of this seemingly brief hour.
Because it allowed him to get a direct glimpse of just how terrifying the utility ofTHE Infinite Desmoterionwould truly be going forward.
This single passing hour in external reality equated to fifteen thousand hours cultivating insideTHE Infinite Desmoterion.
More than six hundred days of accelerated advancement.
Prompts bloomed before his vision detailing the extraordinary collective progress.
|THE Infinite Desmoterion - Temporal Progression Report|
|External Time Elapsed: 1 hour, 14 minutes|
|Internal Time Elapsed: 18,525 hours (772 days)|
|Prisoners Currently Cultivating: 2/27|
|Maintenance Cost Paid: 20 Rudimentary Units of Everything|
|Mastery Advancement - The First Tongue|
|Your proficiency in The First Tongue has experienced dramatic growth through intensive practice|
|Current Classification: Fluent Speaker (Advanced)|
|You can now freely form Logos of 8+ Phonemes with minimal concentration required|
|Complex grammatical structures containing multiple Phonemes can be constructed with careful effort|
|Inscription speed increased by 340%|
|Error rate when forming Logos under pressure: Reduced to near-zero|
|Phoneme Comprehension Deepened|
|You have extrapolated and internalized the different variations of each Core Phoneme|
|Understanding achieved: A single Phoneme can carry dozens of subtle meanings depending on context, inflection, and combination|
|Example: The Phoneme of Fire can mean destruction, transformation, purification, passion, or creation depending on how it is expressed|
|This multilayered comprehension allows for more sophisticated Logos construction|
|Foundation for Perfect Speaker classification being systematically built|
|Prisoner Cultivation Report - Ozymandias|
|Days Cultivating: 772|
|Primary Focus: Perfecting The First Tongue and refining The Way of Mana and Hunger|
|Progress: Ozymandias has achieved near-perfect fluency in basic Logos construction|
|Advancement: His insights into The Way of Mana and Hunger have deepened your own understanding proportionally|
|Prisoner Cultivation Report - Raijin Katsuro|
|Days Cultivating: 772|
|Initial Status: Extremely resistant and defiant|
|Current Status: Disciplined and fully focused on The Way of Heavenly Lightning|
|Transformation: After 347 days of constant containment and Mana influence, Raijin ceased resistance and began genuine cultivation|
|Progress: The Way of Heavenly Lightning is being systematically influenced and enhanced by The Way of Mana|
|Notable Incident: On day 189, Raijin attempted rebellion and was subjected to thrashing and additional Logos of Imprisonment by Ozymandias. Resistance ceased entirely afterward.|

|Raijin now meditates precisely 18 hours per day and has developed what Ozymandias describes as "an unhealthy obsession with perfecting his lightning manifestation to prove his Way wasn’t fundamentally weak."|
|Current Relationship:Professional prisoner with excellent work ethic|
|The Way of Heavenly Lightning - Integration Complete|
|You can now express The Way of Heavenly Lightning through your own Existence|
|Authority Level: 67% of Raijin’s original mastery|
|This percentage will continue increasing as Raijin refines his Way further within The Desmoterion|
|Principle Analysis - Records Studied|
|The complete records of Raijin Katsuro’s Singularity Principles have been thoroughly analyzed|
|The Genesis Principle contained within his foundation has been examined|
|Understanding Achieved: The structural difference between Singularity and Genesis Principles and The First Tongue has been mapped|
|Projection: After approximately 2,000 additional days of study within The Desmoterion, alteration of Complex Logos representing Principles will become possible|
|Application: This will allow the systematic elevation of your current Singularity Principles toward Genesis classification|
|Timeline: Achievable within 5-6 hours of external reality at current temporal dilation|
|Exponential Advancement - Way of Mana and Hunger|
|The combined cultivation of yourself, Ozymandias, and Raijin within The Desmoterion has created synergistic effects|
|Your Way has expanded across multiple dimensional expressions|
|Stability increased by 410%|
|Authority density increased by 890%|
|Foundation depth reinforced beyond previous projections|
|THE Organ of Civilization - Development Surge|
|Current Development: 31.00%|
|Maximum Prisoner Capacity: 27 to 36 entities|
|Temporal Dilation: 15,000x to 18,000x faster than external reality|
|Note: Each additional prisoner will continue accelerating overall development|
|THE Foundation of The First Tongue - Critical Advancement|
|THE Civilizational Authority Resistance: Increased to 50%|
|Effect: When facing THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty entities, your Foundation will innately filter out and resist approximately half of their authority pressure|
|This resistance applies passively and does not require conscious effort to maintain|
Oh!
The advancements made were absolutely glorious.
With such exponential progress, Noah truly felt like the seemingly far-away stage of achieving THE classification himself could be reached much sooner than he originally anticipated.
At this moment, he reached up into the swirling cluster of treasures overhead and plucked a jelly-like quartz that pulsed with internal radiance.
He took a bite, and his eyes immediately flashed with brilliant obsidian light.
|Treasure Consumed|
|Name: The Void-Touched Essence Quartz|
|Classification: Naturally Formed Civilizational Treasure|
|Composition: Crystallized Void authority mixed with pure THE Civilizational Authority|
|Effect: Permanently enhances capacity to manipulate void and empty space|
|Secondary Effect: Increases resistance to spatial collapse and dimensional distortion by 15%|
|Tertiary Effect: Grants instinctive understanding of how to hide one’s presence within spatial folds|
|Origin: THE Vaults of Ginnungagap|
|Note: Synergizes exceptionally well with The First Tongue’s Phoneme of Void|
As Noah absorbed the treasure’s benefits, Ul’moreth floated beside him with visible joy radiating from his hairy form.
The ancient being spoke with earnest sincerity.

|Ginnu Lifeforms rarely celebrate like this, you know. We tend to be solitary and focused exclusively on our individual advancement. But I wish for all of them to collectively succeed and find genuine happiness in their existence. It saddens me that across all of Existence, the strongest entities seem to have completely forgotten that happiness is even possible. Most seem intent only on covering all of reality under their particular Way and controlling absolutely everything they can reach.|
He shook his head with what might have been melancholy before turning to Noah with renewed energy.

|Alright, I’ve made you enjoy the festival long enough! You are partly still like The Others in nature. Like THE Creature, THE Primordial Chaos, or THE Secretive Eon and similar entities. I know your fundamental nature is not to sit still for extended periods. So go ahead. While the festival continues to unfold, we can also enjoy dancing and singing and eating while observing another battle for entertainment. I’ve already placed the one you had your eye on in the arena.|
Noah blinked and looked toward the distant arena.
Surely enough,THE Maelstrom Thundermanecould be seen standing in the expanded space, looking around with a somber and heavy expression as if contemplating what was about to occur.
Noah smiled as he looked back towardUl’morethand nodded with genuine appreciation before beginning to walk steadily toward the arena.
As he moved, he replied to Ul’moreth’s words.

|Sometimes, one needs to have a precise balance of both approaches. To maintain that insane drive and ambition to place all of Existence within one’s palm and control, while also finding one’s own belonging and genuine happiness within that same Existence. Because sometimes, if you dont have Existence in your palm...you happiness can easily be taken away...|
At these words,Ul’moreth’shairy figure radiated satisfaction as he responded with amused warmth.

|You don’t always have to have the last word in every exchange, my student. Go on now, let us see how you deal with someone who has a slightly stronger Depth of Absolute Sovereignty than your previous opponent. Even though their Ways are similar in expression, this should prove a little more difficult. Because some THE entities will not simply sit there politely and wait for you to speak The First Tongue at them. And remember, all THE classification entities are inherently faster than you currently are!|
Noah nodded at such accurate warnings as he opened his palm.
A vibrant blue-gold stick materialized with familiar weight.
The Goad, ready once more to deliver lessons.
He jumped directly toward the arena, and Gigaparsecs of space expanded dramatically all around him as the battlefield prepared for another impossible confrontation.

Far from The Primordial Genesis Shore, outside of Ginnungagap entirely, deep within The Infinite Unfurlingwhere reality operated according to different fundamental rules, a titanic humanoid entity moved with terrifying purpose.
Multicolored flames of raw Existence itself surrounded this being completely, making their actual form completely unobservable beneath the blazing corona.
One could only see pressurized steam blowing continuously out of what appeared to be a nose, creating visible distortions in surrounding space.
Billowing waves of crushing heat poured out of what seemed to be a mouth with each breath.
The steam emanating from this entity’s existence alone melted and healed the surrounding fabric of reality in a continuous cycle.
If aTHE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentity faced even the passive steam radiating from this being, they would be systematically melted alongside their entire Way and Civilization!
Dissolved completely by ambient heat alone.
The entity moved forward with measured steps that covered impossible distances.
Behind them, multicolored chains swung with rhythmic motion.
When one followed those chains backward, a horrifying sight became visible.
Seven completely bound THE classification entities were being dragged along like captured prisoners.
Each one held eyes filled with sheer existential terror as they barely dared to even look at the entity who pulled them along so effortlessly.
As for the entity themselves, their barely discernible eyes behind the flames of Existence were currently focused ahead on something specific.
Illusory screens floated in the space before them, displaying past scenes with perfect clarity.
Scenes from inside a Primordial Genesis Arena.
A battle showing a Pre-THE Existence wielding a simple stick.
Causing aTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentity to kneel through linguistic authority alone.
This titanic entity watched the recorded scene with complete calm, their expression unreadable behind the consuming flames.
After several moments of observation, they waved one hand casually and caused the illusory screens to disappear entirely.
And then they continued moving forward.
Calmly.
Gloriously.
Unfathomably!
Pulling seven terrified THE entities behind them like trophies.

chapters.title: Chapter 4613: A Period of Quintessential Progress! II
paragraphs: Noah stepped into the vastly expanded arena with calm deliberation, his blue-gold Goad held loosely in one hand.
Across from him,Astrape, THE Maelstrom Thundermane, stood with a heavy expression carved into features that seemed perpetually surrounded by crackling white lightning.
The entity’s eyes blazed with fury and profound resentment.
When Astrape spoke, his voice carried the rumbling quality of distant thunder as he looked at him up and down.
"All of this. Every single consequence that has befallen me. All of this happened because of YOU. And now, after everything you’ve caused, you have the audacity to step into a cage with me?"
HUUM!
White lightning began crackling more intensely around his form as killing intent solidified into almost physical pressure.
"Regardless of what The Ginnu Lifeforms do to me afterward, regardless of what punishments they devise, I will kill you today. Your existence ends here, Anomaly. I swear it upon my Way."
The arena trembled with the weight of that vow.
Noah looked at the enraged entity with complete calm, his expression revealing nothing.
And then he spoke with quiet finality.
"You should not have given me time to utter."
THE Maelstrom Thundermane’s expression shifted to confusion.
What could that possibly mean?
In the very next instant, he understood with horrifying clarity.
Multiple Logos descended onto his position from positions all around the arena where Noah had already inscribed them while walking forward.

Seven Logos of Imprisonment, identical in structure to those that had bound the cages of captured THE entities, wrapped around Astrape’s form with irresistible authority as he found this power familiar!
Additional Logos designed specifically to weaken and suppress lightning-based authorities activated simultaneously.
Shock exploded across Astrape’s features as he realized Noah had prepared the battlefield before even beginning the confrontation.
The battle that unfolded was less a clash of pure power and more a deadly dance between opposing forces.
Above the arena, Ginnu Lifeforms continued their ritual celebration, dancing around the massive flames of Phonemes with building fervor.
Their movements seemed to mirror and accentuate what occurred below.
THE Maelstrom Thundermaneerupted with his full authority, his Way of Fulmination expressing itself in overwhelming fashion.
Bursts of brilliant white lightning exploded outward, each discharge containing enough concentrated power to annihilate entire realities.
The lightning smashed against the descending Logos with devastating force, shattering several of the linguistic constructs instantly.
But Noah simply reformed them faster than Astrape could destroy them, his Fluent Speaker mastery allowing rapid reconstruction.
Then Astrape released something far more terrifying.
A Genesis Principle.
The Genesis Principle of Absolute Conduction!
The moment he unleashed this profound authority, everything within the arena transformed fundamentally.
The ground, the air, the very fabric of space itself, even the Logos Noah had constructed, all of it converted instantly into tendrils of pure white lightning.
Existence itself became an ocean of electrical discharge under Astrape’s complete authority.
Noah’s body was smashed backward violently as reality itself pressed down with crushing force.
The four Logos inscribed across his form flared with protective authority, filtering out approximately half of the devastating pressure.
But even with that resistance, every ounce of transformed reality around him sought to force his existence to convert into pure lightning under Astrape’s Genesis Principle.
Astrape came to float above Noah like a titan formed entirely from condensed electrical fury.
At that moment, this enraged being chose not to speak or waste breath on declarations.
He simply wanted to kill.
What happened next seemed to play out in slow motion, each instant stretched to painful clarity.
Astrape raised both hands high above his head.
For Gigaparsecs behind him, stretching to the very edges of the expanded arena space, absolutely all of existence turned into vibrant white lightning under his authority.
A sea of electrical annihilation waiting to be released.
He brought his hands down with finality, seeking to thunder all of that accumulated devastation directly onto Noah’s position and erase him from Existence entirely!
At such a critical moment, the scene continued playing in that strange slow-motion clarity.
Noah simply raised his stick with calm precision and spoke words that carried quiet satisfaction.
|Thank you for coming so close.|

Even though the might and Depth of Astrape was so terrifying that his Genesis Principle had transformed absolutely everything in the arena, even the Logos Noah had constructed, into white lightning, there remained one fundamental truth.
That Genesis Principle itself was ultimately a complex form of Logos written in The First Tongue.
And even though the visible Logos Noah had utilized were transformed into lightning alongside everything else, his Way could sense every single Phoneme comprising those linguistic structures.
All around him, hidden within the ocean of white lightning that now permeated the entire space, Noah had reformed the seven Logos of Imprisonment.
He had masked them perfectly to appear identical to the lightning surrounding them, making them completely undetectable.

At this moment, where Astrape’s descending hands would bring annihilation crashing down to ensure Noah’s death, Noah activated the veiled Logos that were now mere inches away from the thundering entity.
HUUM!
The terrifying waves of pressure and overwhelming power that Astrape was releasing instantly began to dwindle and be systematically repressed.
The seven Logos of Imprisonment activated simultaneously, wrapping around the shocked entity with binding authority.
Additional Logos manifested in rapid succession.
Multiple Logos of Absolute Separation cut Astrape off from his Civilization and Way.
Logos of Predetermined Failure ensured that any attempt to draw upon external Existence or utilize his Way would conclude in immediate collapse.
Because of the extreme closeness and proximity, Noah’s mastery expressed itself with devastating efficiency.
Tendrils of white lightning that had surrounded Astrape instantly transformed back into visible Logos and began binding him with multiplying restraints.
Noah himself took his Goad and began striking with serpentine speed.
The stick lashed out multiple times in rapid succession, each strike landing on different points across Astrape’s massive form.
With each precise impact, another portion of Astrape’s power was locked away and sealed.
The strikes looked like an intricate dance of Existence itself.
In the surroundings, the vibrant music of the festival permeated even into this expanded arena space.
The rhythm of drums, the melodic tones of Phoneme-based instruments, the harmonic chanting of The First Tongue all created an atmosphere that transformed violence into performance!
Above, the Ginnu Lifeforms were dancing with even more fervor as if everything had reached a critical precipice.
Their movements became faster, more passionate, more celebratory.
The more times Noah struck Astrape with his Goad, the dimmer and dimmer the authority of this once-terrifying being became.
No matter how desperately Astrape tried to express his Way of Fulmination, the Logos already binding him made such expression impossible.
And even when he managed to break through individual Phoneme connections in the linguistic chains through sheer force, Noah reformed them even faster than Astrape could shatter the links.
For the final strike, Noah took a batting stance with his Goad held in both hands.
He swung upward with explosive force, the stick connecting with Astrape’s bound form and launching the massive entity high into the air.
Noah’s figure flickered and appeared far above at the precise trajectory where Astrape would arrive.
He swung downward with equal devastating power, smashing the helpless entity back toward the arena floor with meteor-like velocity.
BOOM!
