chapters.title: Chapter 4623: End of The Line II
paragraphs: What choice wouldTHE Primordial Chaosdemand from Noah?

As his very existence remained under constant crushing pressure, as he continued facing the immensity of the fundamental question of who he was before Primordial Chaos, this entity continued speaking as if it did not even matter what Noah was experiencing right now.
Even though no one could know with complete certainty whether this entity understood exactly what Noah’s existence was currently facing.
And at such a critical point, he was also posing something else entirely.
Noah did not have to look around to perceive that at this moment, there was an immense silence spreading throughout the entire region.
Every single Ginnu Lifeform had formed a circle of profound silence and somberness as each one now felt the oppressive aura ofTHE Primordial Chaosradiating outward.
His presence spread like a suffocating blanket across all of reality.
To experience the aura of an entity on the same unfathomable level asTHE Creaturewas to feel utterly crushed.
It felt as if all of Existence was constantly pressing down on top of you from every direction simultaneously, compressing your very being into an infinitely small point.
At this moment, every single entity that did not possess any Depth of Absolute Sovereignty seemed like they were struggling desperately for their lives.
Their consciousness threatened to simply turn off and be forcibly put to sleep in the next instant, overwhelmed by pressure too great to endure.
And yet the Ginnu Lifeforms stood.
They were somber and they felt the despotic weight crushing them.
But they still floated all aroundUl’morethin a protective circle.
As if regardless of what happened here, regardless of what this apex entity demanded, they would stand with their leader and their fellow Ginnu Lifeforms until the end.
THE Primordial Chaoscontinued as if none of this solidarity was of any consequence to him.
His eyes remained fixed solely on Noah with unwavering focus.

|I don’t like to ramble unnecessarily, so I will present you with the choice directly and simply. Ul’moreth here took you into Ginnungagap when you needed refuge. He saved you from whatever you were fleeing. He seemingly taught you The First Tongue with tremendous generosity. He brought you into his home, his settlement filled with his people.|
His voice carried casual authority.

|There are many Ginnu Lifeforms gathered here. Before you came, they were living perfectly fine lives in relative peace. And if you had not come here, it would have continued to be this way. But now that you’re here...|
He paused for perfect effect.

|I will tell you plainly that every single life on this Primordial Genesis Shore will perish, including Ul’moreth himself, unless you make a choice. A simple choice to declare with conviction that before Primordial Chaos existed, The First Tongue was nothing. That Existence itself, The First Tongue, that Mana, that all of it rose directly from Primordial Chaos as the true origin.|
His smile remained pleasant.
|Just say those simple words with genuine conviction, and all those gathered here will be saved. Refuse, and they all die. Simple.|
The words were devastatingly heavy and terrifying.
Noah kept his gaze utterly calm upon this being even as all of his existence continued vibrating with immense pressure.
The effort he was exerting to maintain coherence was monumentally heavy and vibrant.
Even though he couldn’t even begin to care about potential Harvest at this moment.
What Harvest could there possibly be when the next few seconds of continued existence were not even guaranteed?
And this entity had posed a question of choice that was actually identical to the existential question he was already facing.
This entity was telling him exactly how to answer the paradox.
To make the choice to abandon the immensity of Mana as fundamental origin.
To claim that before Primordial Chaos and Existence, Mana was nothing!
This was the choiceTHE Primordial Chaoswanted him to make in exchange for the lives ofUl’morethand all the others gathered here.
It was absolutely ridiculous.
The pressure Noah felt became even more crushingly intense as he looked down at his hand still holding ontoTHE Primordial Chaos.
It felt like he was gripping something that, if it exerted even slight pressure, could begin systematically crushing every ounce of his existence into nothingness.
This was a type of feeling he never wanted to experience in his existence.
A feeling ofcompletehelplessness.
A feeling of being utterly at the mercy of others.

Because if the disposition ofTHE Primordial Chaoshad been even slightly different, if he did not genuinely care about choices as he presented himself right now, then whether Noah’s threat about being able to induce something irreversible in Existence if harmed was true or not would be completely meaningless.
Everything would simply be over regardless.
It would be the absolute end of the line.
This was something Noah had fought constantly for days and weeks and months to never be in a position like this.
And yet here he was anyway.
Because this was Existence.
Existence was not fair. Existence was not benevolent. Existence was not malicious.
Existence simply was.
And now he simply had to find a way forward in the face of impossible odds!
So he turned his gaze towardTHE Primordial Chaos, who at this time shook his head while looking at Noah with deep understanding.
THE Primordial Chaosthen turned towardUl’morethand all the other gathered Ginnu Lifeforms.
His voice carried casual cruelty.

|You all do not even need to wait for his answer. I already know exactly what it will be. This man here that you brought so generously into your home, that you were planning to put your full backing behind, to sell short your own Way of Existence and make it unfathomably harder for yourselves to ever advance further... this man will never sacrifice himself for any of you.|
His smile widened.
|Regardless of all you have done for him, regardless of the kindness shown, he will choose himself. Every time.|
THE Primordial Chaosturned to look directly at Noah.
His gaze carried the weight of someone looking at another that they considered to be fundamentally the same as themselves.
He continued with voice carrying absolute certainty.

|Did you think it would be different with him compared to me or THE Secretive Eon or THE Creature? I tell you now with complete confidence that he is one and the same as us. People like us have this particular complex where we somehow believe that we are above all others. Not necessarily in terms of raw power, but in a sense of fundamental entitlement.|
He paused thoughtfully.

|Even that word does not fully do it justice, but entitlement is about right. Beings like him and I live our entire existence as if our lives are somehow more existentially important than others. As if other entities can die or lose absolutely everything, and that would be more than acceptable, but not us. Never us.|
BOOM!

Because if the disposition ofTHE Primordial Chaoshad been even slightly different, if he did not genuinely care about choices as he presented himself right now, then whether Noah’s threat about being able to induce something irreversible in Existence if harmed was true or not would be completely meaningless.
Everything would simply be over regardless.
It would be the absolute end of the line.
This was something Noah had fought constantly for days and weeks and months to never be in a position like this.
And yet here he was anyway.
Because this was Existence.
Existence was not fair.
Existence was not benevolent.
Existence was not malicious.
Existence simply was.
And now he simply had to find a way forward in the face of impossible odds!
So he turned his gaze towardTHE Primordial Chaos, who at this time shook his head while looking at Noah with deep understanding.
THE Primordial Chaosthen turned towardUl’morethand all the other gathered Ginnu Lifeforms.
His voice carried casual cruelty.
|You all do not even need to wait for his answer.
I already know exactly what it will be.

This man here that you brought so generously into your home, that you were planning to put your full backing behind, to sell short your own Way of Existence and make it unfathomably harder for yourselves to ever advance further... this man will never sacrifice himself for any of you.|
His smile widened.
|Regardless of all you have done for him, regardless of the kindness shown, he will choose himself.
Every time.|
THE Primordial Chaosturned to look directly at Noah.
His gaze carried the weight of someone looking at another that they considered to be fundamentally the same as themselves.
He continued with voice carrying absolute certainty.
|Did you think it would be different with him compared to me or THE Secretive Eon or THE Creature?
I tell you now with complete confidence that he is one and the same as us.
People like us have this particular complex where we somehow believe that we are above all others.
Not necessarily in terms of raw power, but in a sense of fundamental entitlement.|
He paused thoughtfully.
|Even that word does not fully do it justice, but entitlement is about right.
Beings like him and I live our entire existence as if our lives are somehow more existentially important than others.
As if other entities can die or lose absolutely everything, and that would be more than acceptable, but not us.
Never us.|
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4624: End of The Line III
paragraphs: His purple eyes gleamed.

|We don’t sacrifice our foundations for others. We don’t willingly die. People can die for us, we may close our eyes afterward and solemnly swear we will avenge them... but we will never give up our Way for others’ survival. It is a type of entitlement, hubris, and fundamental arrogance that none of you can truly understand.|
He gestured toward Noah.
|But our Anomaly here understands this feeling very well, because he and I are exactly the same at our cores.|
BOOM!
The atmosphere turned incredibly heavy and profoundly silent.
Noah stared at this being with extremely cold eyes that held no warmth whatsoever.
He realized this entity was genuinely dangerous and constantly attacking even though he was not utilizing any direct existential authority.
His words alone were enough to achieve a tremendous number of terrible things.
Sowing doubt, creating division, undermining trust.
But at this time, in this immense silence whereTHE Primordial Chaoshad been completely controlling the stage and narrative, Noah finally opened his mouth to speak.
His voice emerged with tyrannical calm and devastating concision.

|You speak of entitlement and arrogance as if they are unique to beings like us. But every entity across all of Existence believes their life matters more than others’. The difference is that some have the power to make that belief reality, and others do not. You are not special for valuing your own existence. You are simply powerful enough that no one can force you to pretend otherwise.|
His eyes blazed with cold fire.

|And you mistake conviction for arrogance. I will not abandon my Way because you demand it. Not because I believe I am entitled to survival, but because my Way is true regardless of what any entity claims.|
WAA!
Then Noah addressed the fundamental question directly.
The answer to The Oldest Paradox of Existence.
Before Primordial Chaos, what was The First Tongue? What was Mana?
His voice rang out with profound authority.

|Before Primordial Chaos, before Existence itself took recognizable form, there was not nothing. There was potential. There was the capacity for reality to manifest. And that capacity, that fundamental potential for anything to exist at all, is what Mana represents. Not as what came after, but as the inherent possibility that preceded others.|
His existence began illuminating with unfathomable waves of blue-gold brilliance.

|The First Tongue is not something that emerged from Chaos. It is the language through which potential becomes actual. The mechanism by which possibility collapses into reality. Chaos may have shaped Existence, but the capacity for Chaos itself to exist required something prior. Required the fundamental substrate of possibility.|
The light intensified dramatically.

|So before Primordial Chaos, before Existence, before even the concept of ’before’ held meaning, there was Mana. There was The First Tongue as the Infinite Potential for anything to be real. The First Tongue is how that potential expresses itself into manifestation. Neither created Chaos. Both simply are, making Chaos possible rather than being products of it.|
His words carried absolute conviction.
|This is my answer. This is my Way. And I will not abandon it regardless of consequence.|
BOOM!
Glorious prompts descended before his vision as his entire being blazed with triumphant radiance.
|Existential Challenge - Resolution|
|Your answer to The Oldest Paradox of Existence has been evaluated|
|Verdict: Adequate|
|Note: Your answer is not perfect or complete, but it is coherent and defensible|
|You have successfully defended your position and standing regarding The Way of Mana, The Way of The First Tongue|
|Your existence has proven resilient enough to maintain identity even when questioned byTHE Primordial Chaositself|
|Critical Threshold Achieved|
|Your existence has built sufficient foundation to step into THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty of The First Tongue in the near future|
|All prerequisites have been met through this existential trial|
|Lineage Formation - Final Component Obtained|
|The last ingredient for your emerging Lineage has been secured through this confrontation|
|Bloodline Crystallization: 100% Complete|
|Your new fundamental identity is ready to manifest|
|The Distinction of The Early Creature, Osmont has been completely dissolved|
|New Lineage: Pending Emergence|
Such extraordinary prompts descended before Noah’s eyes.
At this moment, as his gaze shone with unfathomable luminosity, he stared directly into the eyes ofTHE Primordial Chaos.
Who was actually smiling brilliantly at this moment with what seemed like genuine satisfaction.
As if everything had unfolded exactly as he hoped.
And this entire time, through everything that had occurred, this terrifying entity had never once released Noah’s hand from his grip.

AsTHE Primordial Chaoscontinued gazing at Noah after he finished answering The Oldest Paradox of Existence, in the span of less than an instant, Noah’s thoughts moved rapidly faster than even Planck Speed itself.
His existence buzzed with unprecedented intensity as he felt something unfathomable emerging as a direct result of his declaration.
He felt his lineage crystallizing into reality!
Within his heart, something fundamental shifted.
The organ that had been The Heart of The Early Creature, Osmont began transforming with devastating finality.
But this was not destruction. This was metamorphosis.
His heart, which had served as the foundation for so much of his power across countless Weavings, was being reforged entirely.
The Distinction of The Early Creature dissolved completely, the identity that had defined him for so long finally being replaced by something that belonged wholly to his current path.
In its place, something new began to manifest.
A heart that pulsed with blue-gold radiance so intense it seemed to contain compressed Infinity.
A heart that beat with rhythm that spoke The First Tongue with every contraction.
A heart that embodied the answer he had given toTHEPrimordial Chaos.
Prompts descended with overwhelming significance.
|Lineage Emergence Underway|
|Your new fundamental Lineage has manifested in response to your declaration against The Oldest Paradox of Existence|
|Lineage Name: THE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons, THE Potentate|
|The emerging lineage disdains any Distinction less than THE as it has given itself capital T, H, E|
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4625: End of The Line IV
paragraphs: The name reverberated through his existence again and again as a glorious symphony surged within his being.
And all of this was happening in a fraction of an instant as he processed these prompts and underwent these changes in that impossible span of time.
But as of this moment, he was no longer The Early Creature.
Every cell within him began to scream with new identity.
THE! Genesis! Monarch! Of! Infinite! Lexicons!
THE Potentate!
It burned within his Weavings of Existence gloriously, branding itself onto every component of what he was.
|Classification: Unique Primordial Lineage tied to The First Tongue|
|Origin: Born from the conviction that Mana represents infinite potential and The First Tongue is the mechanism of manifestation|
|Heart Transformation - New Distinction Acquired|
|Your heart has been completely reforged and elevated|
|Former Identity: The Heart of The Early Creature, Osmont (dissolved)|
|New Identity:THE Heart of Infinite Lexicons|
|Distinction Gained:THE Potentate|
|Effect: Your heart now generates a unique form of blood that carries both Mana and Fragments of Phonemes of The First Tongue in every drop|
THUMP! THUMP! THUMP!
His heart beat like an ancient drum awakening from primordial slumber.
It had woken with power when he first attained the status of an Early Creature, yes.
But the way it beat right now was entirely different.
It was akin to the beating of drums from the earliest times of Existence.
From times when Mana ran wild and untamed across reality.
From times when The First Tongue was freshly spoken and everything was still being named.
He felt as if each beat echoed outward not just through space but through time itself.
The rhythm flowing backward through Ginnungagap where he currently traversed.
Flowing forward through eons to that distant blue planet where he would eventually be born.
It was indescribably glorious, this sensation of his heart connecting past and future through pure potential.
|THE Heart of Infinite Lexiconsbegins pumping Glorious Genesis Blood of Potential throughout your existence|
|This blood carries the fundamental nature of your Lineage to every aspect of your being|
|Transformation Status: In Progress|
Noah’s entire existence began to shine with unfathomable blue-gold brilliance as the new blood pumped outward from his transformed heart.
It spread through every vein, every cell, every atom of his being.
Where it flowed, transformation followed.
His body began restructuring itself at the most fundamental level, integrating the new Lineage into every component of his existence.
Additional prompts bloomed with extraordinary detail.
|THE Heart of Infinite Lexicons - Core Properties|
|Primary Function: Generates Glorious Genesis Blood of Potential that enhances all aspects of existence|
|Secondary Function: Serves as anchor point for The First Tongue within your being|
|Tertiary Function: Allows instant conversion between Mana and Phonemes of The First Tongue|
|Quaternary Function: Grants instinctive understanding of how Potential becomes actual|
|Lineage Capabilities - Foundational Features|
|Feature One: Lexical Genesis|
|Your Lineage grants the profound capability to create new Phonemes of The First Tongue|
|Maximum New Phonemes: Nine (9) unique creations|
|Requirements: Deep understanding of the concept, sufficient Civilizational Authority, and conviction in the Phoneme’s necessity|
|Potential Phonemes Identified Based on Your Way:|
|- Phoneme of Quintessence|
|- Phoneme of Infinity|
|- Phoneme of Tyranny|
|- Phoneme of Fortune (Loot)|
|- Phoneme of Advantage (Cheats)|
|- Phoneme of Narrative (Protagonist)|
|- Phoneme of Harvest|
|- Phoneme of Hunger|
|- Phoneme of Potential|
|Note: These Phonemes will be recognized as valid by The First Tongue itself if and when created|
|Warning: Creating new Phonemes is an act of tremendous significance and will allow those proficient in The First Tongue across Observable Existence to sense a change|
BOOM!
A ridiculous capability bloomed within his awareness at this moment.
Mind you, all of this was happening as Noah still held the hand ofTHE Primordial Chaos.
But it remained contained within that fraction of an instant as his thoughts moved faster than Planck Speed itself.
It was because he was rapidly processing all the emerging Weavings of his power and lineage.
To ensure he had potential solutions against an entity so overwhelmingly superior that he could be crushed in a moment.
His emerging lineage was one possible answer.
The attainment ofTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntywas another.
But all of it remained Potential until actualized.
And asTHE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons,his mind buzzed with comprehension ofInfinite Potentialitself.
Even this moment right here, these Weavings of Existence playing out right now, they were filled with potential that could be actualized into something grand.
He simply had to determine how to do it.
The first glorious possibility when it came to this infinite potential was the capability to forge his own Phonemes.
It was grand and unfathomable.
There were only eighteen core Phonemes in all of Existence, each with their own countless variations.
And yet he would get to create his own?!
The prompts continued descending in that fraction of an instant.
|Feature Two: Resonance of The First Tongue|
|Your Lineage shares profound connection with all aspects of The First Tongue|
|Effect: Learning new Phonemes is 900% faster|
|Effect: Forming Logos requires 70% less concentration|
|Effect: Inscription speed increased by 1,200%|
|Effect: Error rate when working with The First Tongue reduced to effective zero|
|Effect: Can sense when others speak The First Tongue within vast distances|
|Effect: Instinctively understand the grammatical structure of any Logos encountered|
|Feature Three: Mana Supremacy|
|Your Lineage declares Mana as fundamental origin andInfinite Potential|
|Effect: All Mana-based abilities enhanced by 500% for your entire Civilization|

|Effect: Mana regeneration is functionally infinite for the strongest in your Civilization - granting them Infinite Potential. When you attain THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger, this capability will be fully actualized|
|Effect: Can convert any form of energy or authority into Mana with 89% efficiency|
|Effect: Your Mana naturally influences and gradually converts other forms of power|
|Effect: Resistance to non-Mana authorities increased by 340%|
BOOM!
A terrifying set of capabilities bloomed as they detailed the usage and exertion of infinite potential.
For those in his Civilization to essentially have Infinite Mana regeneration.
Infinite Mana!

In what he could now say and do with linguistic authority.

|Effect: Can temporarily manifest potential futures as if they were real|
|Duration: Variable based on complexity|
|Limitation: Cannot manifest impossibilities, only unrealized possibilities|
|Application: Can briefly wield abilities you could potentially develop in the future|
Oh.
Everything stopped.
Noah felt like all of Existence paused.
Potential Manifestation.
Could this be an answer? Could this be what he was searching for to escape the current impossible situation?
His mind raced through possibilities at speeds that transcended comprehension.
If he could manifest potential futures, then theoretically he could manifest a future where he had already achievedTHE Surface Depth.
Manifest a future where he possessed power sufficient to stand againstTHE Primordial Chaos.
Manifest a future where he had already escaped and was safe.
The limitation stated he could not manifest impossibilities, only unrealized possibilities.
But was a future where he survived this encounter impossible?
No. It was merely improbable. Unrealized. But not impossible.
The issue was his current power level.
The potential he wanted to manifest might be deemed impossible by the mechanism simply because the gap between his current state and that desired future was too vast.
If he tried to manifest himself as aTHE Fundamental Depthentity, the power requirement would likely collapse the manifestation instantly.
But what if he was more strategic?
What if he manifested not overwhelming power, but the perfect timing?
The perfect moment of distraction?
The perfect confluence of events that would allow escape?
What if he manifested a potential future whereTHE Primordial Chaossimply chose to let him go?
That future existed as a possibility, slim though it might be.
Or what if he combinedPotential Manifestationwith his other capabilities?
Manifested a future where he had already formed one of his nine unique Phonemes?
The Phoneme of Advantage, perhaps, which could tilt probability itself in his favor?
Or the Phoneme of Narrative, which could reshape the story being written?
His eyes pulsed with building brightness as he catalogued these possibilities for immediate or future usage.
Even if they were impossible potentials given his current limitations, they represented tools he could refine and develop.

chapters.title: Chapter 4627: Collapse II
paragraphs: As he contemplated these possibilities, the remaining prompts descended.
|Feature Nine: Lexical Sovereignty|
|Your Lineage grants increasing authority over The First Tongue itself|
|Effect: Your spoken Logos carry additional weight and authority|
|Effect:Can overwrite or modify Logos spoken by others (requires sufficient power difference)|
|Effect: Can sense when your name is spoken in The First Tongue anywhere in Existence|
|Effect: Grants immunity to linguistic bindings below your classification level|
|Feature Ten: Civilizational Resonance|
|Your Lineage resonates with THE Civilizational Authority structure|
|Effect: Advancement through Depths of Sovereignty is 450% faster|
|Effect: Can sense the Depth of other entities instinctively|
|Effect: Your Civilization develops automatically as your mastery of The First Tongue increases|
|Effect: Prisoners in THE Infinite Desmoterion benefit from your Lineage’s passive influence|
The transformation continued as billowing waves of blue-gold blood flooded through Noah’s existence.
His skin began glowing from within as if he had become a living embodiment of compressed potential.
His eyes blazed with intensity that seemed to peer directly into the fabric of reality itself.
His very presence began carrying weight that made nearby space tremble.
Final prompts descended.
|Lineage Manifestation - Complete|
|THE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons has fully integrated into your existence|
|All features active and operational|
|Your fundamental nature has been elevated beyond what you were|
|The Early Creature, Osmont no longer exists as a meaningful identity|
|You are now:THE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons, THE Potentate, The Nascent Master of The First Tongue|
|Immediate Effects:|
|- THE Foundation of The First Tongue: Reinforced to Absolute tier|
|- THE Civilizational Authority Resistance: 81% to 95%|
|- Mastery Classification: Fluent Speaker (Peak) to Threshold of Perfect Speaker|
|-Time to THE Surface Depth: Minutes. Minutes. Minutes!|
|- Bloodline Power: Increased by 3,400%|
|-Existential Weight: At THE classification despite current Pre-THE status.Could your Existential Weight exceed most THE Surface Depth entities without you attaining THE?|
Noah’s transformation reached completion as the last of the Glorious Genesis Blood of Potential finished circulating through his existence.
He stood there shining with unfathomable radiance.
Still holding hands withTHE Primordial Chaos.
Who continued smiling brilliantly.
Noah’s mind raced through potential solutions as he faced this overwhelming force.
He needed unpredictability. He actually needed chaos amidst all of this.
Because only in chaos would he find opportunity to make his exit.
He had grand ideas and possibilities of exploringTHE Vaults of Ginnungagapand other potential Weavings.
But with entities possessing excessively greater power than him moving about, he would have to cut his temporal traversal short.
Because of his paranoia and extreme caution, he had already made certain preparations that had not yet revealed themselves. He had left behind Sparks.
They would likely only activate after he left Ginnungagap entirely.
So at this moment, even if they represented impossible potentials, he prepared to unleashPotential Manifestationas a last resort.
But in the next instant, something unexpected occurred.
"Stop!"
The voice rang out with desperate authority.
At this moment, the figures ofTHE First Hunger and THE Living Originarrived with expressions of shock and determination.
Their gazes were stern as they took in the scene before them.
THE Primordial Chaosholding Noah’s hand.
Both surrounded by the scattered encirclement of Ginnu Lifeforms and the frozen form of Ul’moreth.
Noah’s gaze became even more somber as he sensedTor and THE Living Origin’sarrival.
Because the entity whose hand he currently held was one who seemed to genuinely enjoy playing games of sacrifice.
Of forcing others to make impossible choices.
Something Noah absolutely detested.
And now even more people had arrived who might be forced to make such sacrifices.
As ifTHE Primordial Chaoscould perfectly infer his thoughts, he smiled brilliantly while looking directly at Noah.
|Okay. It seems like you won’t really answer my question after all. And by not answering, that is also a choice in itself. What a shame. What a shame.|
HUUM!
The words carried ominous finality.
AsTHE Primordial Chaosmade such an ominous statement,Tor and THE Living Originroared out with desperate determination as they rushed forth.
Their combined authority erupted with building intensity, seeking to intervene in whatever was about to occur.
And off to the side, the figure ofTHE Primeval Titan, Ul’moreth, finally made his move.
He began slowly floating toward Noah andTHE Primordial Chaoswith deliberate purpose.
His voice emerged carrying the weight of eons and absolute conviction.

|In Existence, a teacher has a few fundamental responsibilities that cannot be shirked or delegated. The first responsibility is to impart knowledge without holding back what the student needs to know. The second responsibility is to correct errors and guide the student away from paths that lead to collapse. The third responsibility is to push the student beyond what they believe themselves capable of achieving.|
His hairy form continued advancing as obsidian-gold light began radiating from him with building power.

|The fourth responsibility is to recognize when the student has surpassed the teacher and to step aside with grace. The fifth responsibility is to never claim credit for the student’s achievements, as their success belongs to them alone. And the sixth responsibility, the one that supersedes all others...|
He paused as his entire existence began to tremble.
|...is to ensure the safety of my student at any cost. This responsibility I will complete without fail, or my Civilization will collapse and my Way will dissolve into nothing!|
The words were devastatingly heavy.
In the next moment, the power thatUl’morethradiated shockingly spilled pastTHE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
It headed toward an unfathomable direction beyond normal classification.
His entire existence became surrounded by scintillating obsidian-gold light as multiple Genesis Principles manifested around his form.
He wasTHE Aeon-Strand Keeper. THE Primeval Titan.
And at this time, he moved!
When Noah first met him and examined his status, among the details revealed was a philosophy that stated:All things flow from The First Tongue and return to it eventually.
His Way wasThe Way of Primordial Continuity.
The understanding that Existence moved in grand cycles, that all authority ultimately originated from and would return to The First Tongue in endless progression.
And at this moment, Noah could sense with horrifying clarity that this being was burning his veryPrimordial Continuityitself.
Consuming the fundamental essence of his Way to generate power beyond his normal limits.
Yet another sacrifice. Something Noah hated above almost all else.
Yet he couldn’t do anything to prevent it in the next moment.
THE Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Manaflashed brilliantly acrossUl’moreth’sentire body.
Everything seemed to shift into slow motion as reality itself struggled to process what was occurring.
This Genesis Principle expanded outward with irresistible authority, covering everything in the immediate vicinity.
Where Noah stood clasping the hand ofTHE Primordial Chaos, Ul’morethinstantly manifested in his exact position as if there had been a perfect replacement.
A seamless exchange of spatial coordinates and existential positions.
And whereUl’morethhad been standing moments before, Noah now found himself!
It was the work ofThe Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Mana!

chapters.title: Chapter 4628: Collapse III
paragraphs: The Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Manaoperated on a profound but elegantly simple concept.
It declared that at the most fundamental level, before differentiation into distinct forms and identities, all Mana was identical and interchangeable.
Before Mana became fire or water, light or darkness, creation or destruction, it existed in undifferentiated potential.
And beings themselves, at their deepest core, were expressions of that same undifferentiated potential.
Ul’morethhad leveraged this truth to perform an exchange that should have been impossible.
Even with the overwhelming power ofTHE Primordial Chaos,even with his hand physically clasped around what he thought was Noah, the exchange succeeded.
BecauseUl’morethhad burned his Way of Primordial Continuity to temporarily exceed his normal scope of power.
And because Noah represented The First Tongue itself in living form. Represented Mana itself in its purest expression.
Undifferentiated potential made manifest.
So when Ul’moreth invoked THE Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Mana, declaring that he and Noah were fundamentally identical at the level of pure potential, reality accepted that declaration.
And enacted the exchange regardless ofTHE Primordial Chaos’sgrip.
It was simultaneously the most complex and most simple maneuver imaginable.
Complex in the metaphysical understanding required to execute it.
Simple in the fundamental truth it exploited.
At the exact moment of the exchange, Noah felt an influx of tremendous authority and compressed information flow directly into his existence.
A prompt materialized before his vision.
|Emergency Transmission Received|
|THE Primeval Titan has imparted THE Farewell of Ginnungagap unto your existence|
|This represents the collective accumulated knowledge, treasures, and final gifts of a Primeval Titan|
|Content: Sealed until safe activation conditions are met|
|Warning: Opening prematurely may draw unwanted attention|
Noah felt a radiant obsidian-gold box of concentrated Weavings being pushed deep into his existence for safekeeping.
In the next moment, he heardUl’moreth’svoice resonating directly in his mind with desperate urgency.
|Please do not let the burning of your teacher be for nothing. Go, and go now. Do not look back. Do not hesitate. Just GO!|
The glorious and terrible scene unfolded in that stretched moment.
THE Primordial Chaosstared directly into the hairy obscured eyes ofTHE Primeval Titan.
And he actually smiled brilliantly before beginning to laugh with genuine amusement.
As if this entire development was the most entertaining thing he had witnessed in eons.
In this moment where Existence itself seemed to move with painful slowness, Noah felt his entire being buzzing with overwhelming emotion.
His eyes locked ontoUl’moreth, taking in every detail of the being who had taught him so much.
Then his gaze shifted to the figures ofTHE First Hunger and THE Living Originrushing desperately forward.
And further behind them, he could see the slowly walking crippled figure of Ains, The fisherman who had sacrificed everything.
He saw all of them clearly.
He gave each one a single final look, burning their images into his memory.
Then he closed his eyes and uttered the words with absolute conviction.
|Temporal Traversal.|
He ended his time in this era, concluding his temporal traversal.
His existence burned with profound defiance at the way it was ending.
It burned with rage that another entity had to step in on his behalf and consume their very Way of Existence to give him a chance to escape.
But since it was done, since the sacrifice had been made, he would not allow it to be for nothing.
He did not tarry. He did not hesitate or second-guess.
His Early Atlas of the Folds activated at once as his figure began being funneled backward across the rivers of time.
The reality of The Primordial Genesis Shore began to fade.
THE Primordial Chaos, Ul’moreth, and all the others started becoming distant and indistinct.
And then-

|Haha, I have finally caught you! And you are even using time itself at this very moment. Just where are you returning to, friend? Do you know how much your reckless actions across time can affect Existence? Do you understand the Loops of Time?!|
BOOM!
Just as he was leaving. Just as temporal traversal was nearly complete and about to return him to his current era!
Everything became frozen in time itself.
The figures ofTHE Primeval Titan and THE Primordial Chaosand all others that had been fading away became actualized and very real again.
Noah turned around in shock as the endless rivers of time that had been flowing smoothly around him became violently unstable.
Behind him, he could now see a new entity.
Surrounded by brilliant purple waves of temporal authority.
Time itself seemed to bend and flow around this being’s form.
The figure appeared humanoid but with features that seemed to shift and age and regress simultaneously.
Their skin held a quality that made it impossible to determine if they were ancient or newborn.
Their eyes contained infinite depth, as if one could peer through them and see every moment that had ever existed layered upon itself.
Purple light emanated from them in cascading waves that made reality itself tremble.
They wore robes that seemed woven from compressed moments, each thread a frozen instant of time.
Noah did not have to think long before realizing with defiance that this wasTHE Living Temporal.

On the cusp of him leaving and returning to his current era, afterTHE Primeval Titan Ul’morethhad burned his very Way of Primordial Continuity to give him this chance, another entity at the same level asTHE Primordial Chaoshad actually arrived to stop everything!
And one could definitively sayTHE Living Temporaloperated at the same unfathomable tier asTHE Primordial Chaos.
The allure of undeniable power emanating from them far exceeded any other entity present.
It bordered on the exact same wavelength of authority asTHE Primordial Chaoshimself.
The situation had turned from hopeful to unfathomably worse in an instant.
This profound chaotic progression caused the distant figures ofTHE First Hunger and THE Living Originto pale even further.
At this moment,THE Living Originroared with desperate fury.
"Temporal, what are you doing?! Why are you interfering now?!"
Her eyes carried profound lividity as her own body began erupting with a type of power she had never unveiled before.
Authority that had remained hidden throughout all their previous encounters.
And yet THE Living Temporal did not even turn toward her.
His gaze remained fixed on Noah as if observing the most fascinating specimen in all of Existence.
His voice emerged carrying terrifying weight.

|I have been searching for you across time for longer than you can comprehend. Someone jumping around back and forth through the eras, causing subtle changes here and there that ripple forward and backward as you didn’t truly change anything...but causality was tested. To have finally found you is a stupendous occasion beyond measure. Come.|

In this moment where Existence itself seemed to move with painful slowness, Noah felt his entire being buzzing with overwhelming emotion.
His eyes locked ontoUl’moreth, taking in every detail of the being who had taught him so much.
Then his gaze shifted to the figures ofTHE First Hunger and THE Living Originrushing desperately forward.
And further behind them, he could see the slowly walking crippled figure of Ains, The fisherman who had sacrificed everything.
He saw all of them clearly.
He gave each one a single final look, burning their images into his memory.
Then he closed his eyes and uttered the words with absolute conviction.
|Temporal Traversal.|
He ended his time in this era, concluding his temporal traversal.
His existence burned with profound defiance at the way it was ending.
It burned with rage that another entity had to step in on his behalf and consume their very Way of Existence to give him a chance to escape.
But since it was done, since the sacrifice had been made, he would not allow it to be for nothing.
He did not tarry.
He did not hesitate or second-guess.
His Early Atlas of the Folds activated at once as his figure began being funneled backward across the rivers of time.
The reality of The Primordial Genesis Shore began to fade.
THE Primordial Chaos, Ul’moreth, and all the others started becoming distant and indistinct.
And then-
|Haha, I have finally caught you!
And you are even using time itself at this very moment.
Just where are you returning to, friend?
Do you know how much your reckless actions across time can affect Existence?
Do you understand the Loops of Time?!|
BOOM!
Just as he was leaving.
Just as temporal traversal was nearly complete and about to return him to his current era!
Everything became frozen in time itself.
The figures ofTHE Primeval Titan and THE Primordial Chaosand all others that had been fading away became actualized and very real again.
Noah turned around in shock as the endless rivers of time that had been flowing smoothly around him became violently unstable.
Behind him, he could now see a new entity.
Surrounded by brilliant purple waves of temporal authority.
Time itself seemed to bend and flow around this being’s form.
The figure appeared humanoid but with features that seemed to shift and age and regress simultaneously.
Their skin held a quality that made it impossible to determine if they were ancient or newborn.
Their eyes contained infinite depth, as if one could peer through them and see every moment that had ever existed layered upon itself.
Purple light emanated from them in cascading waves that made reality itself tremble.
They wore robes that seemed woven from compressed moments, each thread a frozen instant of time.
Noah did not have to think long before realizing with defiance that this wasTHE Living Temporal.

On the cusp of him leaving and returning to his current era, afterTHE Primeval Titan Ul’morethhad burned his very Way of Primordial Continuity to give him this chance, another entity at the same level asTHE Primordial Chaoshad actually arrived to stop everything!
And one could definitively sayTHE Living Temporaloperated at the same unfathomable tier asTHE Primordial Chaos.
The allure of undeniable power emanating from them far exceeded any other entity present.
It bordered on the exact same wavelength of authority asTHE Primordial Chaoshimself.
The situation had turned from hopeful to unfathomably worse in an instant.
This profound chaotic progression caused the distant figures ofTHE First Hunger and THE Living Originto pale even further.
At this moment,THE Living Originroared with desperate fury.
"Temporal, what are you doing?!
Why are you interfering now?!"
Her eyes carried profound lividity as her own body began erupting with a type of power she had never unveiled before.
Authority that had remained hidden throughout all their previous encounters.
And yet THE Living Temporal did not even turn toward her.
His gaze remained fixed on Noah as if observing the most fascinating specimen in all of Existence.
His voice emerged carrying terrifying weight.
|I have been searching for you across time for longer than you can comprehend.
Someone jumping around back and forth through the eras, causing subtle changes here and there that ripple forward and backward as you didn’t truly change anything...but causality was tested.
To have finally found you is a stupendous occasion beyond measure.
Come.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4629: Collapse IV
paragraphs: THE Living Temporalextended his hand with casual authority, as if Noah’s capture was already inevitable.
Noah’s eyes burned with absolute lividity and defiance.
His entire existence began shining with endless waves of blue-gold light.
What was this?!
Was Existence itself set on trying to collapse him here no matter what?!
Regardless of how much he prepared, regardless of how cautious he was, when temporal traversal had already activated successfully, another monstrous being had to appear at the worst possible moment?!
He looked like an imperious Emperor about to stake absolutely everything on one final stand.
His lineage began spilling outward with tremendous grandeur.
The full physical manifestation of his lineage that he had not yet expressed externally due to the ongoing chaos of events finally began to reveal itself.
An imperious blue-gold robe formed from actual Fragments of Phonemes of The First Tongue erupted around his body.
It descended and wrapped around him with majestic authority, each thread a compressed word of power.
More Fragments of Phonemes surged and spun over his body in complex patterns.
They began forming a radiant blue-gold crown that materialized above his head, floating there with regal magnificence.
The crown itself was constructed from interwoven Phonemes that spelled out concepts of sovereignty, infinite potential, and linguistic supremacy.

And yet, even as his lineage manifested with such unique power, even as he emanated waves of authority that made nearby Ginnu Lifeforms tremble, he could only hear the mocking laughter ofTHE Primordial Chaos.
That apex entity grasped the hand ofUl’moreth, who had already turned to see the figure ofTHE Living Temporaland howled with desperate fury.
And yetTHE Primordial Chaoskept his hand clasped ontoUl’morethso tightly thatTHE Primeval Titancould not move to intervene.
The situation was unfathomably dire.
At this time,THE Living Temporalthrust his massive hand outward to capture Noah directly.
Purple temporal authority wrapped around those fingers with concentrated power.
At such a critical moment...
HUUM!
Existence itself began to tremble violently.
The skies of The Primordial Genesis Shore shook as if reality was tearing.
An aura of immense proportions and unfathomable wonder bloomed above the settlement.

The mere eruption of this presence cascaded downward and caused every single entity that had not achieved a Depth of Absolute Sovereignty to have their consciousness immediately flicker and shut down.
They became unconscious and dropped from the skies like flies, unable to withstand even the passive pressure.
Even some weakerTHE Surface Depth of Absolute SovereigntyGinnu Lifeforms lost consciousness entirely and fell.
The laughter ofTHE Primordial Chaosceased abruptly.
The movement ofTHE Living Temporalstopped mid-motion.
Noah’s gaze became even more fiercely defiant as he looked upward to witness the emergence of an unfathomably massive and titanic outline of a humanoid entity.
This being’s entire body was surrounded and obscured by multicolored flames of pure Existence itself.
The flames burned in impossible colors that should not exist, shifting between hues that had no names.
Heat and steam and additional flames emanated continuously from what appeared to be a nose and mouth.
They were melting and healing the surrounding fabric of Existence in constant cycles.
Where the steam touched reality, it would dissolve momentarily before reforming instantly.
An air of profound ancientness surged around this entity.
An aura of immensity that suggested this being had existed since before time itself took coherent form.
The moment this titanic figure appeared, everything nearby turned utterly silent.
EvenTHE Primordial Chaos and THE Living Temporalceased all movement and sound.
Prompts materialized before Noah’s vision.
|You have glimpsed Immensity|
|You have glimpsed THE Creature|
|Warning: Prolonged observation may result in existential damage|
HUUM!
The moment this massive titanic entity appeared in full manifestation, the figure ofTHE Primordial Chaosthat had been laughing throughout this entire ordeal stopped completely.
His gaze turned upward towardTHE Creature.
His entire existence began illuminating with tremendous defensive power.
His expression became razor sharp as he spoke with voice carrying challenge.
|Oh no you don’t!|
Purple and chaotic authority erupted from him as he moved to counter whateverTHE Creatureintended.
Noah’s eyes burned with absolute defiance as his awareness registered three entities of unfathomably terrifying power all focused on this single moment.
THE Living Temporalbehind him had stopped momentarily whenTHE Creatureappeared.
But now his massive hand extended once more, burning with crackling waves of temporal authority to capture Noah.
Meanwhile, Noah could feel the influence ofTHE Primordial Chaossurging toward both himself andTHE Creaturesimultaneously.
Attempting to lock down all variables and control the outcome.
And this massive titanic entity that he now stared at with unwavering defiance...
Its face could not be clearly observed as it burned with far too much concentrated flame of Existence.
But Noah could absolutely feel the eyes of this being staring straight at him through that inferno.
His defiance burned even greater.
Was this what Existence wanted?!
Did they truly want to test him and force him to make good on his threats?!
Because he genuinely felt like he could do something absolutely irreversible to The First Tongue if he wished.
Something that would cause unknown cascading effects throughout all of reality.
If no solution presented itself, if things really continued heading toward this disastrous direction, if he and all those depending on him were put in mortal danger...
He would willingly flip the entire board and accept whatever consequences followed.
In this moment of unfathomable defiance, burning with determination to survive no matter the cost, he felt something shift within his existence.
A semblance of a Depth he had been approaching.
THE.
It was calling out to him with greater intensity than ever before.
The threshold was right there, tantalizingly close.
But when it came to beings who moved far faster than even Planck Speed, would any advancement be capable of changing anything in this frozen moment?!
Everything moved in terrible slow motion.
At this time, the massive titanic form of the immensity above The Primordial Genesis Shore raised one hand.
And simply clenched his fist.
A mere clench of a fist. Such a simple gesture.
And yet in the next moment, the figure ofTHE Living Temporalshowed a face of immense shock and genuine surprise.
The figure ofTHE Primordial Chaosroared out with what sounded like frustrated familiarity.
|You ugly bum!|
And in the next instant...
BOOM!
The terrifying and imposing temporal restrictions that had appeared the momentTHE Living Temporalarrived and stopped Noah’s traversal from proceeding...
They disappeared instantly as if they had never existed.
The sensation of Existence fading all around Noah, which had been interrupted, resumed immediately.
The figures ofUl’moreth, Tor, THE Living Origin, THE Primordial Chaos, and THE Living Temporalall began fading away once more.
Noah’s defiant gaze remained locked onTHE Creatureabove.
His eyes fumed with blue-gold Mana as they showed profound shock!
